16.165.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi sāvitrīṃ lokamātaram ..
mahā pāpapraśamanīṃ someśādīśadiksthitām .. 1 ..
16.165.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि सावित्रीं लोकमातरम् ..
महा पापप्रशमनीं सोमेशादीशदिक्स्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.165.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to Sāvitrī, the mother of the world, / who dispels great sins, situated in the northeastern quarter from Someśa.

16.165.s: saṃyatātmā naraḥ paśyettatra tāṃ niyatātmavān .. 2 ..
16.165.d: संयतात्मा नरः पश्येत्तत्र तां नियतात्मवान् .. 2 ..
16.165.m: With self restrained and mind controlled, a man should behold her there.

16.165.s:
brahmaṇā yaṣṭukāmena sāvitrī sahadharmiṇī ..
kṛtā tāṃ balato jñātvā gāyatrīṃ kopamāviśat .. 3 ..
16.165.d:
ब्रह्मणा यष्टुकामेन सावित्री सहधर्मिणी ..
कृता तां बलतो ज्ञात्वा गायत्रीं कोपमाविशत् .. 3 ..
16.165.m: When Brahmā desired to perform a sacrifice, Sāvitrī was [his] lawful partner in duty; / finding that Gāyatrī was taken by force, anger seized her.

16.165.s:
tataḥ saṃtyajya sā devī brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam ..
sapatnīroṣasantaptā prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritā .. 4 ..
16.165.d:
ततः संत्यज्य सा देवी ब्रह्माणं कमलोद्भवम् ..
सपत्नीरोषसन्तप्ता प्रभासं क्षेत्रमाश्रिता .. 4 ..
16.165.m: Then, abandoning Brahmā, the lotus-born, / burning with anger toward her co-wife, that goddess took refuge in the Prabhāsa kṣetra.

16.165.s:
tapaḥ karoti vipulaṃ devairapi suduḥsaham ..
tatra sthale sthitā devī sā'dyāpi priyadarśanā .. 5 ..
16.165.d:
तपः करोति विपुलं देवैरपि सुदुःसहम् ..
तत्र स्थले स्थिता देवी साऽद्यापि प्रियदर्शना .. 5 ..
16.165.m: She performs great austerity, very hard to endure even for the gods. / Standing at that place, that fair-visaged goddess is [present] even today.

16.165.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
kimarthaṃ sā parityaktā sāvitrī brahmaṇā purā ..
gāyatrī ca kathaṃ prāptā kena cāsya niveditā .. 6 ..
16.165.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
किमर्थं सा परित्यक्ता सावित्री ब्रह्मणा पुरा ..
गायत्री च कथं प्राप्ता केन चास्य निवेदिता .. 6 ..
16.165.m: The Goddess said: / For what reason was that Sāvitrī abandoned long ago by Brahmā? / And how was Gāyatrī obtained, and by whom was she brought to him?

16.165.s:
kīdṛśīṃ tāṃ ca gāyatrīṃ labdhavānpadmasaṃbhavaḥ ..
yastāṃ patnīṃ samutsṛjya tasyāmeva mano dadhau .. 7 ..
16.165.d:
कीदृशीं तां च गायत्रीं लब्धवान्पद्मसंभवः ..
यस्तां पत्नीं समुत्सृज्य तस्यामेव मनो दधौ .. 7 ..
16.165.m: Of what sort was that Gāyatrī obtained by the lotus-born [Brahmā], / who, having completely abandoned that wife, set his mind on her alone?

16.165.s:
kasya sā duhitā deva kimarthaṃ ca vivāhitā ..
etanme kautukaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 8 .. ..
16.165.d:
कस्य सा दुहिता देव किमर्थं च विवाहिता ..
एतन्मे कौतुकं सर्वं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 8 .. ..
16.165.m: Whose daughter was she, O Lord, and for what purpose was she married? / You ought to tell me all this curiosity accurately.

16.165.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sāvitryāścaritaṃ mahat ..
yathā sā brahmaṇā tyaktā gāyatrī ca vivāhitā .. 9 ..
16.165.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि सावित्र्याश्चरितं महत् ..
यथा सा ब्रह्मणा त्यक्ता गायत्री च विवाहिता .. 9 ..
16.165.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall relate the great deed of Sāvitrī: / how she was abandoned by Brahmā and Gāyatrī was married.

16.165.s:
purā buddhiḥ samutpannā brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ ..
iti vedā mayā proktā yajñārthaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 7.1.165.10 ..
16.165.d:
पुरा बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः ..
इति वेदा मया प्रोक्ता यज्ञार्थं नात्र संशयः .. 7.1.165.10 ..
16.165.m: Long ago, a thought arose in Brahmā, whose birth is from the unmanifest: / 'Thus the Vedas were spoken by me for the sake of sacrifice, there is no doubt here.

16.165.s:
yajñaiḥ saṃtarpitā devā vṛṣṭiṃ dāsyaṃti bhūtale ..
tataścauṣadhayaḥ sarvā bhaviṣyaṃti dharātale .. 11 ..
16.165.d:
यज्ञैः संतर्पिता देवा वृष्टिं दास्यंति भूतले ..
ततश्चौषधयः सर्वा भविष्यंति धरातले .. 11 ..
16.165.m: Gratified by sacrifices, the gods will bestow rain upon the earth's surface. / Then all medicinal herbs will come into being on the surface of the earth.

16.165.s:
tasmātsaṃjāyate śukraṃ śukrātsṛṣṭiḥ pravartate ..
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ tato yajñaṃ karomyaham .. 12 ..
16.165.d:
तस्मात्संजायते शुक्रं शुक्रात्सृष्टिः प्रवर्तते ..
सृष्ट्यर्थं सर्वलोकानां ततो यज्ञं करोम्यहम् .. 12 ..
16.165.m: From that, semen is produced; from semen, creation proceeds. / Therefore, for the sake of the creation of all worlds, I shall perform a sacrifice.

16.165.s:
dṛṣṭvā māṃ yajña āsaktaṃ ye ca viprā dharātale ..
te yajñānpracariṣyaṃti śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 13 ..
16.165.d:
दृष्ट्वा मां यज्ञ आसक्तं ये च विप्रा धरातले ..
ते यज्ञान्प्रचरिष्यंति शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 13 ..
16.165.m: Seeing me engaged in sacrifice, whatever brahmins are on the earth's surface / will perform sacrifices by the hundreds and thousands.'

16.165.s:
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā yajñārthaṃ surasuṃdari ..
tīrthaṃ niveśayāmāsa puṣkaraṃ nāma nāmataḥ .. 14 ..
16.165.d:
एवं स निश्चयं कृत्वा यज्ञार्थं सुरसुंदरि ..
तीर्थं निवेशयामास पुष्करं नाम नामतः .. 14 ..
16.165.m: Having made such a resolve for the sake of the sacrifice, O beauty among the gods, / he founded the sacred ford named Puṣkara by name.

16.165.s:
yajñavāṭo mahāṃstatra āsīttasya mahātmanaḥ ..
tatra devarṣayaḥ sarve devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ .. 15 ..
16.165.d:
यज्ञवाटो महांस्तत्र आसीत्तस्य महात्मनः ..
तत्र देवर्षयः सर्वे देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः .. 15 ..
16.165.m: There was a great sacrificial enclosure there for that great-souled one. / There all the divine seers and the gods, headed by Indra,

16.165.s:
samāyātā mahādevi yajñe paitāmahe tadā ..
puṇyāste'pi dvijaśreṣṭhāstatrartvijaḥ prajajñire .. 16 ..
16.165.d:
समायाता महादेवि यज्ञे पैतामहे तदा ..
पुण्यास्तेऽपि द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तत्रर्त्विजः प्रजज्ञिरे .. 16 ..
16.165.m: arrived, O great goddess, at the sacrifice of the Grandfather then. / Those virtuous, best of twice-born also became the officiating priests there.

16.165.s:
sāvitrī lokajananī patnī tasya mahātmanaḥ ..
gṛhakārye samāsaktā dīkṣā kālavyatikramāt ..
adhvaryuṇā samāhūtā sāvitrī vākyamabravīt .. 17 ..
16.165.d:
सावित्री लोकजननी पत्नी तस्य महात्मनः ..
गृहकार्ये समासक्ता दीक्षा कालव्यतिक्रमात् ..
अध्वर्युणा समाहूता सावित्री वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 17 ..
16.165.m: Sāvitrī, the mother of the world and wife of that great-souled one, / was deeply engaged in household duties; because the time for consecration had passed, / summoned by the adhvaryu priest, Sāvitrī spoke [these] words:

16.165.s:
.. sāvitryuvāca .. ..
adyāpi na kṛto veṣo na gṛhe gṛhamaṇḍanam ..
lakṣmīrnādyāpi saṃprāptā na bhavānī na jāhnavī .. 18 ..
16.165.d:
.. सावित्र्युवाच .. ..
अद्यापि न कृतो वेषो न गृहे गृहमण्डनम् ..
लक्ष्मीर्नाद्यापि संप्राप्ता न भवानी न जाह्नवी .. 18 ..
16.165.m: Sāvitrī said: / 'My attire is not yet prepared, nor the adornment of the house in the home; / Lakṣmī has not yet arrived, nor Bhavānī, nor the Ganges;

16.165.s:
na svāhā na svadhā caiva tathā caivāpyaruṃdhatī ..
indrāṇī devapatnyo'nyāḥ kathamekākinī vraje .. 19 ..
16.165.d:
न स्वाहा न स्वधा चैव तथा चैवाप्यरुंधती ..
इन्द्राणी देवपत्न्योऽन्याः कथमेकाकिनी व्रजे .. 19 ..
16.165.m: nor Svāhā, nor Svadhā, nor indeed Arundhatī; / nor Indrāṇī and the other wives of the gods. How can I go alone?'

16.165.s:
uktaḥ pitāmaho gatvā pulastyena mahātmanā ..
sāvitrī deva nāyāti prasaktā gṛhakarmaṇi .. 7.1.165.20 ..
16.165.d:
उक्तः पितामहो गत्वा पुलस्त्येन महात्मना ..
सावित्री देव नायाति प्रसक्ता गृहकर्मणि .. 7.1.165.20 ..
16.165.m: The Grandfather was addressed by the noble Pulastya, who went [to him]: / 'Sāvitrī does not come, O Lord; she is engrossed in domestic chores.

16.165.s:
tvatpatnī kimidaṃ karma phalena saṃpravartate ..
tacchrutvā dīkṣito vācaṃ śikhī muṃḍī mṛgājinī .. 21 ..
16.165.d:
त्वत्पत्नी किमिदं कर्म फलेन संप्रवर्तते ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा दीक्षितो वाचं शिखी मुंडी मृगाजिनी .. 21 ..
16.165.m: [Without] your wife, how can this ritual proceed to its fruit?' / Hearing that speech, the consecrated [Brahmā], with topknot, shaven head, and deer skin,

16.165.s: patnīkopena saṃtaptaḥ prāha devaṃ puraṃdaram .. 22 ..
16.165.d: पत्नीकोपेन संतप्तः प्राह देवं पुरंदरम् .. 22 ..
16.165.m: tormented by anger at his wife, spoke to Lord Purandara:

16.165.s:
gaccha madvacanācchakra patnīmanyāṃ kutaścana ..
gṛhītvā śīghramāgaccha na syātkālātyayo yathā .. 23 ..
16.165.d:
गच्छ मद्वचनाच्छक्र पत्नीमन्यां कुतश्चन ..
गृहीत्वा शीघ्रमागच्छ न स्यात्कालात्ययो यथा .. 23 ..
16.165.m: 'Go, Śakra, at my command, take another wife from anywhere, / and come quickly, so that the time may not be lost.'

16.165.s:
jagāma balahā tūrṇaṃ vacanātparameṣṭhinaḥ ..
apaśyamānaḥ kāṃcitstrīṃ yā yogyā haṃsavāhane .. 24 ..
16.165.d:
जगाम बलहा तूर्णं वचनात्परमेष्ठिनः ..
अपश्यमानः कांचित्स्त्रीं या योग्या हंसवाहने .. 24 ..
16.165.m: The slayer of Bala went quickly at the word of the Supreme Lord, / seeing no woman who was suitable for the swan-mounted [Brahmā].

16.165.s:
atha śāpādbibhītena sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā ..
dṛṣṭā gopālakanyaikā rūpayauvanaśālinī .. 25 ..
16.165.d:
अथ शापाद्बिभीतेन सहस्राक्षेण धीमता ..
दृष्टा गोपालकन्यैका रूपयौवनशालिनी .. 25 ..
16.165.m: Then, terrified of a curse, the wise thousand-eyed [Indra] / saw a cowherd's maiden, endowed with beauty and youth.

16.165.s:
bibhratī tatra pūrṇaṃ sā kumbhaṃ kanyetyacodayat ..
tāṃ gṛhītvā tataḥ śakraḥ samāyādyatra dīkṣitaḥ ..
devadevaścaturvaktro viṣṇurudrasamanvitaḥ .. 26 ..
16.165.d:
बिभ्रती तत्र पूर्णं सा कुम्भं कन्येत्यचोदयत् ..
तां गृहीत्वा ततः शक्रः समायाद्यत्र दीक्षितः ..
देवदेवश्चतुर्वक्त्रो विष्णुरुद्रसमन्वितः .. 26 ..
16.165.m: Carrying a full pitcher there, the maiden was urged on [by him]. / Taking her, Śakra then went to where the consecrated / god of gods, the four-faced [Brahmā], was present along with Viṣṇu and Rudra.

16.165.s: saṃpradānaṃ tu kṛtavānkanyāyā madhusūdanaḥ ..27..
16.165.d: संप्रदानं तु कृतवान्कन्याया मधुसूदनः ..27..
16.165.m: Madhusūdana, however, gave away the maiden [in marriage].

16.165.s:
preritaḥ śaṃkareṇaiva brahmā devarṣibhistathā..
pariṇīyatāṃ tato dīkṣāṃ tasyāścakre yathātmanaḥ ..28 ..
16.165.d:
प्रेरितः शंकरेणैव ब्रह्मा देवर्षिभिस्तथा..
परिणीयतां ततो दीक्षां तस्याश्चक्रे यथात्मनः ..28 ..
16.165.m: Urged by Śaṃkara and likewise by the divine seers, / Brahmā married her and then performed her consecration, just like his own.

16.165.s: tataḥ pravartito yajñaḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ ..29..
16.165.d: ततः प्रवर्तितो यज्ञः सर्वकामसमन्वितः ..29..
16.165.m: Then the sacrifice, accompanied by all desired objects, was set in motion.

16.165.s:
atrirhotārcikastatra pulastyo'dhvaryureva ca..
udgātā'tho marīciśca brahmāhaṃ surapuṃgavaḥ..7.1.165.30..
16.165.d:
अत्रिर्होतार्चिकस्तत्र पुलस्त्योऽध्वर्युरेव च..
उद्गाताऽथो मरीचिश्च ब्रह्माहं सुरपुंगवः..7.1.165.30..
16.165.m: There Atri was the hotṛ, chanting the ṛcs; Pulastya was the adhvaryu; / Marīci was the udgātṛ; and I, the foremost of the gods, was the brahmā.

16.165.s:
sanatkumārapramukhāḥ sadasyāstasya nirmitāḥ..
vastrairābharaṇairyuktā mukuṭairaṃgulīyakaiḥ .. 31 ..
16.165.d:
सनत्कुमारप्रमुखाः सदस्यास्तस्य निर्मिताः..
वस्त्रैराभरणैर्युक्ता मुकुटैरंगुलीयकैः .. 31 ..
16.165.m: Those headed by Sanatkumāra were appointed as members of his assembly, / adorned with garments and ornaments, with diadems and rings.

16.165.s:
bhūṣitā bhūṣaṇopetā ekaikasya pṛthakpṛthak ..
trayastrayaḥ pṛṣṭhato'nye te caivaṃ ṣoḍaśartvijaḥ ..32..
16.165.d:
भूषिता भूषणोपेता एकैकस्य पृथक्पृथक् ..
त्रयस्त्रयः पृष्ठतोऽन्ये ते चैवं षोडशर्त्विजः ..32..
16.165.m: Adorned and provided with ornaments, three others stood separately / behind each of them; and in this way there were sixteen officiating priests.

16.165.s:
proktā bhavadbhi ryajñe'sminnanugṛhyo'smi sarvadā ..
patnī mameyaṃ gāyatrī yajñe'sminnanugṛhyatām .. 33 ..
16.165.d:
प्रोक्ता भवद्भि र्यज्ञेऽस्मिन्ननुगृह्योऽस्मि सर्वदा ..
पत्नी ममेयं गायत्री यज्ञेऽस्मिन्ननुगृह्यताम् .. 33 ..
16.165.m: "You have declared: 'I must always be favored in this sacrifice.' / May this Gāyatrī, my wife, be favored in this sacrifice!"

16.165.s:
mṛduvastradharāṃ sākṣātkṣaumavastrāvaguṇṭhitām ..
niṣkramya patnīśālāta ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ .. 34 ..
16.165.d:
मृदुवस्त्रधरां साक्षात्क्षौमवस्त्रावगुण्ठिताम् ..
निष्क्रम्य पत्नीशालात ऋत्विग्भिर्वेदपारगैः .. 34 ..
16.165.m: [With her] who wore soft garments and was visibly veiled in a linen cloth, / Brahmā, having emerged from the wife's chamber, accompanied by the officiating priests who had mastered the Vedas,

16.165.s:
audumbareṇa daṇḍena saṃvṛto mṛgacarmaṇā ..
tayā sārdhaṃ praviṣṭaśca brahmā taṃ yajñamaṇḍapam ..35..
16.165.d:
औदुम्बरेण दण्डेन संवृतो मृगचर्मणा ..
तया सार्धं प्रविष्टश्च ब्रह्मा तं यज्ञमण्डपम् ..35..
16.165.m: [and] equipped with an udumbara staff and covered with a deer skin, / entered the sacrificial pavilion together with her.

16.165.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
etasminneva kāle tu saṃprāptā devayoṣitaḥ ..
saṃprāptā yatra sāvitrī yajñe tasminnimaṃtritāḥ .. 36 ..
16.165.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु संप्राप्ता देवयोषितः ..
संप्राप्ता यत्र सावित्री यज्ञे तस्मिन्निमंत्रिताः .. 36 ..
16.165.m: Īśvara said: / At that very time, the wives of the gods arrived, / coming to the sacrifice to which they had been invited, where Sāvitrī was.

16.165.s:
bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannā viṣṇupatnī yaśasvinī ..
āmantritā sā lakṣmīśca tatrāyātā tvarānvitā .. 37 ..
16.165.d:
भृगोः ख्यात्यां समुत्पन्ना विष्णुपत्नी यशस्विनी ..
आमन्त्रिता सा लक्ष्मीश्च तत्रायाता त्वरान्विता .. 37 ..
16.165.m: Viṣṇu's glorious wife, born from Khyāti to Bhṛgu, / that Lakṣmī, having been invited, arrived there with haste.

16.165.s:
tatra devī mahābhāgā yoganidrādibhūṣitā ..
devī kāṃtistathā śraddhā dyutistuṣṭistathaiva ca .. 38 ..
16.165.d:
तत्र देवी महाभागा योगनिद्रादिभूषिता ..
देवी कांतिस्तथा श्रद्धा द्युतिस्तुष्टिस्तथैव च .. 38 ..
16.165.m: There [arrived] the fortunate goddess adorned with Yoganidrā and the rest, / the goddess Kānti, as well as Śraddhā, Dyuti, and Tuṣṭi,

16.165.s:
satī yā dakṣatanayā umā yā pārvatī śubhā ..
trailokyasundarī devī strīṇāṃ saubhāgyadāyakā ..39..
16.165.d:
सती या दक्षतनया उमा या पार्वती शुभा ..
त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी देवी स्त्रीणां सौभाग्यदायका ..39..
16.165.m: Satī, who is the daughter of Dakṣa, and auspicious Umā, who is Pārvatī, / the goddess who is the beauty of the three worlds, bestowing good fortune on women,

16.165.s:
jayā ca vijayā caiva gaurī caiva mahādhanā ..
manojavā vāyupatnī ṛddhiśca dhanadapriyā .. 7.1.165.40 ..
16.165.d:
जया च विजया चैव गौरी चैव महाधना ..
मनोजवा वायुपत्नी ऋद्धिश्च धनदप्रिया .. 7.1.165.40 ..
16.165.m: Jayā and Vijayā, highly opulent Gaurī, / Manojavā the wife of Vāyu, and Ṛddhi the beloved of the giver of wealth [Kubera].

16.165.s:
devakanyāstathā''yātā dānavyo danuvaṃśajāḥ ..
saptarṣīṇāṃ tathā patnya ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca .. 41 ..
16.165.d:
देवकन्यास्तथा'ऽयाता दानव्यो दनुवंशजाः ..
सप्तर्षीणां तथा पत्न्य ऋषीणां च तथैव च .. 41 ..
16.165.m: Likewise arrived the daughters of the gods, the Dānavī women born of Danu's lineage, / and the wives of the seven seers, and of the [other] seers as well,

16.165.s:
plavā mitrā duhitaro vidyādharagaṇāstathā ..
pitaro rakṣasāṃ kanyāstathā'nyā lokamātaraḥ .. 42 ..
16.165.d:
प्लवा मित्रा दुहितरो विद्याधरगणास्तथा ..
पितरो रक्षसां कन्यास्तथाऽन्या लोकमातरः .. 42 ..
16.165.m: Plavā, Mitrā, the daughters, and the Vidyādhara troops, / the Pitṛs, the daughters of the Rakṣases, and other mothers of the worlds.

16.165.s:
vadhūbhiścaiva mukhyābhiḥ sāvitrī gantumicchati ..
adityādyāstathā devyo dakṣakanyāḥ samāgatāḥ .. 43 ..
16.165.d:
वधूभिश्चैव मुख्याभिः सावित्री गन्तुमिच्छति ..
अदित्याद्यास्तथा देव्यो दक्षकन्याः समागताः .. 43 ..
16.165.m: Along with the principal wives, Sāvitrī wished to go. / The goddesses beginning with Aditi, daughters of Dakṣa, assembled.

16.165.s:
tābhiḥ parivṛtā sārdhaṃ brahmāṇī kamalālayā ..
kāścinmodakamādāya kāścitpūpaṃ varānane .. 44 ..
16.165.d:
ताभिः परिवृता सार्धं ब्रह्माणी कमलालया ..
काश्चिन्मोदकमादाय काश्चित्पूपं वरानने .. 44 ..
16.165.m: Surrounded by them, Brahmāṇī, whose abode is the lotus, / some taking sweetmeats, some cakes, O fair-faced one,

16.165.s:
phalāni tu samādāya prayātā brahmaṇo'ntikam ..
āḍhakīścaiva niṣpāvānrājamāṣāṃstathā'parāḥ .. 45 ..
16.165.d:
फलानि तु समादाय प्रयाता ब्रह्मणोऽन्तिकम् ..
आढकीश्चैव निष्पावान्राजमाषांस्तथाऽपराः .. 45 ..
16.165.m: taking fruits, departed for the presence of Brahmā; / others took pigeon peas, white beans, and cowpeas;

16.165.s:
dāḍimāni vicitrāṇi mātuliṃgāni śobhane..
karīrāṇi tathā cānyā gṛhītvā karamardakān..46..
16.165.d:
दाडिमानि विचित्राणि मातुलिंगानि शोभने..
करीराणि तथा चान्या गृहीत्वा करमर्दकान्..46..
16.165.m: diverse pomegranates and citrons, O beautiful one; / while others took shoots of caper and karamarda berries;

16.165.s:
kausuṃbhaṃ jīrakaṃ caiva kharjūraṃ cāparāstathā..
utatīścāparā gṛhya nālikerāṇi cāparāḥ..47..
16.165.d:
कौसुंभं जीरकं चैव खर्जूरं चापरास्तथा..
उततीश्चापरा गृह्य नालिकेराणि चापराः..47..
16.165.m: and others saffron, cumin seeds, and dates; / others took raisins, and others coconuts;

16.165.s:
drākṣayā pūritaṃ cāmraṃ śṛṅgārāya yathā purā..
karburāṇi vicitrāṇi jaṃbūkāni śubhāni ca..48..
16.165.d:
द्राक्षया पूरितं चाम्रं शृङ्गाराय यथा पुरा..
कर्बुराणि विचित्राणि जंबूकानि शुभानि च..48..
16.165.m: a mango stuffed with grapes for ornamentation as in former times; / variegated kerba plums and auspicious rose-apples;

16.165.s:
akṣoḍāmalakāngṛhya jaṃbīrāṇi tathā parāḥ ..
bilvāni paripakvāni cirbhaṭāni varānane .. 49 ..
16.165.d:
अक्षोडामलकान्गृह्य जंबीराणि तथा पराः ..
बिल्वानि परिपक्वानि चिर्भटानि वरानने .. 49 ..
16.165.m: others took walnuts, myrobalans, and limes; / fully ripe bilvas and cucumbers, O fair-faced one;

16.165.s:
annapānādhikārāṇi bahūni vividhāni ca ..
śarkarāputtalīṃ cānyā vastre kausumbhake tathā .. 7.1.165.50 ..
16.165.d:
अन्नपानाधिकाराणि बहूनि विविधानि च ..
शर्करापुत्तलीं चान्या वस्त्रे कौसुम्भके तथा .. 7.1.165.50 ..
16.165.m: many diverse things suitable for food and drink; / and others brought dolls of sugar, wrapped in saffron-dyed cloth.

16.165.s:
evamādīni cānyāni gṛhya pūrve varānane ..
sāvitryā sahitāḥ sarvāḥ saṃprāptāstu tadā śubhāḥ .. 51 ..
16.165.d:
एवमादीनि चान्यानि गृह्य पूर्वे वरानने ..
सावित्र्या सहिताः सर्वाः संप्राप्तास्तु तदा शुभाः .. 51 ..
16.165.m: Taking these and other things as before, O fair-faced one, / all those auspicious women, accompanied by Sāvitrī, then arrived.

16.165.s:
sāvitrīmāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītastatra puraṃdaraḥ ..
adhomukhaḥ sthito brahmā kimeṣā māṃ vadiṣyati .. 52 ..
16.165.d:
सावित्रीमागतां दृष्ट्वा भीतस्तत्र पुरंदरः ..
अधोमुखः स्थितो ब्रह्मा किमेषा मां वदिष्यति .. 52 ..
16.165.m: Seeing Sāvitrī arrive, Puraṃdara became afraid. / Brahmā stood with his head bowed, thinking: "What will she say to me?"

16.165.s:
trapānvitau viṣṇurudrau sarve cānye dvijātayaḥ ..
sabhāsadastathā bhītāstathaivānye divaukasaḥ .. 53 ..
16.165.d:
त्रपान्वितौ विष्णुरुद्रौ सर्वे चान्ये द्विजातयः ..
सभासदस्तथा भीतास्तथैवान्ये दिवौकसः .. 53 ..
16.165.m: Viṣṇu and Rudra were filled with shame, as were all the other twice-born. / The members of the assembly became afraid, as did the other dwellers of heaven,

16.165.s:
putrapautrā bhāgineyā mātulā bhrātarastathā ..
ṛtavo nāma ye devā devānāmapi devatāḥ .. 54 ..
16.165.d:
पुत्रपौत्रा भागिनेया मातुला भ्रातरस्तथा ..
ऋतवो नाम ये देवा देवानामपि देवताः .. 54 ..
16.165.m: sons, grandsons, nephews, maternal uncles, and brothers, / and the gods called Ṛtus, who are the deities even of the gods.

16.165.s:
vilakṣāstu tathā sarve sāvitrī kiṃ vadiṣyati ..
brahmavākyāni vācyāni kiṃ nu vai gopakanyayā .. .. 55 ..
16.165.d:
विलक्षास्तु तथा सर्वे सावित्री किं वदिष्यति ..
ब्रह्मवाक्यानि वाच्यानि किं नु वै गोपकन्यया .. .. 55 ..
16.165.m: They were all embarrassed, wondering: "What will Sāvitrī say? / Can the sacred words of Brahmā indeed be recited with a cowherd's daughter?"

16.165.s:
maunībhūtāstu śṛṇvānāḥ sarveṣāṃ vadatāṃ giraḥ ..
adhvaryuṇā samāhūtā nāgatā varavarṇinī .. 56 ..
16.165.d:
मौनीभूतास्तु शृण्वानाः सर्वेषां वदतां गिरः ..
अध्वर्युणा समाहूता नागता वरवर्णिनी .. 56 ..
16.165.m: Becoming silent, they listened to the voices of all who spoke: / "Summoned by the adhvaryu, the fair-complexioned lady did not come.

16.165.s:
śakreṇānyā tathā''nītā dattā sā viṣṇunā svayam ..
anumoditā ca rudreṇa pitrā dattā svayaṃ tathā .. 57 ..
16.165.d:
शक्रेणान्या तथा'ऽनीता दत्ता सा विष्णुना स्वयम् ..
अनुमोदिता च रुद्रेण पित्रा दत्ता स्वयं तथा .. 57 ..
16.165.m: Another was brought by Śakra, given away by Viṣṇu himself, / approved by Rudra, and likewise given by her father himself.

16.165.s:
kathaṃ sā bhavitā yajñaḥ samāptiṃ vā kathaṃ vrajet ..
evaṃ cintayatāṃ teṣāṃ praviṣṭā kamalālayā .. 58 ..
16.165.d:
कथं सा भविता यज्ञः समाप्तिं वा कथं व्रजेत् ..
एवं चिन्तयतां तेषां प्रविष्टा कमलालया .. 58 ..
16.165.m: How will that be? Or how can the sacrifice reach completion?" / While they were reflecting thus, she whose abode is the lotus entered.

16.165.s:
vṛto brahmā bhāryayā sa ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ ..
hūyante cāgnayastatra brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ .. 59 ..
16.165.d:
वृतो ब्रह्मा भार्यया स ऋत्विग्भिर्वेदपारगैः ..
हूयन्ते चाग्नयस्तत्र ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः .. 59 ..
16.165.m: Brahmā was surrounded by his wife and by the officiating priests who had mastered the Vedas, / and the fires were offered into there by the brahmins who had mastered the Vedas.

16.165.s:
patnīśāle tathā gopī raupyaśṛṃgā samekhalā ..
kṣaumavastraparīdhānā dhyāyantī parameśvaram .. 7.1.165.60 ..
16.165.d:
पत्नीशाले तथा गोपी रौप्यशृंगा समेखला ..
क्षौमवस्त्रपरीधाना ध्यायन्ती परमेश्वरम् .. 7.1.165.60 ..
16.165.m: So too in the wife's chamber, the cowherd girl, wearing silver horns and a girdle, / dressed in linen garments, meditating on the Supreme Lord,

16.165.s:
pativratā patiprāṇā prādhānyena niveśitā ..
kṛpānvitā viśālākṣī tejasā bhāskaropamā .. 61 ..
16.165.d:
पतिव्रता पतिप्राणा प्राधान्येन निवेशिता ..
कृपान्विता विशालाक्षी तेजसा भास्करोपमा .. 61 ..
16.165.m: devoted to her husband, holding her husband as her life-breath, was seated in the place of honor, / compassionate, large-eyed, resembling the sun in splendor,

16.165.s:
dyotayaṃtī sadastatra sūryasyeva yathā prabhā ..
jvalamānastathā vahnirbhramaṃte cartvijastathā .. 62 ..
16.165.d:
द्योतयंती सदस्तत्र सूर्यस्येव यथा प्रभा ..
ज्वलमानस्तथा वह्निर्भ्रमंते चर्त्विजस्तथा .. 62 ..
16.165.m: illuminating the assembly there like the radiance of the sun. / The fire was blazing, and the officiating priests moved about.

16.165.s:
paśūnāmavadānāni gṛhṇaṃti dvijasattamāḥ ..
prāptā bhāgārthino devā vilaṃbasamayo'bhavat .. 63 ..
16.165.d:
पशूनामवदानानि गृह्णंति द्विजसत्तमाः ..
प्राप्ता भागार्थिनो देवा विलंबसमयोऽभवत् .. 63 ..
16.165.m: The best of the twice-born took the sacrificial portions of the victims. / The gods desiring their shares arrived; it had become a time of delay.

16.165.s:
kālahīnaṃ na kartavyaṃ kṛtaṃ na phaladaṃ bhavet ..
vedeṣvayamadhīkāro dṛṣṭaḥ sarvo manīṣibhiḥ .. 64 ..
16.165.d:
कालहीनं न कर्तव्यं कृतं न फलदं भवेत् ..
वेदेष्वयमधीकारो दृष्टः सर्वो मनीषिभिः .. 64 ..
16.165.m: "A rite must not be performed out of time; done [so], it bears no fruit." / This rule in the Vedas has been observed by all wise men.

16.165.s:
pravargye kriyamāṇe tu brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ ..
kṣīradvaye hūyamāne maṃtreṇādhvaryuṇā tathā .. 65 ..
16.165.d:
प्रवर्ग्ये क्रियमाणे तु ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः ..
क्षीरद्वये हूयमाने मंत्रेणाध्वर्युणा तथा .. 65 ..
16.165.m: While the pravargya rite was being performed by the brahmins who had mastered the Vedas, / and two offerings of milk were being poured with mantras by the adhvaryu,

16.165.s:
upahūtopahūtena āgateṣu dvijanmasu ..
kriyamāṇe tathā bhakṣye dṛṣṭvā devī krudhānvitā ..
uvāca devī brahmāṇaṃ sadomadhye tu mauninam .. 66 ..
16.165.d:
उपहूतोपहूतेन आगतेषु द्विजन्मसु ..
क्रियमाणे तथा भक्ष्ये दृष्ट्वा देवी क्रुधान्विता ..
उवाच देवी ब्रह्माणं सदोमध्ये तु मौनिनम् .. 66 ..
16.165.m: as the twice-born came when summoned by the call to eat, / and while the food was being prepared, the goddess, seeing this and filled with anger, / said to Brahmā, who stood silent in the midst of the assembly:

16.165.s:
kimevaṃ budhyate deva kṛtametadviceṣṭitam ..
māṃ parityajya yaḥ kāmātkṛtavānasi kilbiṣam .. 67 ..
16.165.d:
किमेवं बुध्यते देव कृतमेतद्विचेष्टितम् ..
मां परित्यज्य यः कामात्कृतवानसि किल्बिषम् .. 67 ..
16.165.m: "O lord, how is this action that has been done understood? / Abandoning me, you have committed an offense out of lust!

16.165.s: na tulyā pādarajasā samā sā'dhiśiraḥ kṛtā .. 68 ..
16.165.d: न तुल्या पादरजसा समा साऽधिशिरः कृता .. 68 ..
16.165.m: She who is not equal to the dust of my feet has been placed over [my] head!

16.165.s:
yadvadaṃti narāḥ sarve saṃgatāḥ sadasi sthitāḥ ..
āścaryaṃ ca prabhūṇāṃ tu kurute yaṃ yamicchati .. 69 ..
16.165.d:
यद्वदंति नराः सर्वे संगताः सदसि स्थिताः ..
आश्चर्यं च प्रभूणां तु कुरुते यं यमिच्छति .. 69 ..
16.165.m: As all men assembled and seated in the assembly say: / 'Astonishing is the power of the mighty: they do whatever they wish!'

16.165.s: bhavatā rūpalobhena kṛtaṃ karma vigarhitam .. 7.1.165.70 ..
16.165.d: भवता रूपलोभेन कृतं कर्म विगर्हितम् .. 7.1.165.70 ..
16.165.m: Out of longing for beauty, you have done a contemptible deed!"

16.165.s:
na putreṣu kṛtā lajjā pautreṣu ca na te vibho ..
kāmakārakṛtaṃ manye hyetatkarma vigarhitam .. 71 ..
16.165.d:
न पुत्रेषु कृता लज्जा पौत्रेषु च न ते विभो ..
कामकारकृतं मन्ये ह्येतत्कर्म विगर्हितम् .. 71 ..
16.165.m: You felt no shame before your sons, nor before your grandsons, O all-pervading lord. / I consider this contemptible deed to have been done out of lust.

16.165.s:
pitāmaho'si devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ prapitāmahaḥ ..
kathaṃ na te trapā jātā ātmanaḥ paśyatastanum .. 72 ..
16.165.d:
पितामहोऽसि देवानामृषीणां प्रपितामहः ..
कथं न ते त्रपा जाता आत्मनः पश्यतस्तनुम् .. 72 ..
16.165.m: You are the grandfather of the gods, the great-grandfather of the seers; / how did you feel no shame looking upon your own form?

16.165.s:
lokamadhye kṛtaṃ hāsyamiha caiva vigarhitaḥ ..
yadyeṣa te sthito bhāvastiṣṭha deva namo'stu te ..73..
16.165.d:
लोकमध्ये कृतं हास्यमिह चैव विगर्हितः ..
यद्येष ते स्थितो भावस्तिष्ठ देव नमोऽस्तु ते ..73..
16.165.m: A laughingstock has been made [of you] in the world, and you are condemned here. / If such is your intention, remain [here], O god; reverence be to you!

16.165.s:
ahaṃ kathaṃ sakhīnāṃ tu darśayiṣyāmi vai mukham ..
bhartrā me vihitā patnī kathametadahaṃ vade .. 74 ..
16.165.d:
अहं कथं सखीनां तु दर्शयिष्यामि वै मुखम् ..
भर्त्रा मे विहिता पत्नी कथमेतदहं वदे .. 74 ..
16.165.m: How indeed shall I show my face to my companions? / How shall I say this: 'Another wife has been taken by my husband'?

16.165.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
ṛtvigbhirahamājñapto dīkṣā kālo'tivartate ..
patnīṃ vinā na homotra śīghraṃ patnīmihānaya .. 75 ..
16.165.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
ऋत्विग्भिरहमाज्ञप्तो दीक्षा कालोऽतिवर्तते ..
पत्नीं विना न होमोत्र शीघ्रं पत्नीमिहानय .. 75 ..
16.165.m: Brahmā said: / I was instructed by the officiating priests: 'The time for consecration is passing away; / without a wife, no oblation can be made here; bring a wife here at once.'

16.165.s:
śakreṇaiṣā samānītā dattā caivā'tha viṣṇunā ..
gṛhītā ca mayā tvaṃ hi kṣamasvaikaṃ mayā kṛtam ..
na cāparādhyaṃ bhūyo'nyaṃ kariṣye tava suvrate .. 76 ..
16.165.d:
शक्रेणैषा समानीता दत्ता चैवाऽथ विष्णुना ..
गृहीता च मया त्वं हि क्षमस्वैकं मया कृतम् ..
न चापराध्यं भूयोऽन्यं करिष्ये तव सुव्रते .. 76 ..
16.165.m: She was brought by Śakra, and she was given by Viṣṇu, / and accepted by me. Forgive this one [fault] committed by me; / and I shall not commit another offense against you, O lady of virtuous vows!

16.165.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evamuktā tadā kruddhā brahmāṇaṃ śaptumudyatā..
yadi me'sti tapastaptaṃ guravo yadi toṣitāḥ .. 77 ..
16.165.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ता तदा क्रुद्धा ब्रह्माणं शप्तुमुद्यता..
यदि मेऽस्ति तपस्तप्तं गुरवो यदि तोषिताः .. 77 ..
16.165.m: Īśvara said: / Addressed thus, she, enraged, prepared to curse Brahmā: / 'If I have performed austerity, if the elders have been pleased,

16.165.s:
sarvabrāhmaṇaśālāsu sthāneṣu vividheṣvapi ..
na tu te brāhmaṇāḥ pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti kadācana .. .. 78 ..
16.165.d:
सर्वब्राह्मणशालासु स्थानेषु विविधेष्वपि ..
न तु ते ब्राह्मणाः पूजां करिष्यंति कदाचन .. .. 78 ..
16.165.m: in all the halls of the brahmins and in various places, / brahmins shall never perform worship to you,

16.165.s:
ṛte vai kārtikīmekāṃ pūjāṃ sāṃvatsarīṃ tava ..
kariṣyaṃti dvijāḥ sarve satyenānena te śape ..
etadbuddhvā na kopostu hato hanti na saṃśayaḥ .. .. 79 ..
16.165.d:
ऋते वै कार्तिकीमेकां पूजां सांवत्सरीं तव ..
करिष्यंति द्विजाः सर्वे सत्येनानेन ते शपे ..
एतद्बुद्ध्वा न कोपोस्तु हतो हन्ति न संशयः .. .. 79 ..
16.165.m: except for one annual worship of yours on the full moon of Kārttika, / which all the twice-born shall perform; by this truth I curse you! / Knowing this, let there be no anger; one who is struck strikes back, without doubt.'

16.165.s:
.. sāvitryuvāca .. ..
bhobhoḥ śakra tvayānītā ābhīrī brahmaṇo'ntikam ..
yasmādīdṛkkṛtaṃ karma tasmāttvaṃ lapsyase phalam ..7.1.165.80..
16.165.d:
.. सावित्र्युवाच .. ..
भोभोः शक्र त्वयानीता आभीरी ब्रह्मणोऽन्तिकम् ..
यस्मादीदृक्कृतं कर्म तस्मात्त्वं लप्स्यसे फलम् ..7.1.165.80..
16.165.m: Sāvitrī said: / O Śakra, an Ābhīra woman was brought by you into the presence of Brahmā; / because such an act was done [by you], therefore you shall reap the fruit.

16.165.s:
yadā saṃgrāmamadhye tvaṃ sthātā śakra bhaviṣyasi ..
tadā tvaṃ śatrubhirbaddho nītaḥ paramikāṃ daśām .. 81 ..
16.165.d:
यदा संग्राममध्ये त्वं स्थाता शक्र भविष्यसि ..
तदा त्वं शत्रुभिर्बद्धो नीतः परमिकां दशाम् .. 81 ..
16.165.m: When you stand in the midst of battle, O Śakra, / then, bound by enemies, you will be reduced to the most dire state.

16.165.s:
akiṃcano naṣṭasutaḥ śatrūṇāṃ nagare sthitaḥ..
parābhavaṃ mahatprāpya acirādeva mokṣyase .. 82 ..
16.165.d:
अकिंचनो नष्टसुतः शत्रूणां नगरे स्थितः..
पराभवं महत्प्राप्य अचिरादेव मोक्ष्यसे .. 82 ..
16.165.m: Destitute, your son lost, residing in the city of your enemies, / having suffered great humiliation, only after a long time will you be released.

16.165.s: śakraṃ śaptvā tadā devī viṣṇuṃ cā'tha vacobravīt .. 83 ..
16.165.d: शक्रं शप्त्वा तदा देवी विष्णुं चाऽथ वचोब्रवीत् .. 83 ..
16.165.m: Having cursed Śakra, the goddess then spoke these words to Viṣṇu:

16.165.s:
guruvākyena te janma yadā martye bhavi ṣyati ..
bhāryāvirahajaṃ duḥkhaṃ tadā tvaṃ tatra bhokṣyase .. 84 ..
16.165.d:
गुरुवाक्येन ते जन्म यदा मर्त्ये भवि ष्यति ..
भार्याविरहजं दुःखं तदा त्वं तत्र भोक्ष्यसे .. 84 ..
16.165.m: When your birth among mortals shall take place due to the curse of a guru, / then you will experience the sorrow born of separation from your wife.

16.165.s:
hṛtāṃ śatrugaṇaiḥ patnīṃ pare pāre mahodadheḥ ..
na ca tvaṃ jñāyase sītāṃ śokopahacetanaḥ .. 85 ..
16.165.d:
हृतां शत्रुगणैः पत्नीं परे पारे महोदधेः ..
न च त्वं ज्ञायसे सीतां शोकोपहचेतनः .. 85 ..
16.165.m: With your wife abducted by hosts of enemies to the far shore of the great ocean, / you will not know Sītā, your mind overcome by grief.

16.165.s:
bhrātrā saha parāṃ kāṣṭhāmāpadaṃ duḥkhitastathā ..
paśūnāṃ caiva saṃyogaścirakālaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 86 ..
16.165.d:
भ्रात्रा सह परां काष्ठामापदं दुःखितस्तथा ..
पशूनां चैव संयोगश्चिरकालं भविष्यति .. 86 ..
16.165.m: Afflicted by sorrow, you will face the utmost extremity of misfortune together with your brother, / and your association with beasts will last for a long time.

16.165.s:
tathā''ha rudraṃ kupitā yadā dāruvane sthitaḥ ..
tadā te munayaḥ kruddhāḥ śāpaṃ dāsyaṃti te hara .. 87 ..
16.165.d:
तथा'ऽह रुद्रं कुपिता यदा दारुवने स्थितः ..
तदा ते मुनयः क्रुद्धाः शापं दास्यंति ते हर .. 87 ..
16.165.m: Likewise she, enraged, spoke to Rudra: 'When you are staying in the pine forest, / then the enraged sages will utter a curse upon you, O Hara:

16.165.s:
bhobhoḥ kāpālika kṣudra patnyo'smākaṃ jihīrṣasi ..
tadetadbhūṣitaṃ liṃga bhūmau rudra patiṣyati .. 88 ..
16.165.d:
भोभोः कापालिक क्षुद्र पत्न्योऽस्माकं जिहीर्षसि ..
तदेतद्भूषितं लिंग भूमौ रुद्र पतिष्यति .. 88 ..
16.165.m: "O vile Kāpālika, you wish to ravish our wives! / Therefore this adorned liṅga of yours shall fall to the ground, O Rudra!"

16.165.s:
vihīnaḥ pauruṣeṇa tvaṃ muniśāpācca pīḍitaḥ ..
gaṃgātīre sthitā patnī sā tvāmāśvāsayiṣyati .. 89 ..
16.165.d:
विहीनः पौरुषेण त्वं मुनिशापाच्च पीडितः ..
गंगातीरे स्थिता पत्नी सा त्वामाश्वासयिष्यति .. 89 ..
16.165.m: Deprived of virility and tormented by the curse of the sages, / your wife, standing on the bank of the Gaṅgā, will comfort you.'

16.165.s:
agne tvaṃ sarvabhakṣo'si pūrvaṃ putreṇa me kṛtaḥ ..
bhrūṇahā dharma ityeṣa kathaṃ dagdhaṃ dahāmyaham .. 7.1.165.90 ..
16.165.d:
अग्ने त्वं सर्वभक्षोऽसि पूर्वं पुत्रेण मे कृतः ..
भ्रूणहा धर्म इत्येष कथं दग्धं दहाम्यहम् .. 7.1.165.90 ..
16.165.m: 'O Agni, you were previously made an eater of everything by my son; / [thinking,] "The killer of an embryo is righteousness: how can I burn what is already burnt?",

16.165.s:
jātavedasa rudrastvāṃ retasā plāvayiṣyati ..
medhyeṣu ca kṛtajvālā jvālayā tvāṃ jvaliṣyati .. 91 ..
16.165.d:
जातवेदस रुद्रस्त्वां रेतसा प्लावयिष्यति ..
मेध्येषु च कृतज्वाला ज्वालया त्वां ज्वलिष्यति .. 91 ..
16.165.m: O Jātavedas, Rudra will flood you with his semen, / and a flame ignited among sacrificial offerings will burn you with its blaze.'

16.165.s: brāhmaṇānṛtvijaḥ sarvānsāvitrī hyaśapattadā .. 92 ..
16.165.d: ब्राह्मणानृत्विजः सर्वान्सावित्री ह्यशपत्तदा .. 92 ..
16.165.m: Then Sāvitrī cursed all the brahmins who were officiating priests:

16.165.s:
pratigrahāgnihotrāśca vṛthā dārā vṛthāśramāḥ ..
sadā kṣetrāṇi tīrthāni lobhādeva gamiṣyatha .. 93 ..
16.165.d:
प्रतिग्रहाग्निहोत्राश्च वृथा दारा वृथाश्रमाः ..
सदा क्षेत्राणि तीर्थानि लोभादेव गमिष्यथ .. 93 ..
16.165.m: 'Your receiving of gifts and your Agnihotra fires will be in vain, your wives in vain, your efforts in vain. / You will constantly wander to sacred fields and sacred fords purely out of greed.

16.165.s:
parānneṣu sadā tṛptā atṛptāḥ svagṛheṣu ca ..
ayājyayājanaṃ kṛtvā kutsitasya pratigraham .. 94 ..
16.165.d:
परान्नेषु सदा तृप्ता अतृप्ताः स्वगृहेषु च ..
अयाज्ययाजनं कृत्वा कुत्सितस्य प्रतिग्रहम् .. 94 ..
16.165.m: You will always be satisfied with food from others, and never satisfied in your own homes. / Having performed sacrifices for those unfit to sacrifice, and having accepted gifts from the despicable,

16.165.s:
vṛthā dhanārjanaṃ kṛtvā vyavaścaiva tathā vṛthā ..
mṛtānāṃ tena pretatvaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 95 ..
16.165.d:
वृथा धनार्जनं कृत्वा व्यवश्चैव तथा वृथा ..
मृतानां तेन प्रेतत्वं भविष्यति न संशयः .. 95 ..
16.165.m: having acquired wealth in vain, and your expenditure also being in vain, / when dead, you will become hungry ghosts on that account, without doubt.'

16.165.s:
evaṃ śakraṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ vai pāvakaṃ tathā ..
brahmāṇaṃ brāhmaṇāṃścaiva sarvāṃstānaśapattadā .. 96 ..
16.165.d:
एवं शक्रं तथा विष्णुं रुद्रं वै पावकं तथा ..
ब्रह्माणं ब्राह्मणांश्चैव सर्वांस्तानशपत्तदा .. 96 ..
16.165.m: Thus she cursed Śakra, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and Pāvaka, / as well as Brahmā and all those brahmins at that time.

16.165.s: śāpaṃ dattvā tathā teṣāṃ tadā sāvasthitā sthirā .. 97 ..
16.165.d: शापं दत्त्वा तथा तेषां तदा सावस्थिता स्थिरा .. 97 ..
16.165.m: Having pronounced the curse upon them, she then stood firm.

16.165.s:
lakṣmīḥ prāha sakhīṃ tāṃ ca indrāṇī ca varānanā ..
anyā devyastathā prāhuḥ sā''ha sthāsyāmi nātra vai ..
tatra cāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi yatra śroṣye na tu dhvanim .. 98 ..
16.165.d:
लक्ष्मीः प्राह सखीं तां च इन्द्राणी च वरानना ..
अन्या देव्यस्तथा प्राहुः सा'ऽह स्थास्यामि नात्र वै ..
तत्र चाहं गमिष्यामि यत्र श्रोष्ये न तु ध्वनिम् .. 98 ..
16.165.m: Lakṣmī, lovely-faced Indrāṇī, and the other goddesses said to that friend: / 'I shall not stay here; / I shall go there where I will not hear the noise.'

16.165.s:
tatastāḥ pramadāḥ sarvāḥ prayātāḥ svaṃ niketanam ..
sāvitrī kupitā tāsāṃ punaḥ śāpāya codyatā .. 99 ..
16.165.d:
ततस्ताः प्रमदाः सर्वाः प्रयाताः स्वं निकेतनम् ..
सावित्री कुपिता तासां पुनः शापाय चोद्यता .. 99 ..
16.165.m: Then all those women departed to their own abodes. / Enraged at them, Sāvitrī prepared to curse them again:

16.165.s:
yasmānmāṃ saṃparityajya gatāstā devayoṣitaḥ ..
tāsāmapi tathā śāpaṃ pradāsye kupitā bhṛśam .. 7.1.165.100 ..
16.165.d:
यस्मान्मां संपरित्यज्य गतास्ता देवयोषितः ..
तासामपि तथा शापं प्रदास्ये कुपिता भृशम् .. 7.1.165.100 ..
16.165.m: 'Because those wives of the gods have gone away, abandoning me, / exceedingly enraged, I shall pronounce a curse upon them as well.

16.165.s:
naikatra vāso lakṣmyāstu bhaviṣyati kadācana ..
rudrāpi caṃcalā tāvanmūrkheṣu ca vasiṣyasi .. 101 ..
16.165.d:
नैकत्र वासो लक्ष्म्यास्तु भविष्यति कदाचन ..
रुद्रापि चंचला तावन्मूर्खेषु च वसिष्यसि .. 101 ..
16.165.m: Lakṣmī shall never have an abode in one single place; / even if restrained, you will be fickle, and you will dwell among fools,

16.165.s:
mleccheṣu parvatīyeṣu kutsite kuṣṭhite tathā ..
vācāṭe cāvalipte ca abhiśaste durātmani ..
evaṃvidhe nare tubhyaṃ vasatiḥ śāpakāritā .. 102 ..
16.165.d:
म्लेच्छेषु पर्वतीयेषु कुत्सिते कुष्ठिते तथा ..
वाचाटे चावलिप्ते च अभिशस्ते दुरात्मनि ..
एवंविधे नरे तुभ्यं वसतिः शापकारिता .. 102 ..
16.165.m: among barbarians, mountain-dwellers, the despicable, the leprous, / the talkative, the arrogant, the defiled, and the wicked-minded; / an abode with such a man is ordained for you by my curse.'

16.165.s: śāpaṃ dattvā tatastasyā indrāṇīmaśapattadā .. 103 ..
16.165.d: शापं दत्त्वा ततस्तस्या इन्द्राणीमशपत्तदा .. 103 ..
16.165.m: Having pronounced the curse upon her, she then cursed Indrāṇī:

16.165.s:
tvaṣṭurvācā gṛhītendre patyau te duṣṭakāriṇi ..
nahuṣāya gate rājye dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ yācayiṣyati .. .. 104 ..
16.165.d:
त्वष्टुर्वाचा गृहीतेन्द्रे पत्यौ ते दुष्टकारिणि ..
नहुषाय गते राज्ये दृष्ट्वा त्वां याचयिष्यति .. .. 104 ..
16.165.m: 'When your husband Indra is seized at Tvaṣṭṛ’s word, O evil-doer, / and when the kingdom has passed to Nahuṣa, he will ask for you upon seeing you:

16.165.s:
ahamindraḥ kathaṃ caiṣā nopatiṣṭhati cālasā ..
sarvāndevānhaniṣyāmi lapsye nāhaṃ śacīṃ yadi .. 105 ..
16.165.d:
अहमिन्द्रः कथं चैषा नोपतिष्ठति चालसा ..
सर्वान्देवान्हनिष्यामि लप्स्ये नाहं शचीं यदि .. 105 ..
16.165.m: "I am Indra; why does she not attend upon me, sluggish woman? / I will slay all the gods if I do not obtain Śacī!"

16.165.s:
naṣṭā tvaṃ ca tadā śastā vane mahati duḥkhitā ..
vasiṣyasi durācāre śāpena mama garvite .. 106 ..
16.165.d:
नष्टा त्वं च तदा शस्ता वने महति दुःखिता ..
वसिष्यसि दुराचारे शापेन मम गर्विते .. 106 ..
16.165.m: And then, having disappeared, struck down and distressed in the great forest, / you will dwell, O arrogant woman of wicked conduct, by my curse!'

16.165.s: devabhāryāsu sarvāsu tadā śāpamayacchata .. 107 ..
16.165.d: देवभार्यासु सर्वासु तदा शापमयच्छत .. 107 ..
16.165.m: She then bestowed a curse upon all the wives of the gods:

16.165.s:
na cāpatyakṛtā prītiḥ sarvāsveva bhaviṣyati ..
dahyamānā divārātrau vaṃdhyāśabdena duḥkhitāḥ ..108..
16.165.d:
न चापत्यकृता प्रीतिः सर्वास्वेव भविष्यति ..
दह्यमाना दिवारात्रौ वंध्याशब्देन दुःखिताः ..108..
16.165.m: 'There shall be no joy born of offspring for any of you; / burning day and night, you will be grieved by the word "barren".'

16.165.s:
gaurīmevaṃ tathā śaptvā sā devī varavarṇinī ..
uccai ruroda sāvitrī bhartṛ yajñādbahiḥ sthitā .. 109 ..
16.165.d:
गौरीमेवं तथा शप्त्वा सा देवी वरवर्णिनी ..
उच्चै रुरोद सावित्री भर्तृ यज्ञाद्बहिः स्थिता .. 109 ..
16.165.m: Having thus cursed Gaurī as well, that goddess of excellent complexion, / Sāvitrī, standing outside her husband’s sacrifice, wept loudly.

16.165.s:
rodamānā tu sā dṛṣṭā viṣṇunā ca prasāditā ..
mā rodīstvaṃ viśālākṣi ehyāgaccha sadaḥ śubhe .. 7.1.165.110 ..
16.165.d:
रोदमाना तु सा दृष्टा विष्णुना च प्रसादिता ..
मा रोदीस्त्वं विशालाक्षि एह्यागच्छ सदः शुभे .. 7.1.165.110 ..
16.165.m: Seen weeping, she was conciliated by Viṣṇu: / 'Do not weep, O large-eyed lady! Come, enter the assembly, O auspicious one!

16.165.s:
praviṣṭā ca śubhe yāge mekhalāṃ kṣaumavāsasī ..
gṛhāṇa dīkṣāṃ brahmāṇi pādau te praṇame śubhe .. 111 ..
16.165.d:
प्रविष्टा च शुभे यागे मेखलां क्षौमवाससी ..
गृहाण दीक्षां ब्रह्माणि पादौ ते प्रणमे शुभे .. 111 ..
16.165.m: Enter the auspicious sacrifice, take the girdle and the two silken garments, / receive the consecration, O consort of Brahmā; I bow at your feet, O auspicious one!'

16.165.s:
evamuktā'bravīdenaṃ nāhaṃ kuryāṃ vacastava ..
tatrāhaṃ ca gamiṣyāmi yatra śroṣye na ca dhvanim .. 112 ..
16.165.d:
एवमुक्ताऽब्रवीदेनं नाहं कुर्यां वचस्तव ..
तत्राहं च गमिष्यामि यत्र श्रोष्ये न च ध्वनिम् .. 112 ..
16.165.m: Addressed thus, she said to him: 'I will not obey your word. / I shall go to a place where I will not hear the noise.'

16.165.s: etāvaduktvā vyaramaduccaiḥ sthāne kṣitau sthitā .. 113 ..
16.165.d: एतावदुक्त्वा व्यरमदुच्चैः स्थाने क्षितौ स्थिता .. 113 ..
16.165.m: Having said this much, standing upon the ground at an elevated place, she ceased.

16.165.s:
viṣṇustadagrataḥ sthitvā baddhvā ca karasaṃpuṭam ..
tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ .. 114 ..
16.165.d:
विष्णुस्तदग्रतः स्थित्वा बद्ध्वा च करसंपुटम् ..
तुष्टाव प्रणतो भूत्वा भक्त्या परमया युतः .. 114 ..
16.165.m: Standing before her and joining his palms, / Viṣṇu bowed down and praised her, filled with supreme devotion.

16.165.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
namo'stu te mahādevi bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrayīmayi ..
sāvitri durgatariṇi tvaṃ vāṇī saptadhā smṛtā .. 115 ..
16.165.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
नमोऽस्तु ते महादेवि भूर्भुवःस्वस्त्रयीमयि ..
सावित्रि दुर्गतरिणि त्वं वाणी सप्तधा स्मृता .. 115 ..
16.165.m:
Viṣṇu said:
“Salutations unto you, O great goddess, who consist of the three worlds—Bhūḥ, Bhuvaḥ, and Svaḥ—and the three Vedas!
O Sāvitrī, deliverer from perils! You are remembered as speech sevenfold.

16.165.s:
sarvāṇi stutiśāstrāṇi lakṣaṇāni tathaiva ca ..
bhaviṣyā sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ tvaṃ tu devi namo'stu te .. .. 116 ..
16.165.d:
सर्वाणि स्तुतिशास्त्राणि लक्षणानि तथैव च ..
भविष्या सर्वशास्त्राणां त्वं तु देवि नमोऽस्तु ते .. .. 116 ..
16.165.m:
All scriptures of praise, and likewise all treatises on characteristics,
and the future forms of all sacred sciences are you, O goddess. Salutations unto you!

16.165.s:
śvetā tvaṃ śvetarūpāsi śaśāṃkena samānanā ..
śaśiraśmiprakāśena hariṇorasi rājase ..
divyakuṃḍalapūrṇābhyāṃ śravaṇābhyāṃ vibhūṣitā .. .. 117 ..
16.165.d:
श्वेता त्वं श्वेतरूपासि शशांकेन समानना ..
शशिरश्मिप्रकाशेन हरिणोरसि राजसे ..
दिव्यकुंडलपूर्णाभ्यां श्रवणाभ्यां विभूषिता .. .. 117 ..
16.165.m:
You are white, of white form, your face like the moon.
You shine upon Hari’s chest with the radiance of moonbeams,
adorned with ears full of celestial earrings.

16.165.s:
tvaṃ siddhistvaṃ tathā ṛddhiḥ kīrtiḥ śrīḥ saṃtatirmatiḥ ..
saṃdhyā rātri prabhātastvaṃ kālarātristvameva ca .. 118 ..
16.165.d:
त्वं सिद्धिस्त्वं तथा ऋद्धिः कीर्तिः श्रीः संततिर्मतिः ..
संध्या रात्रि प्रभातस्त्वं कालरात्रिस्त्वमेव च .. 118 ..
16.165.m:
You are accomplishment, and likewise prosperity, fame, fortune, progeny, and intellect.
You are twilight, night, dawn, and Kālarātri herself.

16.165.s:
karṣukāṇāṃ yathā sītā bhūtānāṃ dhāriṇī tathā ..
evaṃ stuvaṃtaṃ sāvitrī viṣṇuṃ provāca suvratā .. 119 ..
16.165.d:
कर्षुकाणां यथा सीता भूतानां धारिणी तथा ..
एवं स्तुवंतं सावित्री विष्णुं प्रोवाच सुव्रता .. 119 ..
16.165.m:
Just as the furrow is to farmers, so are you the supporter of all beings.”
To Viṣṇu, who was thus praising her, Sāvitrī of virtuous vows spoke:

16.165.s:
samyakstutā tvayā putra ajeyastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ..
avatāre sadā vatsa pitṛmātṛsu vallabhaḥ .. 7.1.165.120 ..
16.165.d:
सम्यक्स्तुता त्वया पुत्र अजेयस्त्वं भविष्यसि ..
अवतारे सदा वत्स पितृमातृसु वल्लभः .. 7.1.165.120 ..
16.165.m:
“I have been fittingly praised by you, my son. You shall be invincible.
In your incarnation, my child, you will always be dearly loved by your father and mother.

16.165.s:
anena stavarājena stoṣyate yastu māṃ sadā ..
sarvadoṣavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ gamiṣyati .. 121 ..
16.165.d:
अनेन स्तवराजेन स्तोष्यते यस्तु मां सदा ..
सर्वदोषविनिर्मुक्तः परं स्थानं गमिष्यति .. 121 ..
16.165.m:
Whoever continually praises me with this king of hymns,
freed from all faults, will go to the supreme realm.

16.165.s: gaccha yajñaṃ ciraṃ tasya samāptiṃ naya putraka .. 122 ..
16.165.d: गच्छ यज्ञं चिरं तस्य समाप्तिं नय पुत्रक .. 122 ..
16.165.m: Go, bring that long-delayed sacrifice of his to completion, my little son!

16.165.s:
kurukṣetre prayāge ca bhaviṣye yajñakarmaṇi ..
samīpagā sthitā bhartuḥ kariṣye tava bhāṣitam .. 123 ..
16.165.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रे प्रयागे च भविष्ये यज्ञकर्मणि ..
समीपगा स्थिता भर्तुः करिष्ये तव भाषितम् .. 123 ..
16.165.m:
At Kurukṣetra, at Prayāga, and in the future sacrificial rite,
standing by my husband's side, I shall do as you have spoken.”

16.165.s:
evamukto gato viṣṇurbrahmaṇaḥ sada uttamam ..
sāvitrī tu samāyātā prabhāse varavarṇini ..124..
16.165.d:
एवमुक्तो गतो विष्णुर्ब्रह्मणः सद उत्तमम् ..
सावित्री तु समायाता प्रभासे वरवर्णिनि ..124..
16.165.m:
Thus addressed, Viṣṇu went to Brahmā’s excellent assembly-hall.
Sāvitrī, however, came to Prabhāsa, O fair-complexioned lady.

16.165.s: gatāyāmatha sāvitryāṃ gāyatrī vākyamabravīt ..125..
16.165.d: गतायामथ सावित्र्यां गायत्री वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..125..
16.165.m: When Sāvitrī had departed, Gāyatrī spoke these words:

16.165.s:
śṛṇvaṃtu munayo vākyaṃ madīyaṃ bhartṛsannidhau ..
yadahaṃ vacmi saṃtuṣṭā varadānāya codyatā .. 126 ..
16.165.d:
शृण्वंतु मुनयो वाक्यं मदीयं भर्तृसन्निधौ ..
यदहं वच्मि संतुष्टा वरदानाय चोद्यता .. 126 ..
16.165.m:
“Let the sages listen to my words in the presence of my husband,
which I speak, well-pleased and eager to grant boons.

16.165.s:
brahmāṇaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti narā bhaktisamanvitāḥ ..
teṣāṃ vastraṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dārāḥ saukhyaṃ sutāśca vai .. 127 ..
16.165.d:
ब्रह्माणं पूजयिष्यंति नरा भक्तिसमन्विताः ..
तेषां वस्त्रं धनं धान्यं दाराः सौख्यं सुताश्च वै .. 127 ..
16.165.m:
Men who worship Brahmā endowed with devotion,
theirs shall be garments, wealth, grain, wives, happiness, and sons indeed.

16.165.s:
avicchinnaṃ tathā saukhyaṃ gṛhaṃ vai putrapautrikam ..
bhuktvā'sau suciraṃ kālaṃ tato mokṣaṃ gamiṣyati ..128..
16.165.d:
अविच्छिन्नं तथा सौख्यं गृहं वै पुत्रपौत्रिकम् ..
भुक्त्वाऽसौ सुचिरं कालं ततो मोक्षं गमिष्यति ..128..
16.165.m:
And after enjoying unbroken happiness and a home with sons and grandsons
for a very long time, he shall go to liberation.

16.165.s:
śakrāhaṃ te varaṃ vacmi saṃgrāme śatrubhiḥ saha ..
tadā brahmā mocayitā gatvā śatruniketanam .. 129 ..
16.165.d:
शक्राहं ते वरं वच्मि संग्रामे शत्रुभिः सह ..
तदा ब्रह्मा मोचयिता गत्वा शत्रुनिकेतनम् .. 129 ..
16.165.m:
O Śakra, I tell you your boon: when you are in battle with your enemies,
then Brahmā, having gone to the enemy’s abode, will deliver you.

16.165.s:
saputraśatrunāśāttvaṃ lapsyase ca paraṃ mudam ..
akaṃṭakaṃ mahadrājyaṃ trailokye te bhaviṣyati .. 7.1.165.130 ..
16.165.d:
सपुत्रशत्रुनाशात्त्वं लप्स्यसे च परं मुदम् ..
अकंटकं महद्राज्यं त्रैलोक्ये ते भविष्यति .. 7.1.165.130 ..
16.165.m:
From the destruction of your enemy and his sons you will obtain supreme joy,
and yours will be an untroubled, great dominion in the three worlds.

16.165.s:
martyaloke yadā viṣṇo hyavatāraṃ kariṣyasi ..
bhrātrā saha paraṃ duḥkhaṃ svabhāryā haraṇaṃ ca yat .. 131 ..
16.165.d:
मर्त्यलोके यदा विष्णो ह्यवतारं करिष्यसि ..
भ्रात्रा सह परं दुःखं स्वभार्या हरणं च यत् .. 131 ..
16.165.m:
When, O Viṣṇu, you make an incarnation in the mortal world,
and undergo great sorrow along with your brother, as well as the abduction of your wife,

16.165.s:
hatvā śatruṃ punarbhāryāṃ lapsyase surasannidhau ..
gṛhītvā tāṃ punaḥ prājyaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā gamiṣyasi .. 132 ..
16.165.d:
हत्वा शत्रुं पुनर्भार्यां लप्स्यसे सुरसन्निधौ ..
गृहीत्वा तां पुनः प्राज्यं राज्यं कृत्वा गमिष्यसि .. 132 ..
16.165.m:
having slain the enemy, you will regain your wife in the presence of the gods.
Taking her back, you will rule an extensive kingdom and then depart.

16.165.s:
ekādaśa sahasrāṇi kṛtvā rājyaṃ punardivam..
khyātiste vipulā loke cānurāgo bhaviṣyati.. 133 ..
16.165.d:
एकादश सहस्राणि कृत्वा राज्यं पुनर्दिवम्..
ख्यातिस्ते विपुला लोके चानुरागो भविष्यति.. 133 ..
16.165.m:
Having ruled the kingdom for eleven thousand [years], you will return to heaven.
Your renown in the world will be widespread, and there will be great affection for you.”

16.165.s: gāyatrī brāhmaṇāṃstāṃśca sarvānevābravīdidam ..134 ..
16.165.d: गायत्री ब्राह्मणांस्तांश्च सर्वानेवाब्रवीदिदम् ..134 ..
16.165.m: Gāyatrī also said this to all those brahmins:

16.165.s:
yuṣmākaṃ prīṇanaṃ kṛtvā' tṛptiṃ yāsyaṃti devatāḥ..
bhavaṃto bhūmidevā vai sarve pūjyā bhaviṣyatha .. 135 ..
16.165.d:
युष्माकं प्रीणनं कृत्वा' तृप्तिं यास्यंति देवताः..
भवंतो भूमिदेवा वै सर्वे पूज्या भविष्यथ .. 135 ..
16.165.m:
“By gratifying you, the gods will attain satisfaction.
You, indeed, will become gods upon earth, worthy of worship by all.

16.165.s:
yuṣmākaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ..
prāṇāyāmena caikena sarvametattariṣyatha..136..
16.165.d:
युष्माकं पूजनं कृत्वा दत्त्वा दानान्यनेकशः..
प्राणायामेन चैकेन सर्वमेतत्तरिष्यथ..136..
16.165.m:
Having honoured you and given numerous gifts,
and with a single breath-control, they will cross over all this.

16.165.s:
prabhāse tu viśeṣeṇa japtvā māṃ vedamātaram..
pratigrahakṛtāndoṣānna prāpsyadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ..137 ..
16.165.d:
प्रभासे तु विशेषेण जप्त्वा मां वेदमातरम्..
प्रतिग्रहकृतान्दोषान्न प्राप्स्यध्वं द्विजोत्तमाः..137 ..
16.165.m:
Especially in Prabhāsa, by reciting me, the Mother of the Vedas,
you will not incur the faults arising from accepting gifts, O best of the twice-born.

16.165.s:
puṣkare cānnadānena prītāḥ sarve ca devatāḥ ..
ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavatibhojitā .. 138 ..
16.165.d:
पुष्करे चान्नदानेन प्रीताः सर्वे च देवताः ..
एकस्मिन्भोजिते विप्रे कोटिर्भवतिभोजिता .. 138 ..
16.165.m:
And at Puṣkara, all the gods are pleased by the gift of food.
When one brahmin is fed, ten million are considered fed.

16.165.s:
brahmahatyādipāpāni duritāni ca yāni ca ..
tariṣyaṃti narāḥ sarve datte yuṣmatkare dhane .. 139 ..
16.165.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि दुरितानि च यानि च ..
तरिष्यंति नराः सर्वे दत्ते युष्मत्करे धने .. 139 ..
16.165.m:
Whatever sins there are, such as the killing of a brahmin, and other misdeeds,
all men will cross over them when wealth is placed in your hands.

16.165.s:
mahīyadhve tu jāpyena prāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ kṛtaiḥ ..
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati .. 7.1.165.140 ..
16.165.d:
महीयध्वे तु जाप्येन प्राणायामैस्त्रिभिः कृतैः ..
ब्रह्महत्यासमं पापं तत्क्षणादेव नश्यति .. 7.1.165.140 ..
16.165.m:
You will be magnified by recitation; when three breath-controls are performed,
sin equal to the killing of a brahmin is destroyed that very moment.

16.165.s:
daśabhirjanmajanitaṃ śatena tu purā kṛtam ..
triyugaṃ tu sahasreṇa gāyatrī haṃti kilbiṣam .. 141 ..
16.165.d:
दशभिर्जन्मजनितं शतेन तु पुरा कृतम् ..
त्रियुगं तु सहस्रेण गायत्री हंति किल्बिषम् .. 141 ..
16.165.m:
Gāyatrī destroys the sin born of this life with ten [recitations],
that committed in a former birth with a hundred, and that of three yugas with a thousand.

16.165.s:
evaṃ jñātvā sadā pūjyā jāpye ca mama vai kṛte ..
bhaviṣyadhvaṃ na sandeho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 142 ..
16.165.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा सदा पूज्या जाप्ये च मम वै कृते ..
भविष्यध्वं न सन्देहो नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 142 ..
16.165.m:
Knowing this, you will ever be worthy of worship when my recitation is performed;
of this there is no doubt, and no hesitation should be entertained here.

16.165.s:
oṃkāreṇa trimātreṇa sārdhena ca viśeṣataḥ ..
pūjyāḥ sarve na sandeho japtvā māṃ śirasā saha .. 143 ..
16.165.d:
ओंकारेण त्रिमात्रेण सार्धेन च विशेषतः ..
पूज्याः सर्वे न सन्देहो जप्त्वा मां शिरसा सह .. 143 ..
16.165.m:
Accompanied by the oṃkāra of three and a half measures especially,
all become worthy of worship, without a doubt, having recited me together with the Śiras.

16.165.s:
aṣṭākṣarasthitā cāhaṃ jagadvyāptaṃ mayā tvidam ..
mātā'haṃ sarvavedānāṃ vedaiḥ sarvairalaṅkatā .. 144..
16.165.d:
अष्टाक्षरस्थिता चाहं जगद्व्याप्तं मया त्विदम् ..
माताऽहं सर्ववेदानां वेदैः सर्वैरलङ्कता .. 144..
16.165.m:
I abide in eight syllables, and this universe is pervaded by me.
I am the Mother of all the Vedas, adorned by all the Vedas.

16.165.s:
jatvā māṃ paramāṃ sirddhi paśyanti dvijasattamāḥ ..
prādhānyaṃ mama jāpyena sarveṣāṃ vo bhaviṣyati .. 145 ..
16.165.d:
जत्वा मां परमां सिर्द्धि पश्यन्ति द्विजसत्तमाः ..
प्राधान्यं मम जाप्येन सर्वेषां वो भविष्यति .. 145 ..
16.165.m:
Having known me, the best of the twice-born behold supreme perfection.
Through the recitation of me, pre-eminence shall belong to all of you.

16.165.s:
gāyatrīsāramātro'pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ..
nāyaṃtritaścaturvedaḥ sarvāśī sarvavikrayī..146..
16.165.d:
गायत्रीसारमात्रोऽपि वरं विप्रः सुयन्त्रितः..
नायंत्रितश्चतुर्वेदः सर्वाशी सर्वविक्रयी..146..
16.165.m:
Even a brahmin who possesses only the Gāyatrī is superior, if well-restrained,
not one unrestrained though knowing the four Vedas, who eats anything and sells anything.

16.165.s:
yasmādbhavatāṃ sāvitryā śāpo datto sade tviha..
atra dattaṃ hutaṃ cāpi sarvamakṣayakārakam..
datto varo mayā tena yuṣmākaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 147 ..
16.165.d:
यस्माद्भवतां सावित्र्या शापो दत्तो सदे त्विह..
अत्र दत्तं हुतं चापि सर्वमक्षयकारकम्..
दत्तो वरो मया तेन युष्माकं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 147 ..

16.165.s:
agnihotraparā viprāstrikālaṃ homadāyinaḥ ..
svargaṃ te tu gamiṣyaṃti ekaviṃśatibhiḥ kulaiḥ .. 148 ..
16.165.d:
अग्निहोत्रपरा विप्रास्त्रिकालं होमदायिनः ..
स्वर्गं ते तु गमिष्यंति एकविंशतिभिः कुलैः .. 148 ..
16.165.m:
The brahmins devoted to the agnihotra, offering oblations at the three junctures of the day,
will go to heaven along with twenty-one generations of their family.”

16.165.s:
evaṃ śakre ca viṣṇau ca rudre vai pāvake tathā ..
brahmaṇo brahmaṇānāṃ ca gāyatrī sā varaṃ dadau ..
tasminkāle varaṃ dattvā brahmaṇaḥ pārśvagā'bhavat .. 149 ..
16.165.d:
एवं शक्रे च विष्णौ च रुद्रे वै पावके तथा ..
ब्रह्मणो ब्रह्मणानां च गायत्री सा वरं ददौ ..
तस्मिन्काले वरं दत्त्वा ब्रह्मणः पार्श्वगाऽभवत् .. 149 ..
16.165.m:
In this way Gāyatrī granted a boon to Śakra, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and Pāvaka,
and to Brahmā and the brahmins.
Having granted the boon at that time, she stood beside Brahmā.

16.165.s:
hariṇā tu samākhyātaṃ lakṣmyāḥ śāpasya kāraṇam ..
yuvatīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ śāpastāsāṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 7.1.165.150 ..
16.165.d:
हरिणा तु समाख्यातं लक्ष्म्याः शापस्य कारणम् ..
युवतीनां च सर्वासां शापस्तासां पृथक्पृथक् .. 7.1.165.150 ..
16.165.m:
Then Hari explained the cause of Lakṣmī's curse,
and the individual curses of all the young women.

16.165.s: lakṣmyāstadā varaṃ prādādgāyatrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā .. 151 ..
16.165.d: लक्ष्म्यास्तदा वरं प्रादाद्गायत्री ब्रह्मणः प्रिया .. 151 ..
16.165.m: Then Gāyatrī, the beloved of Brahmā, granted a boon to Lakṣmī:

16.165.s:
akutsitāḥ sadā putri tava vāsena śobhane ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ sarvebhyaḥ prītidāyakāḥ .. 152 ..
16.165.d:
अकुत्सिताः सदा पुत्रि तव वासेन शोभने ..
भविष्यति न संदेहः सर्वेभ्यः प्रीतिदायकाः .. 152 ..
16.165.m:
“O daughter, O fair lady! By your presence, people will never be despised;
they will, without doubt, bring delight to everyone.

16.165.s:
ye tvayā vīkṣitāḥ sarve sarve vai puṇyabhājanāḥ ..
teṣāṃ jātiḥ kulaṃ śīlaṃ dharmaścaiva varānane .. 153 ..
16.165.d:
ये त्वया वीक्षिताः सर्वे सर्वे वै पुण्यभाजनाः ..
तेषां जातिः कुलं शीलं धर्मश्चैव वरानने .. 153 ..
16.165.m:
All those who are looked upon by you are vessels of merit.
Theirs will be high birth, lineage, virtuous conduct, and dharma, O fair-faced one.

16.165.s:
parityaktāstvayā ye tu te narā duḥkhabhāginaḥ ..
sabhāyāṃ te na śobhante manyante na ca pārthivaiḥ .. 154 ..
16.165.d:
परित्यक्तास्त्वया ये तु ते नरा दुःखभागिनः ..
सभायां ते न शोभन्ते मन्यन्ते न च पार्थिवैः .. 154 ..
16.165.m:
Those men who are abandoned by you are partakers of sorrow;
they do not shine in an assembly, nor are they respected by kings.

16.165.s:
āśiṣaścaiva teṣāṃ tu kurvate vai dvijottamāḥ ..
saujanyaṃ teṣu kurvanti naptā bhrātā pitā guruḥ .. 155 ..
16.165.d:
आशिषश्चैव तेषां तु कुर्वते वै द्विजोत्तमाः ..
सौजन्यं तेषु कुर्वन्ति नप्ता भ्राता पिता गुरुः .. 155 ..
16.165.m:
To those [favoured by you], the best of the twice-born indeed give blessings;
grandson, brother, father, and teacher show benevolence toward them.

16.165.s:
bāṃdhavo'si na saṃdeho na jīve'haṃ tvayā vinā ..
tvayi dṛṣṭe prasannā me dṛṣṭirbhavati śobhanā ..
manaḥ prasīdate'tyarthaṃ satyaṃsatyaṃ vadāmi te .. 156 ..
16.165.d:
बांधवोऽसि न संदेहो न जीवेऽहं त्वया विना ..
त्वयि दृष्टे प्रसन्ना मे दृष्टिर्भवति शोभना ..
मनः प्रसीदतेऽत्यर्थं सत्यंसत्यं वदामि ते .. 156 ..

16.165.s:
evaṃvidhāni vākyāni tvayā dṛṣṭyā nirīkṣite ..
sajjanāste vadiṣyanti janānāṃ prītidāyakāḥ .. 157 ..
16.165.d:
एवंविधानि वाक्यानि त्वया दृष्ट्या निरीक्षिते ..
सज्जनास्ते वदिष्यन्ति जनानां प्रीतिदायकाः .. 157 ..
16.165.m:
Good people, bringing delight to men, will speak words of this kind
to the one looked upon by your glance.”

16.165.s:
indrāṇi nahuṣaḥ prāpya svargaṃ tvāṃ yācayiṣyati ..
adṛṣṭvā tu hataḥ pāpo agastyavacanāddrutam.. 158 ..
16.165.d:
इन्द्राणि नहुषः प्राप्य स्वर्गं त्वां याचयिष्यति ..
अदृष्ट्वा तु हतः पापो अगस्त्यवचनाद्द्रुतम्.. 158 ..
16.165.m: O Indrāṇī, Nahuṣa, having attained heaven, will demand you. / But, not seeing [you], that wicked one will be destroyed swiftly by the word of Agastya.

16.165.s:
sarpatvaṃ samanuprāpya prārthayiṣyati taṃ munim ..
darpeṇāhaṃ vinaṣṭo'smi śaraṇaṃ me mune bhava .. 159 ..
16.165.d:
सर्पत्वं समनुप्राप्य प्रार्थयिष्यति तं मुनिम् ..
दर्पेणाहं विनष्टोऽस्मि शरणं मे मुने भव .. 159 ..
16.165.m: Reaching the state of a serpent, he will pray to that sage: / ‘I have been ruined by pride; O sage, become my refuge!’

16.165.s:
vākyena tena tasyāsau nṛpasya bhagavānṛṣiḥ ..
kṛtvā manasi kāruṇyamidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 7.1.165.160 ..
16.165.d:
वाक्येन तेन तस्यासौ नृपस्य भगवानृषिः ..
कृत्वा मनसि कारुण्यमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 7.1.165.160 ..
16.165.m: At that speech of that king, the venerable seer, / feeling compassion in his mind, spoke this word:

16.165.s:
utpatsyati kule rājā tvadīye kurunaṃdana ..
sārpaṃ kalevaraṃ dṛṣṭvā praśnaistvāmuddhariṣyati .. 161 ..
16.165.d:
उत्पत्स्यति कुले राजा त्वदीये कुरुनंदन ..
सार्पं कलेवरं दृष्ट्वा प्रश्नैस्त्वामुद्धरिष्यति .. 161 ..
16.165.m: ‘A king will be born in your lineage, O delight of the Kurus; / seeing your serpentine body, he will deliver you with questions.

16.165.s:
so'pyajagaratāṃ tyaktvā punaḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyati ..
aśvamedhe kṛte bhartrā saha yāsi punardivi ..
prāpsyase vara dānena mamānena sulocane .. 162 ..
16.165.d:
सोऽप्यजगरतां त्यक्त्वा पुनः स्वर्गं गमिष्यति ..
अश्वमेधे कृते भर्त्रा सह यासि पुनर्दिवि ..
प्राप्स्यसे वर दानेन ममानेन सुलोचने .. 162 ..
16.165.m: He too, abandoning the state of a python, will go to heaven again. / When the horse sacrifice is performed, you will go again to heaven with your husband. / You will obtain [this] by this boon granted by me, O fair-eyed one.’

16.165.s:
devapatnyastadā sarvāstuṣṭayā paribhāṣitāḥ ..
apatyairapi hīnāḥ syurnaiva duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 163 ..
16.165.d:
देवपत्न्यस्तदा सर्वास्तुष्टया परिभाषिताः ..
अपत्यैरपि हीनाः स्युर्नैव दुःखं भविष्यति .. 163 ..
16.165.m: Then all the wives of the gods were addressed by her who was pleased: / ‘Even though devoid of offspring, there will be no sorrow for you at all.’

16.165.s:
iti dattvā varāndevī gāyatrī lokasaṃmatā ..
jagāmādarśanaṃ devī sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā .. 164 ..
16.165.d:
इति दत्त्वा वरान्देवी गायत्री लोकसंमता ..
जगामादर्शनं देवी सर्वेषां पश्यतां तदा .. 164 ..
16.165.m: Having thus granted boons, the goddess Gāyatrī, revered by the worlds, / vanished while everyone was watching then.

16.165.s:
sāvitrī tu tadā devī prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatā ..
kṛtasmarasya śṛṅge tu śrīsomeśvarapūrvataḥ .. 165 ..
16.165.d:
सावित्री तु तदा देवी प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागता ..
कृतस्मरस्य शृङ्गे तु श्रीसोमेश्वरपूर्वतः .. 165 ..
16.165.m: Then the goddess Sāvitrī came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa, / on the peak of Kṛtasmara, to the east of Śrī Someśvara.

16.165.s:
manvantare cākṣuṣe ca dvitīye dvāpare śubhe ..
tatra yajñaḥ samārabdho brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā .. 166 ..
16.165.d:
मन्वन्तरे चाक्षुषे च द्वितीये द्वापरे शुभे ..
तत्र यज्ञः समारब्धो ब्रह्मणा लोककारिणा .. 166 ..
16.165.m: In the Cākṣuṣa Manvantara, in the auspicious second Dvāpara, / a sacrifice was undertaken there by Brahmā, the creator of the worlds.

16.165.s:
yajñe yātā mahātmāno devāḥ saptarṣayo varāḥ ..
svāyaṃbhuve tu ye śastāḥ śaptāste cābhavanpurā .. 167 ..
16.165.d:
यज्ञे याता महात्मानो देवाः सप्तर्षयो वराः ..
स्वायंभुवे तु ये शस्ताः शप्तास्ते चाभवन्पुरा .. 167 ..
16.165.m: The noble gods and the excellent Seven Seers went to the sacrifice; / they who were praised in the Svāyambhuva [age] had been cursed formerly.

16.165.s: tasmātkālātsamārabhya prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritāḥ .. 168 ..
16.165.d: तस्मात्कालात्समारभ्य प्रभासं क्षेत्रमाश्रिताः .. 168 ..
16.165.m: Beginning from that time, they resorted to the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.165.s:
sāvitrī lokajananī lokānugrahakāriṇī ..
yastāṃ pūjayate bhaktyā pakṣamekaṃ niraṃtaram ..
brahmapūjāvidhānena tasya putro dhruvo bhavet .. 169 ..
16.165.d:
सावित्री लोकजननी लोकानुग्रहकारिणी ..
यस्तां पूजयते भक्त्या पक्षमेकं निरंतरम् ..
ब्रह्मपूजाविधानेन तस्य पुत्रो ध्रुवो भवेत् .. 169 ..
16.165.m: Sāvitrī is the mother of the worlds, bestowing grace upon the worlds. / Whoever worships her with devotion continually for one fortnight, / by the procedure of the worship of Brahmā, his son will surely become enduring.

16.165.s:
pāṇḍukūpe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā liṃgāni pañca vai ..
pāṇḍavaiḥ sthāpitānīha dṛṣṭvā yajñaphalaṃ labhet .. 7.1.165.170 ..
16.165.d:
पाण्डुकूपे नरः स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वा लिंगानि पञ्च वै ..
पाण्डवैः स्थापितानीह दृष्ट्वा यज्ञफलं लभेत् .. 7.1.165.170 ..
16.165.m: A man, having bathed in Pāṇḍukūpa and having beheld the five liṅgas / installed here by the Pāṇḍavas, having beheld [them], obtains the fruit of a sacrifice.

16.165.s:
jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tu sāvitrīsthalasaṃnidhau ..
paṭhedyo brahmasūktāni mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 171 ..
16.165.d:
ज्येष्ठस्य पूर्णिमायां तु सावित्रीस्थलसंनिधौ ..
पठेद्यो ब्रह्मसूक्तानि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 171 ..
16.165.m: On the full-moon day of Jyeṣṭha, in the vicinity of the place of Sāvitrī, / whoever recites the Brahma-sūktas is released from all sins.

16.165.s:
etatte sarvavikhyātamākhyātaṃ kalmaṣāpaham ..
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā sa gacchetparamaṃ padam .. 172 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāvitrīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaṣaṣṭyutaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 165 ..
16.165.d:
एतत्ते सर्वविख्यातमाख्यातं कल्मषापहम् ..
यश्चेदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या स गच्छेत्परमं पदम् .. 172 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सावित्रीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चषष्ट्युतरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 165 ..
16.165.m:
This has all been related to you, famous and destroying impurities. / And whoever hears this with devotion shall go to the supreme abode.
Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Sāvitrī', in the first [part], the Glory of the Sacred Field of Prabhāsa, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.166.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
prabhāse saṃsthitā yā tu sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā ..
tasyāścaritraṃ me brūhi devadeva jagatpate .. 1 ..
16.166.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
प्रभासे संस्थिता या तु सावित्री ब्रह्मणः प्रिया ..
तस्याश्चरित्रं मे ब्रूहि देवदेव जगत्पते .. 1 ..
16.166.m: The goddess said: / Sāvitrī, who is situated in Prabhāsa and is the beloved of Brahmā— / tell me her story, O god of gods, O lord of the world,

16.166.s:
vratamāhātmyasaṃyuktamitihāsasamanvitam ..
pāti vratyakaraṃ strīṇāṃ mahābhāgyaṃ mahodayam .. 2 ..
16.166.d:
व्रतमाहात्म्यसंयुक्तमितिहाससमन्वितम् ..
पाति व्रत्यकरं स्त्रीणां महाभाग्यं महोदयम् .. 2 ..
16.166.m: endowed with the glory of the vow, accompanied by historical narrative, / which produces the vow of chastity for women, bringing great fortune and great prosperity.

16.166.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kathayāmi mahādevi sāvitryāścaritaṃ mahat ..
prabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthāyāḥ sthala sthāne maheśvari ..
yathā cīrṇaṃ vratakaraṃ sāvitryā rājakanyayā .. 3 ..
16.166.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
कथयामि महादेवि सावित्र्याश्चरितं महत् ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रसंस्थायाः स्थल स्थाने महेश्वरि ..
यथा चीर्णं व्रतकरं सावित्र्या राजकन्यया .. 3 ..
16.166.m: Īśvara said: / I shall tell, O great goddess, the great story of Sāvitrī, / situated in the sacred field of Prabhāsa at her holy site, O Maheśvarī, / [and] how the vow-making [observance] was performed by Sāvitrī, the king’s daughter.

16.166.s:
āsīnmadreṣu dharmātmā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ..
pārthivo'śvapatirnāma paurajānapada priyaḥ .. 4 ..
16.166.d:
आसीन्मद्रेषु धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतहिते रतः ..
पार्थिवोऽश्वपतिर्नाम पौरजानपद प्रियः .. 4 ..
16.166.m: In Madra there was a righteous ruler named Aśvapati, / devoted to the welfare of all beings, dear to town and country people.

16.166.s:
kṣamāvānanapatyaśca satyavādī jitendriyaḥ ..
prabhāsakṣetrayātrāyāmājagāma sa bhūpatiḥ ..
yātrāṃ kurvanvidhānena sāvitrīsthalamāgataḥ .. 5 ..
16.166.d:
क्षमावाननपत्यश्च सत्यवादी जितेन्द्रियः ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रयात्रायामाजगाम स भूपतिः ..
यात्रां कुर्वन्विधानेन सावित्रीस्थलमागतः .. 5 ..
16.166.m: He was forgiving, childless, truth-speaking, and self-controlled. / That king went on a pilgrimage to the sacred field of Prabhāsa; / performing the pilgrimage according to rule, he came to the place of Sāvitrī.

16.166.s:
sa sabhāryo vratamidaṃ tatra cakre nṛpaḥ svayam ..
sāvitrīti prasiddhaṃ yatsarvakāmaphalapradam .. 6 ..
16.166.d:
स सभार्यो व्रतमिदं तत्र चक्रे नृपः स्वयम् ..
सावित्रीति प्रसिद्धं यत्सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 6 ..
16.166.m: The king himself, accompanied by his wife, performed this vow there, / celebrated as 'Sāvitrī', which grants the fruits of all desires.

16.166.s:
tasya tuṣṭā'bhavaddevi sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā ..
bhūrbhuvaḥsvaritītyeṣā sākṣānmūrtimatī sthitā .. 7 ..
16.166.d:
तस्य तुष्टाऽभवद्देवि सावित्री ब्रह्मणः प्रिया ..
भूर्भुवःस्वरितीत्येषा साक्षान्मूर्तिमती स्थिता .. 7 ..
16.166.m: O goddess, Sāvitrī, the beloved of Brahmā, became pleased with him; / she who is 'bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ' stood revealed in bodily form.

16.166.s:
kamaṃḍaludharā devī jagāmādarśanaṃ punaḥ ..
kālena vahunā jātā duhitā devarūpiṇī .. 8 ..
16.166.d:
कमंडलुधरा देवी जगामादर्शनं पुनः ..
कालेन वहुना जाता दुहिता देवरूपिणी .. 8 ..
16.166.m: Bearing a water-pot, the goddess vanished again. / After a long time, a daughter of divine form was born.

16.166.s:
sāvitryā prītayā dattā sāvitryāḥ pūjayā tathā ..
sāvitrītyeva nāmā'syāścakre viprājñayā nṛpaḥ.. 9 ..
16.166.d:
सावित्र्या प्रीतया दत्ता सावित्र्याः पूजया तथा ..
सावित्रीत्येव नामाऽस्याश्चक्रे विप्राज्ञया नृपः.. 9 ..
16.166.m: Given by Sāvitrī who was pleased, and through the worship of Sāvitrī, / the king, by the command of the brahmins, gave her the name Sāvitrī.

16.166.s:
sā vigrāhavatīva śrīḥ prāvardhata nṛpātmajā ..
sāvitrī sukumārāṃgī yauvanasthā babhūva ha .. 7.1.166.10 ..
16.166.d:
सा विग्राहवतीव श्रीः प्रावर्धत नृपात्मजा ..
सावित्री सुकुमारांगी यौवनस्था बभूव ह .. 7.1.166.10 ..
16.166.m: Like Fortune incarnate, the king's daughter grew up; / delicate of limb, Sāvitrī reached youthfulness.

16.166.s:
yā sumadhyā pṛthuśroṇī pratimā kāñcanī yathā ..
prāpteyaṃ devakanyā vā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ menire janāḥ .. .. 11 ..
16.166.d:
या सुमध्या पृथुश्रोणी प्रतिमा काञ्चनी यथा ..
प्राप्तेयं देवकन्या वा दृष्ट्वा तां मेनिरे जनाः .. .. 11 ..
16.166.m: She of slender waist and broad hips was like a golden statue; / seeing her, people thought, 'Has a daughter of the gods arrived?'

16.166.s:
sā tu padmā viśālākṣī prajvalatīva tejasā ..
cacāra sā ca sāvitrī vrataṃ yadbhṛguṇoditam ..12..
16.166.d:
सा तु पद्मा विशालाक्षी प्रज्वलतीव तेजसा ..
चचार सा च सावित्री व्रतं यद्भृगुणोदितम् ..12..
16.166.m: She, lotuseyed and large-eyed, blazing as it were with splendour, / that Sāvitrī performed the vow that was proclaimed by Bhṛgu.

16.166.s:
athopoṣya śiraḥsnātā devatāmabhigamya ca ..
hutvāgniṃ vidhivadviprānvācayedvaravarṇinī ..13..
16.166.d:
अथोपोष्य शिरःस्नाता देवतामभिगम्य च ..
हुत्वाग्निं विधिवद्विप्रान्वाचयेद्वरवर्णिनी ..13..
16.166.m: Then, having fasted, having washed her head, and having approached the deity, / having offered oblation into the fire according to rule, the fair-complexioned one had the brahmins recite [blessings].

16.166.s:
tebhyaḥ sumanasaḥ śeṣāṃ pratigṛhya nṛpātmajā..
sakhīparivṛtā'bhyetya devī śrīvatsarūpiṇī ..14..
16.166.d:
तेभ्यः सुमनसः शेषां प्रतिगृह्य नृपात्मजा..
सखीपरिवृताऽभ्येत्य देवी श्रीवत्सरूपिणी ..14..
16.166.m: Receiving from them the remaining flowers, the king's daughter, / surrounded by friends, stepped forward, a goddess in the form of Śrīvatsa.

16.166.s:
sā'bhivādya pituḥ pādau śeṣāṃ pūrvaṃ nivedya ca ..
kṛtāñjalirvarārohā nṛpateḥ pārśvataḥ sthitā .. 15 ..
16.166.d:
साऽभिवाद्य पितुः पादौ शेषां पूर्वं निवेद्य च ..
कृताञ्जलिर्वरारोहा नृपतेः पार्श्वतः स्थिता .. 15 ..
16.166.m: Having paid homage to her father's feet and having first offered the remaining [flowers], / the lovely woman stood at the king's side with folded hands.

16.166.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanaprāptāṃ svāṃ sutāṃ devarūpiṇīm ..
uvāca rājā saṃmantrya putryarthaṃ saha mantribhiḥ .. 16 ..
16.166.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा यौवनप्राप्तां स्वां सुतां देवरूपिणीम् ..
उवाच राजा संमन्त्र्य पुत्र्यर्थं सह मन्त्रिभिः .. 16 ..
16.166.m: Seeing his own daughter of divine form who had attained youth, / the king, having consulted with his ministers for his daughter's sake, said:

16.166.s:
putri pradānakālaste na hi kaścidvṛṇoti mām ..
vicārayanna paśyāmi varaṃ tulyamihātmanaḥ .. ..17..
16.166.d:
पुत्रि प्रदानकालस्ते न हि कश्चिद्वृणोति माम् ..
विचारयन्न पश्यामि वरं तुल्यमिहात्मनः .. ..17..
16.166.m: ‘O daughter, the time for giving you away [in marriage] has arrived, and no one asks me [for your hand]. / Deliberating, I do not see a bridegroom equal to yourself here.

16.166.s:
devādīnāṃ yathā vācyo na bhaveyaṃ tathā kuru ..
paṭhyamānaṃ mayā putri dharmaśāstreṣu ca śrutam ..18..
16.166.d:
देवादीनां यथा वाच्यो न भवेयं तथा कुरु ..
पठ्यमानं मया पुत्रि धर्मशास्त्रेषु च श्रुतम् ..18..
16.166.m: Act in such a way that I may not be censured by gods and others. / What is read in the Dharmaśāstras has been heard by me, O daughter:

16.166.s:
piturgehe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā ..
brahmahatyā pitustasya sā kanyā vṛṣalī smṛtā .. 19 ..
16.166.d:
पितुर्गेहे तु या कन्या रजः पश्यत्यसंस्कृता ..
ब्रह्महत्या पितुस्तस्य सा कन्या वृषली स्मृता .. 19 ..
16.166.m: “That maiden who in her father's house sees her menses while unbetrothed / [causes] the sin of killing a brahmin to her father, and that maiden is deemed a degraded woman.”

16.166.s:
ato'rthaṃ preṣayāmi tvāṃ kuru putri svayaṃvaram ..
vṛddhairamātyaiḥ sahitā śīghraṃ gacchāvadhāraya .. .. 7.1.166.20 ..
16.166.d:
अतोऽर्थं प्रेषयामि त्वां कुरु पुत्रि स्वयंवरम् ..
वृद्धैरमात्यैः सहिता शीघ्रं गच्छावधारय .. .. 7.1.166.20 ..
16.166.m: For this purpose I send you; O daughter, make your own choice of a husband. / Accompanied by elderly ministers, go quickly and decide.’

16.166.s:
evamastviti sāvitrī procya tasmādviniryayau ..
tapovanāni ramyāṇi rājarṣīṇāṃ jagāma sā .. 21 ..
16.166.d:
एवमस्त्विति सावित्री प्रोच्य तस्माद्विनिर्ययौ ..
तपोवनानि रम्याणि राजर्षीणां जगाम सा .. 21 ..
16.166.m: Saying 'Let it be so,' Sāvitrī departed from there; / she went to the delightful penance groves of the royal seers.

16.166.s:
mānyānāṃ tatra vṛddhānāṃ kṛtvā pādābhivandanam ..
tato'bhigamya tīrthāni sarvāṇyevāśramāṇi ca .. 22 ..
16.166.d:
मान्यानां तत्र वृद्धानां कृत्वा पादाभिवन्दनम् ..
ततोऽभिगम्य तीर्थानि सर्वाण्येवाश्रमाणि च .. 22 ..
16.166.m: There, having performed prostration at the feet of the venerable elders, / and then having visited all the sacred fords and the hermitages,

16.166.s:
ājagāma punarveśma sāvitrī saha maṃtribhiḥ ..
tatrāpaśyata devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ purataḥ śucim .. 23 ..
16.166.d:
आजगाम पुनर्वेश्म सावित्री सह मंत्रिभिः ..
तत्रापश्यत देवर्षिं नारदं पुरतः शुचिम् .. 23 ..
16.166.m: Sāvitrī came back home together with the ministers. / There she saw the pure celestial seer Nārada before her.

16.166.s:
āsīnamāsane vipraṃ praṇamya smitabhāṣiṇī ..
kathayāmāsa tatkāryaṃ yenāraṇyaṃ gatā ca sā .. 24 ..
16.166.d:
आसीनमासने विप्रं प्रणम्य स्मितभाषिणी ..
कथयामास तत्कार्यं येनारण्यं गता च सा .. 24 ..
16.166.m: Having bowed to the brahmin seated on the seat, she who speaks with a smile / related that business on account of which she had gone to the forest.

16.166.s:
.. sāvitryuvāca ..
āsīcchālveṣu dharmātmā kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
dyumatsena iti khyāto daivādandho vabhūva saḥ .. 25 ..
16.166.d:
.. सावित्र्युवाच ..
आसीच्छाल्वेषु धर्मात्मा क्षत्रियः पृथिवीपतिः ..
द्युमत्सेन इति ख्यातो दैवादन्धो वभूव सः .. 25 ..
16.166.m: Sāvitrī said: / In Śālva there was a righteous ruler of the earth, a kṣatriya, / known as Dyumatsena; by fate, he became blind.

16.166.s:
āryasya bālaputrasya dyumatsenasya rukmiṇā ..
sāmantena hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ chidre'sminpūrvavairiṇā .. 26 ..
16.166.d:
आर्यस्य बालपुत्रस्य द्युमत्सेनस्य रुक्मिणा ..
सामन्तेन हृतं राज्यं छिद्रेऽस्मिन्पूर्ववैरिणा .. 26 ..
16.166.m: The noble Dyumatsena, whose son was still a child, had his kingdom seized by Rukmin, / a feudatory who was his ancient enemy, taking advantage of this weakness.

16.166.s: sa bālavatsayā sārdhaṃ bhāryayā prasthito vanam .. 27 ..
16.166.d: स बालवत्सया सार्धं भार्यया प्रस्थितो वनम् .. 27 ..
16.166.m: Together with his wife and young child, he departed for the forest.

16.166.s:
sa tasya ca vane vṛddhaḥ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ..
satyavāganurūpo me bharteti manasepsitaḥ .. 28 ..
16.166.d:
स तस्य च वने वृद्धः पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः ..
सत्यवागनुरूपो मे भर्तेति मनसेप्सितः .. 28 ..
16.166.m: And in that forest, his son, most righteous, grew up; / he is Satyavān, suited to be my husband, desired by my heart.”

16.166.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ sāvitryā nṛpate kṛtam ..
bālasvabhāvādanayā guṇavānsatyavāgvṛtaḥ .. 29 ..
16.166.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
अहो बत महत्कष्टं सावित्र्या नृपते कृतम् ..
बालस्वभावादनया गुणवान्सत्यवाग्वृतः .. 29 ..
16.166.m: Nārada said: / “Alas, O king, a great mistake has been made by Sāvitrī! / Out of childish innocence she has chosen the virtuous Satyavān.

16.166.s:
satyaṃ vadatyasya pitā satyaṃ mātā prabhāṣate ..
satyaṃ vadeti munibhiḥ satyavānnāma vai kṛtam ..7.1.166.30..
16.166.d:
सत्यं वदत्यस्य पिता सत्यं माता प्रभाषते ..
सत्यं वदेति मुनिभिः सत्यवान्नाम वै कृतम् ..7.1.166.30..
16.166.m: His father speaks the truth, his mother speaks the truth, / and because the sages said ‘Speak the truth!’, his name was made Satyavān.

16.166.s:
nityaṃ cāśvāḥ priyāstasya karotyaśvāśca mṛnmayān ..
citre'pi ca likhatyaśvāṃścitrāśva iti cocyate .. 31 ..
16.166.d:
नित्यं चाश्वाः प्रियास्तस्य करोत्यश्वाश्च मृन्मयान् ..
चित्रेऽपि च लिखत्यश्वांश्चित्राश्व इति चोच्यते .. 31 ..
16.166.m: Horses are always dear to him, and he makes clay horses; / he also paints horses in pictures, and so he is called Citrāśva.

16.166.s:
satyavānraṃtidevasya śiṣyo dānaguṇaiḥ samaḥ ..
brahmaṇyaḥ satyavādī ca śibirauśīnaro yathā .. 32 ..
16.166.d:
सत्यवान्रंतिदेवस्य शिष्यो दानगुणैः समः ..
ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यवादी च शिबिरौशीनरो यथा .. 32 ..
16.166.m: Satyavān is a disciple of Rantideva, equal to him in the virtues of generosity; / he is devoted to brahmins and truthful in speech, like Śibi the Auśīnara.

16.166.s:
yayātiriva codāraḥ somavatpriyadarśanaḥ ..
rūpeṇānyatamo'śvibhyāṃ dyumatsenasuto balī .. 33 ..
16.166.d:
ययातिरिव चोदारः सोमवत्प्रियदर्शनः ..
रूपेणान्यतमोऽश्विभ्यां द्युमत्सेनसुतो बली .. 33 ..
16.166.m: He is generous like Yayāti, pleasing to behold like the Moon; / in beauty Dyumatsena’s mighty son is like one of the Aśvins.

16.166.s:
eko doṣo'sti nānyaśca so'dyaprabhṛti satyavān ..
saṃvatsareṇa kṣīṇāyurdehatyāgaṃ kariṣyati .. 34 ..
16.166.d:
एको दोषोऽस्ति नान्यश्च सोऽद्यप्रभृति सत्यवान् ..
संवत्सरेण क्षीणायुर्देहत्यागं करिष्यति .. 34 ..
16.166.m: He has one flaw, and no other: beginning from today, Satyavān, / his lifespan exhausted within one year, will abandon his body.”

16.166.s: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā duhitā prāha pārthivam .. 35 ..
16.166.d: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दुहिता प्राह पार्थिवम् .. 35 ..
16.166.m: Having heard Nārada’s words, the daughter said to the king:

16.166.s:
.. sāvitryuvāca .. ..
sakṛjjalpaṃti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ ..
sakṛtkanyā pradīyeta trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt .. 36 ..
16.166.d:
.. सावित्र्युवाच .. ..
सकृज्जल्पंति राजानः सकृज्जल्पंति ब्राह्मणाः ..
सकृत्कन्या प्रदीयेत त्रीण्येतानि सकृत्सकृत् .. 36 ..
16.166.m: Sāvitrī said: / “Kings speak only once, brahmins speak only once, / a maiden is given away only once: these three happen only once each.

16.166.s:
dīrghāyurathavālpāyuḥ saguṇo nirguṇo'pi vā ..
sakṛdvṛto mayā bhartā na dvitīyaṃ vṛṇomyaham .. 37 ..
16.166.d:
दीर्घायुरथवाल्पायुः सगुणो निर्गुणोऽपि वा ..
सकृद्वृतो मया भर्ता न द्वितीयं वृणोम्यहम् .. 37 ..
16.166.m: Whether long-lived or short-lived, with virtues or without virtues, / he has been chosen once by me as husband; I will not choose a second.

16.166.s:
manasā niścayaṃ kṛtvā tato vācā'bhidhīyate ..
kriyate karmaṇā paścātpramāṇaṃ hi manastataḥ .. 38 ..
16.166.d:
मनसा निश्चयं कृत्वा ततो वाचाऽभिधीयते ..
क्रियते कर्मणा पश्चात्प्रमाणं हि मनस्ततः .. 38 ..
16.166.m: Having resolved in the mind, one then expresses it in speech; / afterwards it is carried out in action: therefore the mind is the true authority.”

16.166.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
yadyetadiṣṭaṃ bhavataḥ śīghrameva vidhīyatām ..
avighnena tu sāvitryāḥ pradānaṃ duhitustava .. 39 ..
16.166.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
यद्येतदिष्टं भवतः शीघ्रमेव विधीयताम् ..
अविघ्नेन तु सावित्र्याः प्रदानं दुहितुस्तव .. 39 ..
16.166.m: Nārada said: / “If this is your wish, let it be carried out at once, / the giving away of your daughter Sāvitrī without impediment.”

16.166.s:
evamuktvā samutpatya nārūdastridivaṃ gataḥ ..
rājā ca duhituḥ sarvaṃ vaivāhikamathākarot ..
śubhe muhūrte pārśvasthairbrāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ .. 7.1.166.40 ..
16.166.d:
एवमुक्त्वा समुत्पत्य नारूदस्त्रिदिवं गतः ..
राजा च दुहितुः सर्वं वैवाहिकमथाकरोत् ..
शुभे मुहूर्ते पार्श्वस्थैर्ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः .. 7.1.166.40 ..
16.166.m: Having spoken thus, Nārada flew up and went to heaven; / and the king then performed all the marriage rites for his daughter / at an auspicious hour, together with the brahmins versed in the Vedas standing beside him.

16.166.s:
sāvitryapi ca taṃ labdhvā bhartāraṃ manaseptitam ...
mumude'tīva tanvaṃgī svargaṃ prāpyeva puṇyakṛt .. 41 ..
16.166.d:
सावित्र्यपि च तं लब्ध्वा भर्तारं मनसेप्तितम् ...
मुमुदेऽतीव तन्वंगी स्वर्गं प्राप्येव पुण्यकृत् .. 41 ..
16.166.m: And Sāvitrī, having obtained that husband desired by her heart, / the slender-limbed maiden rejoiced exceedingly, like a doer of meritorious deeds reaching heaven.

16.166.s:
evaṃ tatrāśrame teṣāṃ tadā nivasatāṃ satām ..
kālastu paśyatāṃ kiñcidaticakrāma pārvati .. 42 ..
16.166.d:
एवं तत्राश्रमे तेषां तदा निवसतां सताम् ..
कालस्तु पश्यतां किञ्चिदतिचक्राम पार्वति .. 42 ..
16.166.m: While those virtuous people were living there in the hermitage, / some time passed as they watched, O Pārvatī.

16.166.s:
sāvitryāstu tadā nāryāstiṣṭhantyāśca divāniśam ..
nāradena yaduktaṃ tadvākyaṃ manasi vartate .. 43 ..
16.166.d:
सावित्र्यास्तु तदा नार्यास्तिष्ठन्त्याश्च दिवानिशम् ..
नारदेन यदुक्तं तद्वाक्यं मनसि वर्तते .. 43 ..
16.166.m: And as that woman Sāvitrī stayed there day and night, / what had been spoken by Nārada remained in her mind.

16.166.s:
tataḥ kāle bahutithe vyatikrānte kadācana ..
prāptaḥ kālo'tha martavyo yatra satyavrato nṛpaḥ .. 44 ..
16.166.d:
ततः काले बहुतिथे व्यतिक्रान्ते कदाचन ..
प्राप्तः कालोऽथ मर्तव्यो यत्र सत्यव्रतो नृपः .. 44 ..
16.166.m: Then, after a great deal of time had elapsed, / the time arrived when the king Satyavrata was to die.

16.166.s:
jyeṣṭhamāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ rajanīmukhe ..
gaṇayaṃtyāśca sāvitryā nāradoktaṃ vaco hṛdi .. 45 ..
16.166.d:
ज्येष्ठमासे सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां रजनीमुखे ..
गणयंत्याश्च सावित्र्या नारदोक्तं वचो हृदि .. 45 ..
16.166.m: In the month of Jyeṣṭha, in the bright fortnight, on the twelfth day, at nightfall, / Sāvitrī was counting in her heart the words spoken by Nārada.

16.166.s:
caturthe'hani martavyamiti saṃciṃtya bhāminī ..
vrataṃ trirātramuddiśya divārātraṃ sthitā''śrame .. 46 ..
16.166.d:
चतुर्थेऽहनि मर्तव्यमिति संचिंत्य भामिनी ..
