ते भ्रातृभृत्यसुतबंधुजनैर्युताश्च सर्वोपसर्ग रहिताः सुखिनो भवन्ति .. 123 ..
16.167.m: Those who honor through worship the fear-dispelling Mother of spirits of the world, with playful charms of their own smiles, / become happy, accompanied by brothers, servants, sons, and relatives, and free from all afflictions. (123)

16.167.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhūta mātṛkāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 167 ..
16.167.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भूत मातृकामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 167 ..
16.167.m: Thus ends the one hundred sixty-seventh chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Bhūtamātṛkā,’ in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. (167)

16.168.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devīṃ śālakaṭaṃkaṭām ..
sāvitryā dakṣiṇe bhāge raivatātpūrvataḥ sthitām .. 1 ..
16.168.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवीं शालकटंकटाम् ..
सावित्र्या दक्षिणे भागे रैवतात्पूर्वतः स्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.168.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, the wise person should go to Goddess Śālakaṭaṅkaṭā, / situated to the south of Sāvitrī and to the east of Raivata, (1)
who alleviates great sins, who destroys all sorrows, / who is worshiped by all gandharvas, and who is fierce and terrifying with flashing fangs, (2)

16.168.s:
mahāpracaṇḍadaityaghnīṃ paulastyena pratiṣṭhitām ..
mahiṣaghnīṃ mahākāyāṃ kṣetre prābhāsike sthitām .. 3 ..
16.168.d:
महाप्रचण्डदैत्यघ्नीं पौलस्त्येन प्रतिष्ठिताम् ..
महिषघ्नीं महाकायां क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके स्थिताम् .. 3 ..
16.168.m: the slayer of the exceedingly fierce Daityas, installed by the descendant of Pulastya, / the slayer of Mahiṣa, having a huge body, situated in the sacred field of Prabhāsa. (3)

16.168.s:
māghe māse caturdaśyāṃ yastā mārādhayennaraḥ ..
sa bhavetpaśumāndhīmām̐llakṣmīvānputravānsudhīḥ .. 4 ..
16.168.d:
माघे मासे चतुर्दश्यां यस्ता माराधयेन्नरः ..
स भवेत्पशुमान्धीमाम्̐ल्लक्ष्मीवान्पुत्रवान्सुधीः .. 4 ..
16.168.m: A man who worships her on the fourteenth day in the month of Māgha / becomes rich in cattle, wise, prosperous, endowed with sons, and intelligent. (4)

16.168.s:
yastāṃ paśupradānena santarpayati bhaktitaḥ ..
balipūjopahāraiśca sa syācchatru vivarjitaḥ .. 5 ..
16.168.d:
यस्तां पशुप्रदानेन सन्तर्पयति भक्तितः ..
बलिपूजोपहारैश्च स स्याच्छत्रु विवर्जितः .. 5 ..
16.168.m: He who propitiates her with devotion by offering beasts / and with animal offerings, worship, and gifts, becomes free of enemies. (5)

16.168.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śālakaṭaṃkaṭā māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 168 ..
16.168.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहिताया सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शालकटंकटा माहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 168 ..
16.168.m: Thus ends the one hundred sixty-eighth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Śālakaṭaṅkaṭā,’ in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. (168)

16.169.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ vaivasvateśvaram..
devyā dakṣiṇadigbhāge dhanustriṃśakasaṃsthitam .. 1 ..
16.169.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं वैवस्वतेश्वरम्..
देव्या दक्षिणदिग्भागे धनुस्त्रिंशकसंस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.169.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the liṅga Vaivasvateśvara, / situated thirty bow-lengths to the southern direction of the Goddess, (1)

16.169.s:
vaivasvatena manunā sthāpitaṃ sarvakāmadam..
tatsamīpe devakhātaṃ tiṣṭhate tu mahādbhutam .. 2 ..
16.169.d:
वैवस्वतेन मनुना स्थापितं सर्वकामदम्..
तत्समीपे देवखातं तिष्ठते तु महाद्भुतम् .. 2 ..
16.169.m: installed by Vaivasvata Manu, granting all desires. / Near it is situated a most wonderful divine tank. (2)

16.169.s:
snātvā tatra varārohe yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
pañcopacārairvidhinā bhaktiprahvo jitendriyaḥ ..
japedaghoravidhinā stotraṃ siddhiṃ sa cāpnuyāt .. .. 3 ..
16.169.d:
स्नात्वा तत्र वरारोहे यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
पञ्चोपचारैर्विधिना भक्तिप्रह्वो जितेन्द्रियः ..
जपेदघोरविधिना स्तोत्रं सिद्धिं स चाप्नुयात् .. .. 3 ..
16.169.m: Having bathed there, O lady of fair hips, that man who worships it / with five modes of worship according to the rite, bowed down in devotion and with senses conquered, / and chants the hymn according to the rite of Aghora, shall attain perfection. (3)

16.169.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vaivasvateśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmaikonasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 169 ..
16.169.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वैवस्वतेश्वरमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनामैकोनसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 169 ..
16.169.m: Thus ends the one hundred sixty-ninth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Vaivasvateśvara,’ in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. (169)

16.170.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tatra mātṛgaṇānsudhīḥ ..
tatraiva baladevīṃ ca nātidūre vyavasthitām .. 1 ..
16.170.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तत्र मातृगणान्सुधीः ..
तत्रैव बलदेवीं च नातिदूरे व्यवस्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.170.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, the wise person should go to the host of Mothers there, / and right there to Baladevī, situated not very far away. (1)

16.170.s:
śrāvaṇyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi yastāṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
pāyasairmadhunā vāpi divyapuṣpopahārakaiḥ .. .. 2 ..
16.170.d:
श्रावण्यां श्रावणे मासि यस्तां पूजयते नरः ..
पायसैर्मधुना वापि दिव्यपुष्पोपहारकैः .. .. 2 ..
16.170.m: A man who worships her on the full-moon day in the month of Śrāvaṇa / with milk-rice, honey, or offerings of heavenly flowers, (2)
his year passes pleasantly, highly honored, O great goddess. (3)

16.170.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mātṛgaṇabaladevīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatyuttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ .. 170 ..
16.170.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मातृगणबलदेवीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तत्युत्तरशततमोध्यायः .. 170 ..
16.170.m: Thus ends the one hundred seventieth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Mātṛgaṇa and Baladevī,’ in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. (170)

16.171.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devīmekallavīrikām ..
ekallavīrāyāmye tu nātidūre vyavasthitām .. 1 ..
16.171.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवीमेकल्लवीरिकाम् ..
एकल्लवीरायाम्ये तु नातिदूरे व्यवस्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.171.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the goddess Ekallavīrikā, / situated not very far to the south of Ekallavīra. (1)

16.171.s:
pūrvaṃ daśaratho yo'sau sūryavaṃśavibhūṣaṇaḥ ..
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya tapaścakre suduścaram .. 2 ..
16.171.d:
पूर्वं दशरथो योऽसौ सूर्यवंशविभूषणः ..
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य तपश्चक्रे सुदुश्चरम् .. 2 ..
16.171.m: Formerly, that famous Daśaratha, an ornament of the Solar dynasty, / came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa and performed exceedingly severe austerity. (2)

16.171.s:
liṃgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya toṣayāmāsa śāṃkaram ..
sa devaṃ prārthayāmāsa putraṃ caivāmitaujasam .. .. 3 ..
16.171.d:
लिंगं तत्र प्रतिष्ठाप्य तोषयामास शांकरम् ..
स देवं प्रार्थयामास पुत्रं चैवामितौजसम् .. .. 3 ..
16.171.m: Installing a liṅga there, he propitiated Śaṅkara; / he prayed to the god for a son of immeasurable splendor. (3)

16.171.s:
dadau tasya tadā putraṃ devaṃ trailokyapūjitam ..
rāmeti nāma yasyāsīttrailokye prathitaṃ yaśaḥ .. 4 ..
16.171.d:
ददौ तस्य तदा पुत्रं देवं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् ..
रामेति नाम यस्यासीत्त्रैलोक्ये प्रथितं यशः .. 4 ..
16.171.m: Then [the god] granted him a son, a god revered throughout the three worlds, / whose name was Rāma, whose fame was renowned across the three worlds, (4)

16.171.s:
yasyādyāpīha gāyanti bhūrbhuvaḥsvarni vāsinaḥ ..
devadaityāsurāḥ sarve vālmīkyādyā maharṣayaḥ .. 5 ..
16.171.d:
यस्याद्यापीह गायन्ति भूर्भुवःस्वर्नि वासिनः ..
देवदैत्यासुराः सर्वे वाल्मीक्याद्या महर्षयः .. 5 ..
16.171.m: whom to this day the inhabitants of Bhūr, Bhuvas, and Svar, / all gods, Daityas, and asuras, and the great seers headed by Vālmīki, sing of here. (5)

16.171.s:
talliṃgasya prabhāvena prāptaṃ rājñā mahadyaśaḥ ..
kārtikyāṃ kārtike māsi vidhinā yastamarcayet ..
dīpapūjopahāreṇa yaśasvī so'pi jāyate .. 6 ..
16.171.d:
तल्लिंगस्य प्रभावेन प्राप्तं राज्ञा महद्यशः ..
कार्तिक्यां कार्तिके मासि विधिना यस्तमर्चयेत् ..
दीपपूजोपहारेण यशस्वी सोऽपि जायते .. 6 ..
16.171.m: By the power of that liṅga, great renown was attained by the king. / Whoever worships it according to rule on the full moon of the month of Kārttika / with offerings and the worship of lamps, he too becomes renowned. (6)

16.171.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye daśaratheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 171 ..
16.171.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दशरथेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 171 ..
16.171.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-first chapter, named “Description of the Māhātmya of Daśaratheśvara,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [khaṇḍa], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. (171)

16.172.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahā devi liṃgaṃ tadbharateśvaram ..
tasmāduttarakoṇasthaṃ nātidūraṃ vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.172.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महा देवि लिंगं तद्भरतेश्वरम् ..
तस्मादुत्तरकोणस्थं नातिदूरं व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.172.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to that Bharateśvara liṅga, / situated not very far off in the northeast quarter from that [place]. (1)

16.172.s:
bharatonāma rājā'bhūdāgnīdhraḥ prathitaḥ kṣitau ..
yasyedaṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ nāmnā lokeṣu gīyate .. 2 ..
16.172.d:
भरतोनाम राजाऽभूदाग्नीध्रः प्रथितः क्षितौ ..
यस्येदं भारतं वर्षं नाम्ना लोकेषु गीयते .. 2 ..
16.172.m: There was a king named Bharata, a descendant of Āgnīdhra, famous on earth, / after whose name this land of Bhārata is sung among the worlds. (2)

16.172.s:
sa ca cakre tapo ghoraṃ kṣetre'sminpārvati priye ..
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram .. 3 ..
16.172.d:
स च चक्रे तपो घोरं क्षेत्रेऽस्मिन्पार्वति प्रिये ..
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु प्रतिष्ठाप्य महेश्वरम् .. 3 ..
16.172.m: And he performed fierce austerity in this sacred field, O dear Pārvatī, / for a thousand divine years, having installed Maheśvara. (3)

16.172.s:
putrakāmo naraśreṣṭhaḥ pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram ..
tatastuṣṭaḥ sa bhagavānvaraṃ dātuṃ samutsukaḥ .. 4 ..
16.172.d:
पुत्रकामो नरश्रेष्ठः पूजयामास शंकरम् ..
ततस्तुष्टः स भगवान्वरं दातुं समुत्सुकः .. 4 ..
16.172.m: Desiring sons, that best of men worshipped Śaṃkara. / Thereupon the Lord was pleased and eager to grant a boon. (4)

16.172.s:
aṣṭau putrāndadau tasmai kanyāṃ caikāṃ yaśasvinīm ..
sa tu prāpyābhilaṣitaṃ kṛtakṛtyo narādhipaḥ .. 5 ..
16.172.d:
अष्टौ पुत्रान्ददौ तस्मै कन्यां चैकां यशस्विनीम् ..
स तु प्राप्याभिलषितं कृतकृत्यो नराधिपः .. 5 ..
16.172.m: He gave him eight sons and one renowned daughter. / Having attained what he desired, that king became fulfilled. (5)

16.172.s:
bhārataṃ navadhā kṛtvā putrebhyaḥ pradadau pṛthak ..
teṣāṃ nāmāṃkitānyeva tato dvīpāni jajñire .. 6 ..
16.172.d:
भारतं नवधा कृत्वा पुत्रेभ्यः प्रददौ पृथक् ..
तेषां नामांकितान्येव ततो द्वीपानि जज्ञिरे .. 6 ..
16.172.m: Having divided Bhārata into nine parts, he gave them separately to his sons. / From them the regions came to be named after them. (6)

16.172.s:
indradvīpaḥ kaseruśca tāmravarṇo gabhastimān ..
nāgadvīpastathā saumyo gāndharvastvatha cāruṇaḥ .. 7 ..
16.172.d:
इन्द्रद्वीपः कसेरुश्च ताम्रवर्णो गभस्तिमान् ..
नागद्वीपस्तथा सौम्यो गान्धर्वस्त्वथ चारुणः .. 7 ..
16.172.m: Indradvīpa, Kaseru, Tāmravarṇa, Gabhastimat, / Nāgadvīpa, Saumya, Gāndharva, and Aruṇa: (7)

16.172.s:
ayaṃ tu navamo dvīpaḥ kumāryā saṃjñitaḥ priye ..
aṣṭau dvīpāḥ samudreṇa plāvitāśca tathāpare .. 8 ..
16.172.d:
अयं तु नवमो द्वीपः कुमार्या संज्ञितः प्रिये ..
अष्टौ द्वीपाः समुद्रेण प्लाविताश्च तथापरे .. 8 ..
16.172.m: And this ninth region is called Kumārī, O dear one. / The eight other regions were inundated by the ocean. (8)

16.172.s:
grāmādideśasaṃyuktāḥ sthitāḥ sāgaramadhyagāḥ ..
eka eva sthitasteṣāṃ kumāryākhyastu sāṃpratam .. 9 ..
16.172.d:
ग्रामादिदेशसंयुक्ताः स्थिताः सागरमध्यगाः ..
एक एव स्थितस्तेषां कुमार्याख्यस्तु सांप्रतम् .. 9 ..
16.172.m: Endowed with villages and lands, they exist situated in the midst of the sea. / Of them, only this one called Kumārī remains at present. (9)

16.172.s:
biṃdusaraḥ prabhṛtyeva sāgarāddakṣiṇottaram ..
yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu ekaṃ vistīrṇa eva tu .. 7.1.172.10 ..
16.172.d:
बिंदुसरः प्रभृत्येव सागराद्दक्षिणोत्तरम् ..
योजनानां सहस्रं तु एकं विस्तीर्ण एव तु .. 7.1.172.10 ..
16.172.m: From the Bindusaras southward to the ocean, / it is extended across one thousand yojanas; (10)

16.172.s:
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi nava dairghyaṃ prakīrtitam ..
tasyaitajjṛmbhitaṃ devi bharatasya mahātmanaḥ .. 11 ..
16.172.d:
योजनानां सहस्राणि नव दैर्घ्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ..
तस्यैतज्जृम्भितं देवि भरतस्य महात्मनः .. 11 ..
16.172.m: its length is proclaimed to be nine thousand yojanas. / This was the expansion of that great-souled Bharata, O goddess, (11)

16.172.s:
ṣaṭpañcāśadaśvamedhāngaṃgāmanu cakāra yaḥ..
yastriṃśadyamunāprānte bharato lokapūjitaḥ .. 12 ..
16.172.d:
षट्पञ्चाशदश्वमेधान्गंगामनु चकार यः..
यस्त्रिंशद्यमुनाप्रान्ते भरतो लोकपूजितः .. 12 ..
16.172.m: who performed fifty-six horse sacrifices along the Gaṅgā, / and thirty along the Yamunā—Bharata, who was worshipped by the world. (12)
And by the grace of Īśvara he rejoices in heaven like a god. (13)

16.172.s:
yastatpratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ bhārataṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
sa sarvayajñadānānāṃ phalaṃ prāpayitā dhuvam .. 14 ..
16.172.d:
यस्तत्प्रतिष्ठितं लिंगं भारतं पूजयिष्यति ..
स सर्वयज्ञदानानां फलं प्रापयिता धुवम् .. 14 ..
16.172.m: Whoever will worship that liṅga installed by Bharata, / he will certainly obtain the fruit of all sacrifices and gifts. (14)

16.172.s:
kārttikyāṃ kṛttikā yoge yastaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ..
na sa paśyati svapnepi narakaṃ ghoradāruṇam .. 15 ..
16.172.d:
कार्त्तिक्यां कृत्तिका योगे यस्तं पश्यति मानवः ..
न स पश्यति स्वप्नेपि नरकं घोरदारुणम् .. 15 ..
16.172.m: The man who sees it on the full moon of Kārttika under the conjunction with Kṛttikā / does not, even in a dream, see the dreadful and terrible hell. (15)

16.172.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bharateśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 172 ..
16.172.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भरतेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 172 ..
16.172.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-second chapter, named “Description of the Māhātmya of Bharateśvara,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [khaṇḍa], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. (172)

16.173.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgānāṃ ca catuṣṭayam ..
ekasthānasthitānāṃ tu sāvitryāstatra paścime .. 1 ..
16.173.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगानां च चतुष्टयम् ..
एकस्थानस्थितानां तु सावित्र्यास्तत्र पश्चिमे .. 1 ..
16.173.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the four liṅgas / situated in a single place to the west of Sāvitrī there. (1)

16.173.s:
liṃgānāṃ dvitayaṃ pūrve paścime sammukhadvayam ..
kuśakeśvaranāmeti liṃgaṃ vai prathamaṃ smṛtam .. 2 ..
16.173.d:
लिंगानां द्वितयं पूर्वे पश्चिमे सम्मुखद्वयम् ..
कुशकेश्वरनामेति लिंगं वै प्रथमं स्मृतम् .. 2 ..
16.173.m: A pair of liṅgas is in the east, and two face them in the west. / The first is known as the liṅga named Kuśakeśvara; (2)

16.173.s:
gargeśvaraṃ dvitīyaṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ puṣkareśvaram ..
maitreyeśvaranāmeti caturthaṃ samudāhṛtam .. 3 ..
16.173.d:
गर्गेश्वरं द्वितीयं तु तृतीयं पुष्करेश्वरम् ..
मैत्रेयेश्वरनामेति चतुर्थं समुदाहृतम् .. 3 ..
16.173.m: the second is Gargeśvara, the third is Puṣkareśvara, / and the fourth is declared by the name Maitreyeśvara. (3)

16.173.s:
etāni yastu liṃgāni paśyedbhaktyā jitendriyaḥ ..
sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairgacchecchivapuraṃ mahat .. .. 4 ..
16.173.d:
एतानि यस्तु लिंगानि पश्येद्भक्त्या जितेन्द्रियः ..
स मुक्तः पातकैः सर्वैर्गच्छेच्छिवपुरं महत् .. .. 4 ..
16.173.m: Whoever, with senses conquered, sees these liṅgas with devotion, / freed from all sins, goes to the great city of Śiva. (4)

16.173.s:
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhe tu viśeṣataḥ ..
snānaṃ kṛtvā prayatnena brāhmaṇāṃstatra bhojayet .. 5 ..
16.173.d:
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां वैशाखे तु विशेषतः ..
स्नानं कृत्वा प्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणांस्तत्र भोजयेत् .. 5 ..
16.173.m: Having made ritual ablution with effort, especially on the fourteenth of the bright fortnight in Vaiśākha, / one should feed brahmins there. (5)

16.173.s:
tebhyo dadyādyathāśaktyā kāñcanaṃ vasanāni ca ..
evaṃ kṛte bhavedyātrā paripūrṇā sureśvari .. 6 ..
16.173.d:
तेभ्यो दद्याद्यथाशक्त्या काञ्चनं वसनानि च ..
एवं कृते भवेद्यात्रा परिपूर्णा सुरेश्वरि .. 6 ..
16.173.m: One should give them gold and garments according to one’s ability. / When this is done, O ruler of the gods, the pilgrimage becomes complete. (6)

16.173.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kuśakādiliṃgacatuṣṭayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trisaptatyuttaratatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 173 ..
16.173.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कुशकादिलिंगचतुष्टयमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिसप्तत्युत्तरततमोऽध्यायः .. 173 ..
16.173.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-third chapter, named “Description of the Māhātmya of the Four Liṅgas Beginning with Kuśaka,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [khaṇḍa], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. (173)

16.174.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kuntīśvaramanuttamam ..
sāvitryāḥ pūrvabhāgasthaṃ khātamadhye vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.174.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कुन्तीश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
सावित्र्याः पूर्वभागस्थं खातमध्ये व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.174.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the unsurpassed Kuntīśvara, / situated in the eastern quarter of Sāvitrī, within a ditch. (1)

16.174.s:
kuntyā pratiṣṭhitaṃ devi kṣetre prābhāsike priye ..
pāṇḍavāstu yadā pūrvaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāgatāḥ .. 2 ..
16.174.d:
कुन्त्या प्रतिष्ठितं देवि क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके प्रिये ..
पाण्डवास्तु यदा पूर्वं प्रभासक्षेत्रमागताः .. 2 ..
16.174.m: It was installed by Kuntī, O goddess, in the sacred field of Prabhāsa, O dear one, / when the Pāṇḍavas formerly came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa (2)

16.174.s:
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena kuntyā caiva samanvitāḥ ..
tasminkāle mahādevi jñātvā kṣetramanuttamam..3..
16.174.d:
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन कुन्त्या चैव समन्विताः ..
तस्मिन्काले महादेवि ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रमनुत्तमम्..3..
16.174.m: accompanied by Kuntī in the course of a pilgrimage. / At that time, O great goddess, having recognized the sacred field to be unsurpassed, (3)

16.174.s:
kuntyā pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham..
kārtikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ..
sa sarvakāmatṛptātmā rudraloke mahīyate..4..
16.174.d:
कुन्त्या प्रतिष्ठितं लिंगं सर्वपापभयापहम्..
कार्तिक्यां तु विशेषेण यस्तं पूजयते नरः..
स सर्वकामतृप्तात्मा रुद्रलोके महीयते..4..
16.174.m: the liṅga that dispels fear of all sins was installed by Kuntī. / The man who worships it especially on the full moon of Kārttika, / with all his desires satisfied, is glorified in the world of Rudra. (4)

16.174.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yadupārjitam..
tatsarvaṃ naśyate devi tasya liṃgasya darśanāt..5..
16.174.d:
वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मणा यदुपार्जितम्..
तत्सर्वं नश्यते देवि तस्य लिंगस्य दर्शनात्..5..
16.174.m: Whatever sin has been acquired through speech, mind, or action, / all of that is destroyed, O goddess, upon seeing that liṅga. (5)

16.174.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kuntīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 174 ..
16.174.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कुन्तीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुःसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 174 ..
16.174.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-fourth chapter, named “Description of the Māhātmya of Kuntīśvara,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [khaṇḍa], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. (174)

16.175.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi puṇyamarkasthalaṃ śubham ..
tasmādāgneyakoṇasthaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.175.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि पुण्यमर्कस्थलं शुभम् ..
तस्मादाग्नेयकोणस्थं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.175.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the auspicious and holy Arkasthala, / which destroys all sins and is situated in the southeast quarter from that [place]. (1)

16.175.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānuṣo devi na śocyaḥ saṃprajāyate ..
sapta janmāni deveśi dāridryaṃ naiva jāyate .. 2 ..
16.175.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मानुषो देवि न शोच्यः संप्रजायते ..
सप्त जन्मानि देवेशि दारिद्र्यं नैव जायते .. 2 ..
16.175.m: Having seen it, O goddess, a mortal does not become sorrowful; / for seven births, O ruler of the gods, poverty does not arise at all. (2)

16.175.s:
kuṣṭhāni nāśamāyāṃti taṃ dṛṣṭvā daśadhā priye ..
gośatasya pradattasya kurukṣetreṣu yatphalam .. 3 ..
16.175.d:
कुष्ठानि नाशमायांति तं दृष्ट्वा दशधा प्रिये ..
गोशतस्य प्रदत्तस्य कुरुक्षेत्रेषु यत्फलम् .. 3 ..
16.175.m: The ten kinds of leprosy go to destruction upon seeing it, O dear one. / Whatever fruit is obtained from donating a hundred cows in Kurukṣetra, (3)

16.175.s:
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti dṛṣṭvā vārkasthalaṃ ravim ..
snātvā trisaṃgame tīrthe saptaiva ravivāsarān ..4..
16.175.d:
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति दृष्ट्वा वार्कस्थलं रविम् ..
स्नात्वा त्रिसंगमे तीर्थे सप्तैव रविवासरान् ..4..
16.175.m: that fruit one attains upon seeing the Sun of Arkasthala. / Having bathed at the Trisaṅgama tīrtha for seven Sundays, (4)

16.175.s:
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu mahiṣīṃ tatra dāpayet ..
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu svargaloke mahīyate .. 5 ..
16.175.d:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा तु महिषीं तत्र दापयेत् ..
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु स्वर्गलोके महीयते .. 5 ..
16.175.m: and having fed brahmins, one should donate a female buffalo there. / For a thousand divine years, he is glorified in the heavenly world. (5)

16.175.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'rkasthalamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 175 ..
16.175.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽर्कस्थलमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 175 ..
16.175.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-fifth chapter, named “Description of the Māhātmya of Arkasthala,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [khaṇḍa], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. (175)

16.176.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi siddheśvaramiti smṛtam ..
arkasthalāttathā''gneyyāṃ nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.176.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि सिद्धेश्वरमिति स्मृतम् ..
अर्कस्थलात्तथा'ऽग्नेय्यां नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.176.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to what is known as Siddheśvara, / situated not very far off in the southeast from Arkasthala. (1)

16.176.s:
aṣṭādaśa sahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām ..
tasmim̐lliṃge tu siddhāni siddheśvaramataḥ smṛtam .. 2 ..
16.176.d:
अष्टादश सहस्राणि ऋषीणामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे तु सिद्धानि सिद्धेश्वरमतः स्मृतम् .. 2 ..
16.176.m: Eighteen thousand chaste seers / attained perfection at that liṅga; hence it is known as Siddheśvara. 2

16.176.s:
snātvā'rcayennaro bhaktyā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..
saṃpūjya vidhivaddevaṃ dadyādvipreṣu dakṣiṇām ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhastu sa yāti paramaṃ padam .. . ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāharūyā saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsajñetramāhātmye siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 176 ..
16.176.d:
स्नात्वाऽर्चयेन्नरो भक्त्या सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ..
संपूज्य विधिवद्देवं दद्याद्विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् ..
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्तु स याति परमं पदम् .. . ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहरूया संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासज्ञेत्रमाहात्म्ये सिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्सप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 176 ..
16.176.m:
Having bathed, a person should worship it with devotion, fasting and with senses controlled. / Having duly worshipped the god, he should give a fee to the brahmins; / fulfilled of all desires, he goes to the supreme abode.
Thus ends the hundred and seventy-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the māhātmya of Siddheśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 176

16.177.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge lakulīśastu mūrtimān ..
svayaṃ tiṣṭhati deveśi kṛtvā ghoraṃ tapaḥ purā .. 1 ..
16.177.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे लकुलीशस्तु मूर्तिमान् ..
स्वयं तिष्ठति देवेशि कृत्वा घोरं तपः पुरा .. 1 ..
16.177.m: Īśvara said: / To the east of that very [liṅga], Lakulīśa himself, embodied, / stands, O queen of the gods, having performed fierce austerity in ancient times. 1

16.177.s:
saṃsthitaḥ pāpaśamane tatra sthāne sthalopari ..
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ .. 2 ..
16.177.d:
संस्थितः पापशमने तत्र स्थाने स्थलोपरि ..
कार्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे यस्तं पूजयते नरः .. 2 ..
16.177.m: He is stationed on the high ground at that place, destroying sin. / Whosoever worships him on the full moon of Kārttika under the asterism Kṛttikā, 2
he is worshipped, O great goddess, by all the gods and asuras as well. 3

16.177.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye lakulīśamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptasaptatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 177 ..
16.177.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये लकुलीशमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तसप्तत्युत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः .. 177 ..
16.177.m: Thus ends the hundred and seventy-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the māhātmya of Lakulīśa', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 177

16.178.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasmāddakṣiṇataḥ sthitam ..
bhārgaveśvaranāmānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 1 ..
16.178.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्माद्दक्षिणतः स्थितम् ..
भार्गवेश्वरनामानं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.178.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the one situated to the south of it, / named Bhārgaveśvara, which destroys all sin. 1

16.178.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate devi divyapuṣpopahārakaiḥ ..
sa bhavetkṛtakṛtyastu sarvakāmaiḥ samṛddhimān .. 2 ..
16.178.d:
यस्तं पूजयते देवि दिव्यपुष्पोपहारकैः ..
स भवेत्कृतकृत्यस्तु सर्वकामैः समृद्धिमान् .. 2 ..
16.178.m: Whoever worships it, O goddess, with offerings of heavenly flowers, / he has accomplished his aims and abounds in all desired objects. 2

16.178.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhārgaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ- nāmāṣṭasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 178 ..
16.178.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भार्गवेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं- नामाष्टसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 178 ..
16.178.m: Thus ends the hundred and seventy-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the māhātmya of Bhārgaveśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 178

16.179.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
siddheśāddakṣiṇe koṇe dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam ..
māṇḍavyeśvaranāmānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.179.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
सिद्धेशाद्दक्षिणे कोणे धनुषां त्रितये स्थितम् ..
माण्डव्येश्वरनामानं महापातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.179.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga that destroys sin, / situated in the south corner, three bow-lengths from Siddheśa, / named Māṇḍavyeśvara, destroying heinous sins. 1

16.179.s:
māghe māse caturdaśyāṃ pūjāṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tathā ..
kuryādyo'tīndriyo martyo na sa martye punarvrajet .. 2 ..
16.179.d:
माघे मासे चतुर्दश्यां पूजां जागरणं तथा ..
कुर्याद्योऽतीन्द्रियो मर्त्यो न स मर्त्ये पुनर्व्रजेत् .. 2 ..
16.179.m: A mortal who, subduing the senses, performs worship and a vigil / on the fourteenth day of the month of Māgha, does not return to the mortal world. 2

16.179.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsajñetramāhātmye māṇḍavyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonā śītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 179 ..
16.179.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासज्ञेत्रमाहात्म्ये माण्डव्येश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोना शीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 179 ..
16.179.m: Thus ends the hundred and seventy-ninth chapter, named 'Description of the māhātmya of Māṇḍavyeśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 179

16.180.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyetpuṣpadanteśvaraṃ śubham ..
puṣpadanteśvaronāma gaṇeśaḥ śaṃkarasya tu ..1..
16.180.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येत्पुष्पदन्तेश्वरं शुभम् ..
पुष्पदन्तेश्वरोनाम गणेशः शंकरस्य तु ..1..
16.180.m: Īśvara said: / Right there one should view the auspicious Puṣpadanteśvara; / Puṣpadanta was indeed an attendant of Śaṃkara. 1

16.180.s: tena taptaṃ tapo ghoraṃ tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam .. 2 ..
16.180.d: तेन तप्तं तपो घोरं तत्र लिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 2 ..
16.180.m: Fierce austerity was performed by him, and that liṅga was installed there. 2

16.180.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate jaṃturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt ..
prāpnuyādīpsitānkāmāniha loke paratra ca .. 3 ..
16.180.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मुच्यते जंतुर्जन्मसंसारबन्धनात् ..
प्राप्नुयादीप्सितान्कामानिह लोके परत्र च .. 3 ..
16.180.m: Seeing it, a living being is freed from the bond of birth and worldly existence; / he obtains the cherished desires in this world and in the next. 3

16.180.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puṣpadanteśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 180 ..
16.180.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुष्पदन्तेश्वर माहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 180 ..
16.180.m: Thus ends the hundred and eightieth chapter, named 'Description of the māhātmya of Puṣpadanteśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 180

16.181.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kṣetrapeśvaramuttamam ..
siddheśvara samīpasthaṃ pūrvasminnātidūrataḥ .. 1 ..
16.181.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि क्षेत्रपेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
सिद्धेश्वर समीपस्थं पूर्वस्मिन्नातिदूरतः .. 1 ..
16.181.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the supreme Kṣetrapeśvara, / situated near Siddheśvara, not far to the east. 1

16.181.s: taṃ dṛṣṭvā śuklapañcamyāṃ na ca nāgaiḥ sa daśyate .. 2 ..
16.181.d: तं दृष्ट्वा शुक्लपञ्चम्यां न च नागैः स दश्यते .. 2 ..
16.181.m: Seeing it on the fifth day of the bright fortnight, he is not bitten by serpents. 2

16.181.s:
pūjayettaṃ vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt ..
bhojayedbrāhmaṇāñchaktyā bhakṣyabhojyairanekaśaḥ .. 3 ..
16.181.d:
पूजयेत्तं विधानेन गन्धपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् ..
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणाञ्छक्त्या भक्ष्यभोज्यैरनेकशः .. 3 ..
16.181.m: One should worship it according to the rules, in proper order, with perfumes, flowers, and the like, / and feed brahmins according to one's means with manifold foods and delicacies. 3

16.181.s: itiśrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye kṣetrapāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 181 .. ..
16.181.d: इतिश्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये क्षेत्रपालेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 181 .. ..
16.181.m: Thus ends the hundred and eighty-first chapter, named 'Description of the māhātmya of Kṣetrapāleśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 181

16.182.m: Then one should view the host of Mothers beginning with Vasunandā, / situated near Arkasthala, not far to the south. 1

16.182.s:
āśvayukchuklapakṣe tu navamyāṃ niyatātmavān ..
yastāḥ pūjayate mātṝrvidhinā bhāvitātmavān .. 2 ..
16.182.d:
आश्वयुक्छुक्लपक्षे तु नवम्यां नियतात्मवान् ..
यस्ताः पूजयते मातॄर्विधिना भावितात्मवान् .. 2 ..
16.182.m: A self-controlled person of purified soul who worships those Mothers / according to rule on the ninth day of the bright fortnight of Āśvina, 2

16.182.s:
sa samṛddhimavāpnoti durāpāmakṛtātmabhiḥ ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyecchrīmukhaṃ vivarapriyam .. 3 ..
16.182.d:
स समृद्धिमवाप्नोति दुरापामकृतात्मभिः ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येच्छ्रीमुखं विवरप्रियम् .. 3 ..
16.182.m: he attains prosperity that is difficult to obtain by the undisciplined. / Stationed right there, one should view Śrīmukha who is fond of the cavern. 3

16.182.s:
tasminneva dine pūjyaṃ siddhikāmairnaraiḥ sadā ..
etatpūrvaṃ mayākhyātaṃ tava vistarataḥ priye .. 4 ..
16.182.d:
तस्मिन्नेव दिने पूज्यं सिद्धिकामैर्नरैः सदा ..
एतत्पूर्वं मयाख्यातं तव विस्तरतः प्रिये .. 4 ..
16.182.m: On that very day it must always be worshipped by men seeking perfection. / This has been recounted by me previously in detail to you, my beloved. 4
It should be worshipped on that very day in the context of the pilgrimage to the sacred ford. 5

16.182.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vasunandāmātṛgaṇaśrīmukhavivara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 182 ..
16.182.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वसुनन्दामातृगणश्रीमुखविवर माहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्व्यशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 182 ..
16.182.m: Thus ends the hundred and eighty-second chapter, named 'Description of the māhātmya of the Mother-Host Vasunandā and the Śrīmukha Cavern', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 182

16.183.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi miśratīrthamanuttamam ..
trisaṃgameti vikhyātaṃ sauraṃ tīrthamanuttamam .. 1 ..
16.183.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि मिश्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
त्रिसंगमेति विख्यातं सौरं तीर्थमनुत्तमम् .. 1 ..
16.183.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the supreme Miśratīrtha, / renowned as Trisaṃgama, the supreme sacred ford of the Sun. 1

16.183.s:
sarasvatī hiraṇyā ca samudraścaiva bhāmini ..
trayāṇāṃ saṃgamo yatra duṣprāpyo daivatairapi .. 2 ..
16.183.d:
सरस्वती हिरण्या च समुद्रश्चैव भामिनि ..
त्रयाणां संगमो यत्र दुष्प्राप्यो दैवतैरपि .. 2 ..
16.183.m: The Sarasvatī, the Hiraṇyā, and the ocean, O beautiful lady— / the confluence of these three is difficult to reach even for the deities. 2

16.183.s:
sarveṣāṃ tatra tīrthānāṃ pradhānaṃ tīrthamuttamam ..
sūryaparvaṇi saṃprāpte kurukṣetrādviśiṣyate .. 3 ..
16.183.d:
सर्वेषां तत्र तीर्थानां प्रधानं तीर्थमुत्तमम् ..
सूर्यपर्वणि संप्राप्ते कुरुक्षेत्राद्विशिष्यते .. 3 ..
16.183.m: It is the chief, supreme sacred ford among all sacred fords there; / when an eclipse of the sun has arrived, it excels Kurukṣetra. 3

16.183.s: snānaṃ dānaṃ japastatra sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 4 ..
16.183.d: स्नानं दानं जपस्तत्र सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत् .. 4 ..
16.183.m: Ritual ablution, gifting, and silent recitation there all become multiplied ten-millionfold. 4

16.183.s:
maṃkīśvarānmahādevi yāvalliṃgaṃ kṛtasmaram ..
etasminnantare devi tīrthānāṃ daśakoṭayaḥ .. 5 ..
16.183.d:
मंकीश्वरान्महादेवि यावल्लिंगं कृतस्मरम् ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवि तीर्थानां दशकोटयः .. 5 ..
16.183.m: From Maṅkīśvara, O great goddess, up to the liṅga Kṛtasmara, / between these, O goddess, are a hundred million sacred fords. 5

16.183.s:
kṛmikīṭapataṃgāśca śvapacā vā narādhamāḥ ..
so'pi svargamavāpnoti kiṃ punarbhāvitātmavān .. 6 ..
16.183.d:
कृमिकीटपतंगाश्च श्वपचा वा नराधमाः ..
सोऽपि स्वर्गमवाप्नोति किं पुनर्भावितात्मवान् .. 6 ..
16.183.m: Even worms, insects, winged creatures, outcastes, or the vilest of men / attain heaven [there]—what then to say of one with a disciplined soul? 6

16.183.s:
tatra pītāni vastrāṇi kāñcanaṃ surabhistathā ..
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyā samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 7 ..
16.183.d:
तत्र पीतानि वस्त्राणि काञ्चनं सुरभिस्तथा ..
ब्राह्मणाय प्रदातव्या सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 7 ..
16.183.m: Yellow clothes, gold, and a cow / should be given there to a brahmin by those desiring the full fruit of the pilgrimage. 7

16.183.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ snātvā yastarpayetpitṝn ..
tarpitāḥ pitarastena yāvaccandrārkatārakam .. 8 ..
16.183.d:
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां स्नात्वा यस्तर्पयेत्पितॄन् ..
तर्पिताः पितरस्तेन यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकम् .. 8 ..
16.183.m: Having bathed on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, whoever offers libations to the ancestors— / by him the ancestors are satisfied as long as the moon, sun, and stars exist. 8

16.183.s:
etattrisaṃgamaṃ devi mahāpātakanāśanam ..
durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vaiśākhyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ .. 9 ..
16.183.d:
एतत्त्रिसंगमं देवि महापातकनाशनम् ..
दुर्लभं त्रिषु लोकेषु वैशाख्यां तु विशेषतः .. 9 ..
16.183.m: This Trisaṃgama, O goddess, destroys heinous sins; / it is rare in the three worlds, especially on the full-moon day of Vaiśākha. 9

16.183.s:
vṛṣo tsargo viśeṣeṇa tatra kāryo narottamaiḥ ..
sarvapāpavināśāya pitṝṇāṃ prītaye priye .. 7.1.183.10 ..
16.183.d:
वृषो त्सर्गो विशेषेण तत्र कार्यो नरोत्तमैः ..
सर्वपापविनाशाय पितॄणां प्रीतये प्रिये .. 7.1.183.10 ..
16.183.m: The setting free of a bull should especially be performed there by the best of men / for the destruction of all sins and for the gratification of the ancestors, O beloved. 10

16.183.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye trisaṃgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 183 ..
16.183.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये त्रिसंगममाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्र्यशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 183 ..
16.183.m: Thus ends the hundred and eighty-third chapter, named 'Description of the māhātmya of Trisaṃgama', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 183

16.184.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi maṃkīśvaramanuttamam ..
trisaṃgamasamīpasthaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam.. 1 ..
16.184.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि मंकीश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
त्रिसंगमसमीपस्थं सर्वपातकनाशनम्.. 1 ..
16.184.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unsurpassed Maṅkīśvara, / situated near Trisaṅgama, which destroys all sins.

16.184.s:
maṃkīnāma ṛṣiḥ pūrvamāsītsa tapatāṃ varaḥ ..
sa ca jñātvā mahākṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ śaṃkarapriyam .. 2 ..
16.184.d:
मंकीनाम ऋषिः पूर्वमासीत्स तपतां वरः ..
स च ज्ञात्वा महाक्षेत्रं प्रभासं शंकरप्रियम् .. 2 ..
16.184.m: Formerly there was a seer named Maṅkī, the best of those performing austerities. / Having recognized the great field of Prabhāsa, dear to Śaṃkara,

16.184.s:
atapadvai tapo ghoraṃ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ ..
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram .. 3 ..
16.184.d:
अतपद्वै तपो घोरं कन्दमूलफलाशनः ..
वर्षाणामयुतं साग्रं प्रतिष्ठाप्य महेश्वरम् .. 3 ..
16.184.m: he performed severe austerity, eating only roots, tubers, and fruits, / for fully ten thousand years, having installed Maheśvara.

16.184.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevo dadau prīto varaṃ tadā ..
sa vavre yadi tuṣṭo'si asminsthāne sthito bhava .. 4 ..
16.184.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो ददौ प्रीतो वरं तदा ..
स वव्रे यदि तुष्टोऽसि अस्मिन्स्थाने स्थितो भव .. 4 ..
16.184.m: Then Mahādeva, pleased, granted him a boon at that time. / He chose: "If you are pleased, remain in this place,
abiding as a liṅga marked with my name for tens of thousands of kalpas." / Saying "So be it," he then vanished right there.

16.184.s:
tadāprabhṛti talliṃgaṃ maṃkīśvaramiti śrutam..
māghe māse trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāmathāpi vā .. 6 ..
16.184.d:
तदाप्रभृति तल्लिंगं मंकीश्वरमिति श्रुतम्..
माघे मासे त्रयोदश्यां चतुर्दश्यामथापि वा .. 6 ..
16.184.m: From that time onwards, that liṅga became famed as Maṅkīśvara. / In the month of Māgha, on the thirteenth day or the fourteenth day,

16.184.s:
pūjyāḥ paṃcopacāreṇa prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ phalam ..
godānaṃ tatra vai deyaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 7 ..
16.184.d:
पूज्याः पंचोपचारेण प्राप्नुयादीप्सितं फलम् ..
गोदानं तत्र वै देयं सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 7 ..
16.184.m: he is to be worshipped with the fivefold offerings, and one will attain the desired fruit. / A gift of a cow should certainly be given there by those desiring the full fruit of pilgrimage.

16.184.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye maṃkīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 184 ..
16.184.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मंकीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुरशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 184 ..
16.184.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-fourth chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of Maṅkīśvara," in the first [section, named] Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section, named] Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.185.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devamātaramavyayām ..
maṃkīśānnairṛte bhāge gaurīrūpasamāśritām..
devamātā sarasvatyā nāma lokeṣu gīyate .. 1 ..
16.185.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवमातरमव्ययाम् ..
मंकीशान्नैरृते भागे गौरीरूपसमाश्रिताम्..
देवमाता सरस्वत्या नाम लोकेषु गीयते .. 1 ..
16.185.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to Devamātā, the imperishable, / in the south-western direction from Maṅkīśa, having assumed the form of Gaurī. / She is sung among the worlds as the Devamātā of Sarasvatī.

16.185.s:
pādukāsanasaṃsthā ca tatra devī sarasvatī ..
gaurīrūpeṇa sā tatra vaḍavāśritavigrahā .. 2 ..
16.185.d:
पादुकासनसंस्था च तत्र देवी सरस्वती ..
गौरीरूपेण सा तत्र वडवाश्रितविग्रहा .. 2 ..
16.185.m: There the goddess Sarasvatī is seated upon sandals, / having assumed her form resorting to the submarine mare in the form of Gaurī.

16.185.s:
mātṛvadrakṣitā devā vaḍavānalabhītitaḥ ..
devamāteti loke'smiṃ stataḥ sā vibudhaiḥ kṛtā .. 3 ..
16.185.d:
मातृवद्रक्षिता देवा वडवानलभीतितः ..
देवमातेति लोकेऽस्मिं स्ततः सा विबुधैः कृता .. 3 ..
16.185.m: Like a mother, the gods were protected [by her] from fear of the submarine fire. / Therefore she was made [famed as] Devamātā by the gods in this world.

16.185.s:
māghe māse tṛtīyāyāṃ yastāmarcayate naraḥ ..
nārī vā saṃyatā sādhvī sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 4 ..
16.185.d:
माघे मासे तृतीयायां यस्तामर्चयते नरः ..
नारी वा संयता साध्वी सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 4 ..
16.185.m: Whatever man worships her on the third day in the month of Māgha, / or a chaste woman who is self-controlled, will attain all desires.

16.185.s:
daṃpatī bhoja yedyastu pāyasaiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ ..
gaurīsahasrabhojyasya dattasya phalamāpnuyāt .. 5 ..
16.185.d:
दंपती भोज येद्यस्तु पायसैः शर्करादिभिः ..
गौरीसहस्रभोज्यस्य दत्तस्य फलमाप्नुयात् .. 5 ..
16.185.m: And whoever feeds a married couple with rice-pudding, sugar, and other sweets / attains the fruit of giving food to a thousand forms of Gaurī.
A pair of gold sandals should be given there to a virtuous brahmin.

16.185.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devamātṛgaurīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcā śītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 185 .. .. cha ..
16.185.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये देवमातृगौरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचा शीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 185 .. .. छ ..
16.185.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-fifth chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of Devamātṛgaurī," in the first [section, named] Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section, named] Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.186.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi nāgasthānamanuttamam ..
maṃkīśātpaścime bhāge saṃgamatritayaṃ gatam .. 1 ..
16.186.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि नागस्थानमनुत्तमम् ..
मंकीशात्पश्चिमे भागे संगमत्रितयं गतम् .. 1 ..
16.186.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unsurpassed place of the serpents, / in the western direction from Maṅkīśa, which has reached the confluence of three [rivers].
It destroys the sins of all creatures and is the great entrance to Pātāla.

16.186.s:
balabhadraḥ purā devi śrutvā kṛṣṇasya paṃcatām ..
bhallatīrthe tu bhallena tataḥ prabhāsamāgataḥ .. 3 ..
16.186.d:
बलभद्रः पुरा देवि श्रुत्वा कृष्णस्य पंचताम् ..
भल्लतीर्थे तु भल्लेन ततः प्रभासमागतः .. 3 ..
16.186.m: Formerly, O goddess, having heard of Kṛṣṇa's death / by an arrow at Bhallatīrtha, Balabhadra then came to Prabhāsa.

16.186.s:
kṣetraṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi jñātvā sarvārthasiddhidam ..
yādavānāṃ kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato vairāgyameyivān .. .. 4 ..
16.186.d:
क्षेत्रं महाप्रभावं हि ज्ञात्वा सर्वार्थसिद्धिदम् ..
यादवानां क्षयं कृत्वा ततो वैराग्यमेयिवान् .. .. 4 ..
16.186.m: Knowing the field of great efficacy that grants the fulfillment of all purposes, / and having witnessed the destruction of the Yādavas, he then attained detachment.

16.186.s:
śeṣanāgeśarūpeṇa niṣkramya ca śarīrataḥ ..
gacchangacchaṃstadā prāpya tīrthaṃ traisaṃgamaṃ param .. 5 ..
16.186.d:
शेषनागेशरूपेण निष्क्रम्य च शरीरतः ..
गच्छन्गच्छंस्तदा प्राप्य तीर्थं त्रैसंगमं परम् .. 5 ..
16.186.m: Emerging from his body in the form of the lord of serpents, Śeṣa, / and departing, he then reached the supreme sacred ford of the triple confluence.

16.186.s:
pātālasya tadā dṛṣṭvā dvāraṃ vivararūpakam ..
praviṣṭo'tha jagāmāśu yatrānaṃtaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ .. 6 ..
16.186.d:
पातालस्य तदा दृष्ट्वा द्वारं विवररूपकम् ..
प्रविष्टोऽथ जगामाशु यत्रानंतः स्वयं स्थितः .. 6 ..
16.186.m: Then, seeing the door of Pātāla in the form of a chasm, / having entered, he quickly went to where Ananta himself resides.

16.186.s:
yato nāgasvarūpeṇa sthāne'smiṃśca samāviśat ..
tatprabhṛtyeva deveśi nāgasthānamiti śrutam .. 7 ..
16.186.d:
यतो नागस्वरूपेण स्थानेऽस्मिंश्च समाविशत् ..
तत्प्रभृत्येव देवेशि नागस्थानमिति श्रुतम् .. 7 ..
16.186.m: Because he entered this place in the form of a serpent, / ever since then, O ruler of the gods, it has been known as Nāgasthāna.

16.186.s:
nāgarādityapūrveṇa yatra kāyo visarjitaḥ ..
tadadyāpi prasiddhaṃ vai śeṣasthānamiti śrutam .. 8 ..
16.186.d:
नागरादित्यपूर्वेण यत्र कायो विसर्जितः ..
तदद्यापि प्रसिद्धं वै शेषस्थानमिति श्रुतम् .. 8 ..
16.186.m: To the east of Nāgarāditya, where his body was cast off, / that place is renowned even today, known as Śeṣasthāna.

16.186.s:
ataḥ snātvā mahādevi tatra tīrthe trisaṃgame .
nāgasthānaṃ samabhyarcya pañcamyāmakṛtāśanaḥ ..9..
16.186.d:
अतः स्नात्वा महादेवि तत्र तीर्थे त्रिसंगमे .
नागस्थानं समभ्यर्च्य पञ्चम्यामकृताशनः ..9..
16.186.m: Therefore, having bathed, O great goddess, at that sacred ford of Trisaṅgama, / and having properly worshipped Nāgasthāna on the fifth day, fasting,

16.186.s:
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāśaktyā dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām ..
vimuktaḥ sarvaduḥkhebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .. 10 ..
16.186.d:
श्राद्धं कृत्वा यथाशक्त्या दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ..
विमुक्तः सर्वदुःखेभ्यो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .. 10 ..
16.186.m: having performed a śrāddha according to one's capacity, and having given a priestly fee to a brahmin, / freed from all sorrows, he goes to the world of Rudra.

16.186.s:
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃmiśraṃ bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ samanvitam ..
śeṣanāgaṃ samuddiśya vipraṃ yastatra bhojayet ..
koṭibhojyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 11 ..
16.186.d:
पायसं मधुसंमिश्रं भक्ष्यभोज्यैः समन्वितम् ..
शेषनागं समुद्दिश्य विप्रं यस्तत्र भोजयेत् ..
कोटिभोज्यं कृतं तेन जायते नात्र संशयः .. 11 ..
16.186.m: Whoever feeds a brahmin there with rice-pudding mixed with honey, / accompanied by various dishes and foodstuffs, dedicating it to Śeṣanāga, / has provided food for ten million [people]—there is no doubt about this.

16.186.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nāga sthānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 186 ..
16.186.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नाग स्थानमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षडशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 186 ..
16.186.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-sixth chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of Nāgasthāna," in the first [section, named] Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section, named] Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.187.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi sarvakāmaphalapradam ..
prabhāsapaṃcakaṃ puṇyamādyaṃ tatra vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.187.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ..
प्रभासपंचकं पुण्यमाद्यं तत्र व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.187.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to that which bestows the fruit of all desires: / the holy, primeval group of five Prabhāsas established there.

16.187.s:
tasyaiva paścime bhāge prabhāsa iti cocyate ..
vṛddhaprabhāsaśca tato dakṣiṇe nātidūrataḥ .. 2 ..
16.187.d:
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे प्रभास इति चोच्यते ..
वृद्धप्रभासश्च ततो दक्षिणे नातिदूरतः .. 2 ..
16.187.m: In the western part of that very place is what is called Prabhāsa; / and from there, to the south, not very far, is Vṛddhaprabhāsa;

16.187.s:
jala prabhāsaśca tato dakṣiṇena varānane ..
kṛtasmaraprabhāsaśca śmaśānaṃ yatra bhairavam .. 3 ..
16.187.d:
जल प्रभासश्च ततो दक्षिणेन वरानने ..
कृतस्मरप्रभासश्च श्मशानं यत्र भैरवम् .. 3 ..
16.187.m: and to the south from that is Jalaprabhāsa, O fair-faced one; / and Kṛtasmaraprabhāsa, where the fearsome cremation ground is.

16.187.s:
evaṃ paṃcaprabhāsānyaḥ paśyedbhaktayā samanvitaḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam .. 4 ..
16.187.d:
एवं पंचप्रभासान्यः पश्येद्भक्तया समन्वितः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं जरामरणवर्जितम् .. 4 ..
16.187.m: In this way, whoever sees the five Prabhāsas filled with devotion / goes to the supreme abode, free from old age and death.

16.187.s:
na nivartati yatprāpya duṣprāpyaṃ tridaśairapi ..
prabhāsaṃ prathamaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam .. 5 ..
16.187.d:
न निवर्तति यत्प्राप्य दुष्प्राप्यं त्रिदशैरपि ..
प्रभासं प्रथमं तीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् .. 5 ..
16.187.m: Having reached it, one does not return—it is difficult to attain even by the gods. / Prabhāsa is the foremost sacred ford, renowned across the three worlds,

16.187.s:
devānāmapi duṣprāpyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ..
prabhāse tvekarātreṇa amāvāsyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ .. 6 ..
16.187.d:
देवानामपि दुष्प्राप्यं महापातकनाशनम् ..
प्रभासे त्वेकरात्रेण अमावास्यां कृतोदकः .. 6 ..
16.187.m: difficult to attain even for the gods, destroying great sins. / Offering water at Prabhāsa on the new moon day, having spent a single night,

16.187.s:
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati ..
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame .. 7 ..
16.187.d:
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैः शिवलोकं स गच्छति ..
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं गंगासागरसंगमे .. 7 ..
16.187.m: one is freed from all sins and goes to the world of Śiva. / The sin committed in seven births [is destroyed] at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean;

16.187.s:
janmanāṃ ca sahasreṇa yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
snānādevāsya naśyeta sāgare lavaṇāṃbhasi .. 8 ..
16.187.d:
जन्मनां च सहस्रेण यत्पापं कुरुते नरः ..
स्नानादेवास्य नश्येत सागरे लवणांभसि .. 8 ..
16.187.m: and whatever sin a man commits over a thousand births / is destroyed merely by a bath here in the salt waters of the ocean.

16.187.s:
caturdaśyāmamāvāsyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā brāhmaṇānbhojya śaktitaḥ .. 9 ..
16.187.d:
चतुर्दश्याममावास्यां पञ्चदश्यां विशेषतः ..
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा ब्राह्मणान्भोज्य शक्तितः .. 9 ..
16.187.m: Especially on the fourteenth day and the new moon or fifteenth day, / having fasted for a day and night, and having fed brahmins according to one's means,

16.187.s:
dattvā gāṃ kāṃcanaṃ tebhyaḥ śivaḥ prīto bhavatviti ..
evaṃ kṛtvā naro devi kulānāṃ tārayecchatam .. 7.1.187.10 ..
16.187.d:
दत्त्वा गां कांचनं तेभ्यः शिवः प्रीतो भवत्विति ..
एवं कृत्वा नरो देवि कुलानां तारयेच्छतम् .. 7.1.187.10 ..
16.187.m: having given a cow and gold to them, saying, "May Śiva be pleased"— / having done thus, O goddess, a man delivers a hundred generations of his family.

16.187.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
prabhāsapaṃcakaṃ hyetadyattvayā parikīrtitam ..
kathamatra samudbhūtametanme kautukaṃ mahat .. 11 ..
16.187.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
प्रभासपंचकं ह्येतद्यत्त्वया परिकीर्तितम् ..
कथमत्र समुद्भूतमेतन्मे कौतुकं महत् .. 11 ..
16.187.m: The goddess said: / This group of five Prabhāsas that has been proclaimed by you— / how did it originate here? This is my great curiosity.

16.187.s:
eka eva śruto'smābhiḥ prabhāsastīrthavāsitaḥ ..
prabhāsāḥ paṃca deveśa yattvayā parikīrtitāḥ .. 12 ..
16.187.d:
एक एव श्रुतोऽस्माभिः प्रभासस्तीर्थवासितः ..
प्रभासाः पंच देवेश यत्त्वया परिकीर्तिताः .. 12 ..
16.187.m: Only one Prabhāsa, inhabited by sacred fords, was heard of by us; / yet five Prabhāsas have been proclaimed by you, O lord of gods.

16.187.s: etanme saṃśayaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. .. 13 ..
16.187.d: एतन्मे संशयं सर्वं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. .. 13 ..
16.187.m: You ought to resolve this entire doubt of mine according to reality.

16.187.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm ..
yāṃ śrutvā mānavo bhaktyā prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim .. 14 ..
16.187.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि कथां पापप्रणाशनीम् ..
यां श्रुत्वा मानवो भक्त्या प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् .. 14 ..
16.187.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall tell the story that destroys sins, / hearing which with devotion, a mortal attains the supreme goal.

16.187.s:
purā maheśvaro devaścacāra vasudhāmimām ..
divyarūpadharaḥ kānto digvāsāḥ sa yadṛcchayā .. 15 ..
16.187.d:
पुरा महेश्वरो देवश्चचार वसुधामिमाम् ..
दिव्यरूपधरः कान्तो दिग्वासाः स यदृच्छया .. 15 ..
16.187.m: Formerly the god Maheśvara wandered upon this earth, / handsome, bearing a divine form, naked as the sky, according to his pleasure.

16.187.s:
evaṃ ca ramamāṇastu ṛṣīṇāmāśramaṃ mahat ..
jagāma kautukāviṣṭo bhikṣārthaṃ dāruke vane .. 16 ..
16.187.d:
एवं च रममाणस्तु ऋषीणामाश्रमं महत् ..
जगाम कौतुकाविष्टो भिक्षार्थं दारुके वने .. 16 ..
16.187.m: And sporting thus, filled with curiosity, / he went to the great hermitage of the seers in the Dāruka forest for alms.

16.187.s:
bhramamāṇasya tasyātha dṛṣṭvā rūpamanuttamam ..
tā nāryaḥ kāmasaṃtaptā babhūvurvyathitendriyāḥ .. 17 ..
16.187.d:
भ्रममाणस्य तस्याथ दृष्ट्वा रूपमनुत्तमम् ..
ता नार्यः कामसंतप्ता बभूवुर्व्यथितेन्द्रियाः .. 17 ..
16.187.m: Then, seeing his incomparable form as he wandered, / those women were tormented by desire, their senses perturbed.

16.187.s:
sānurāgāstataḥ sarvā anugacchaṃti taṃ sadā ..
samāliṃgaṃti tāḥ kāścitkāśca vīkṣaṃti rāgataḥ .. 18 ..
16.187.d:
सानुरागास्ततः सर्वा अनुगच्छंति तं सदा ..
समालिंगंति ताः काश्चित्काश्च वीक्षंति रागतः .. 18 ..
16.187.m: Full of passion, they all followed him constantly; / some embraced him, and others gazed with passion.

16.187.s: prārthayaṃti tathā cānyāḥ parityajya gṛhānsvakān .. 19 ..
16.187.d: प्रार्थयंति तथा चान्याः परित्यज्य गृहान्स्वकान् .. 19 ..
16.187.m: And others entreatingly abandoned their own homes.

16.187.s:
evaṃ tāsāṃ svarūpaṃ te dṛṣṭvā sarve maharṣayaḥ ..
kopena mahatā yuktāḥ śepustaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam .. .. 7.1.187.20 ..
16.187.d:
एवं तासां स्वरूपं ते दृष्ट्वा सर्वे महर्षयः ..
कोपेन महता युक्ताः शेपुस्तं वृषभध्वजम् .. .. 7.1.187.20 ..
16.187.m: Seeing that condition of theirs, all those great seers, / filled with great anger, cursed him who bears the bull upon his banner:

16.187.s:
yasmāttvaṃ nagnatāmetya āśrame'sminmamāgataḥ ..
mohayānaḥ striyo'smākaṃ lajjāṃ naivaṃ karoṣi ca ..
tasmātte patatālliṃgaṃ sadya eva vṛṣadhvaja .. 21 ..
16.187.d:
यस्मात्त्वं नग्नतामेत्य आश्रमेऽस्मिन्ममागतः ..
मोहयानः स्त्रियोऽस्माकं लज्जां नैवं करोषि च ..
तस्मात्ते पतताल्लिंगं सद्य एव वृषध्वज .. 21 ..
16.187.m: "Because you have come naked into this hermitage of ours, / bewitching our women and feeling no shame at all, / therefore let your liṅga fall down this very moment, O bull-bannered one!"

16.187.s:
tatastatpatitaṃ liṃgaṃ tatkṣaṇācchaṃkarasya ca ..
tasminprapatite bhūmau prākaṃpata vasuṃdharā .. 22 ..
16.187.d:
ततस्तत्पतितं लिंगं तत्क्षणाच्छंकरस्य च ..
तस्मिन्प्रपतिते भूमौ प्राकंपत वसुंधरा .. 22 ..
16.187.m: Then that liṅga of Śaṃkara fell at that very instant; / and when it fell onto the earth, the earth trembled violently.

16.187.s:
kṣubhitāḥ sāgarāḥ sarve maryādā vijahustadā ..
śīrṇāni giriśṛṃgāṇi trastāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ .. 23 ..
16.187.d:
क्षुभिताः सागराः सर्वे मर्यादा विजहुस्तदा ..
शीर्णानि गिरिशृंगाणि त्रस्ताः सर्वे दिवौकसः .. 23 ..
16.187.m: All the oceans were agitated; then they transgressed their bounds; / the mountain peaks shattered; all the gods were terrified.

16.187.s:
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ samahoragakinnarāḥ ..
ūcuḥ pitāmahaṃ gatvā kimetatkāraṇaṃ vibho .. 24 ..
16.187.d:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः समहोरगकिन्नराः ..
ऊचुः पितामहं गत्वा किमेतत्कारणं विभो .. 24 ..
16.187.m: Then the gods, accompanied by the gandharvas, great serpents, and kinnaras, / went to the Grandfather and said: "O all-pervading lord, what is the cause of this,

16.187.s:
sāgarāḥ kṣubhitā yena plāvayaṃti vasuṃdharām ..
śīryaṃte giriśṛṅgāṇi kaṃpate ca vasuṃdharā .. 25 ..
16.187.d:
सागराः क्षुभिता येन प्लावयंति वसुंधराम् ..
शीर्यंते गिरिशृङ्गाणि कंपते च वसुंधरा .. 25 ..
16.187.m: whereby the agitated oceans are flooding the earth, / the mountain peaks are shattering, and the earth is trembling?

16.187.s:
cihnāni lokanāśāya dṛśyante dāruṇāni ca ..
teṣāṃ tadvacana śrutvā brahmaloke pitāmahaḥ .. 26 ..
16.187.d:
चिह्नानि लोकनाशाय दृश्यन्ते दारुणानि च ..
तेषां तद्वचन श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मलोके पितामहः .. 26 ..
16.187.m: Dreadful portents are seen indicating the destruction of the worlds." / Hearing that speech of theirs in the realm of Brahmā, the Grandfather,

16.187.s:
dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ vākyametaduvāca ha ..
śivaliṃgaṃ nipatitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ surasattamāḥ .. 27 ..
16.187.d:
ध्यात्वा तु सुचिरं कालं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..
शिवलिंगं निपतितं पृथिव्यां सुरसत्तमाः .. 27 ..
16.187.m: having meditated for a very long time, indeed spoke these words: / "The Śivaliṅga has fallen down upon the earth, O best of the gods,

16.187.s:
śāpena ṛṣimukhyānāṃ bhārgavāṇāṃ mahātmanām ..
tasminnipatite bhūmau trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 28 ..
16.187.d:
शापेन ऋषिमुख्यानां भार्गवाणां महात्मनाम् ..
तस्मिन्निपतिते भूमौ त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 28 ..
16.187.m: by the curse of the foremost seers, the magnanimous Bhārgavas. / When it fell onto the earth, the three worlds, with all that moves and is still,

16.187.s:
etadavasthatāṃ prāptaṃ tasmāttatraiva gamyatām ..
viṣṇunā saha gīrvāṇāstathā nītirvidhīyatām .. 29 ..
16.187.d:
एतदवस्थतां प्राप्तं तस्मात्तत्रैव गम्यताम् ..
विष्णुना सह गीर्वाणास्तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् .. 29 ..
16.187.m: reached this condition; therefore go to that very place. / O gods, together with Viṣṇu, let proper conduct be undertaken."

16.187.s:
tataḥ kṣīrodadhiṃ jagmurbrahmādyāstridivaukasaḥ ..
yatra śete caturbāhuryoganidrāṃ ca saṃgataḥ .. 7.1.187.30 ..
16.187.d:
ततः क्षीरोदधिं जग्मुर्ब्रह्माद्यास्त्रिदिवौकसः ..
यत्र शेते चतुर्बाहुर्योगनिद्रां च संगतः .. 7.1.187.30 ..
16.187.m: Then the gods, headed by Brahmā, went to the Ocean of Milk, / where the four-armed one lies, absorbed in yoganidrā.

16.187.s:
tasmai sarvaṃ samācakhyustenaiva sahitāstataḥ ..
jagmuryatra mahādevo liṃgena rahito vibhuḥ .. 31 ..
16.187.d:
तस्मै सर्वं समाचख्युस्तेनैव सहितास्ततः ..
जग्मुर्यत्र महादेवो लिंगेन रहितो विभुः .. 31 ..
16.187.m: They reported everything to him; then, accompanied by him, / they went to where the all-pervading Mahādeva was, bereft of his liṅga.

16.187.s: ūcuḥ samāhitāḥ sarve praṇipatya divaukasaḥ ..32..
16.187.d: ऊचुः समाहिताः सर्वे प्रणिपत्य दिवौकसः ..32..
16.187.m: All the gods, bowing down with concentrated minds, said:

16.187.s:
liṃgamutkṣipyatāmetadyatkṣitau patitaṃ vibho ..
ete mahārṇavāḥ sarve plāvayaṃti vasuṃdharām ..33..
16.187.d:
लिंगमुत्क्षिप्यतामेतद्यत्क्षितौ पतितं विभो ..
एते महार्णवाः सर्वे प्लावयंति वसुंधराम् ..33..
16.187.m: "Let this liṅga that has fallen upon the earth be lifted up, O all-pervading lord! / All these great oceans are inundating the earth."

16.187.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
ṛṣibhiḥ pātitaṃ hyetanmama liṃgaṃ sureśvarāḥ ..
na tu śakyo mayā kartuṃ bādhasteṣāṃ mahātmanām ..34..
16.187.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
ऋषिभिः पातितं ह्येतन्मम लिंगं सुरेश्वराः ..
न तु शक्यो मया कर्तुं बाधस्तेषां महात्मनाम् ..34..
16.187.m: The Blessed One said: / "Indeed, this liṅga of mine has been brought down by the seers, O lords of the gods; / and I am unable to cause injury to those magnanimous ones.

16.187.s:
śāpo hi bhārgavendrāṇāmato me śrūyatāṃ vacaḥ ..
pūjayadhvaṃ surāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇupurassarāḥ ..35..
16.187.d:
शापो हि भार्गवेन्द्राणामतो मे श्रूयतां वचः ..
पूजयध्वं सुराः सर्वे ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरस्सराः ..35..
16.187.m: For it is the curse of the foremost of the Bhārgavas; therefore listen to my words: / let all the gods, headed by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, worship

16.187.s:
liṃgametattataḥ sarve sarvaṃ lipsatha sattamāḥ ..
prakṛtiṃ sāgarāḥ sarve yāsyaṃti girayastathā .. 36 ..
16.187.d:
लिंगमेतत्ततः सर्वे सर्वं लिप्सथ सत्तमाः ..
प्रकृतिं सागराः सर्वे यास्यंति गिरयस्तथा .. 36 ..
16.187.m: this liṅga; then, O best of beings, you will obtain everything. / All the oceans, and likewise the mountains, will return to their natural state.

16.187.s:
etatpuṇyatame kṣetre dhṛtvā sarve samāhitāḥ ..
athoddhṛtya surāḥ sarve prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ ..37..
16.187.d:
एतत्पुण्यतमे क्षेत्रे धृत्वा सर्वे समाहिताः ..
अथोद्धृत्य सुराः सर्वे प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागताः ..37..
16.187.m: Bearing it with concentrated minds in this most holy sacred field—" / Then, having lifted it up, all the gods came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.187.s:
tatraiva nidadhuḥ sarve tataḥ pūjāṃ pracakrire ..
brahmaṇā pūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā .. 38 ..
16.187.d:
तत्रैव निदधुः सर्वे ततः पूजां प्रचक्रिरे ..
ब्रह्मणा पूजितं लिंगं विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना .. 38 ..
16.187.m: They placed it down there, and then performed its worship. / The liṅga was worshipped by Brahmā and by Viṣṇu the mighty lord,

16.187.s:
śakreṇātha kubereṇa yamena varuṇena ca ..
ūcuścaiva tato devā liṃgaṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ .. 39 ..
16.187.d:
शक्रेणाथ कुबेरेण यमेन वरुणेन च ..
ऊचुश्चैव ततो देवा लिंगं संपूज्य भक्तितः .. 39 ..
16.187.m: and by Śakra, Kubera, Yama, and Varuṇa. / And having worshipped the liṅga with devotion, the gods then said:

16.187.s:
adyaprabhṛti rudrasya liṃgaṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ ..
bhaviṣyāmo na saṃdehastathā pitṛgaṇāśca ye .. 7.1.187.40 ..
16.187.d:
अद्यप्रभृति रुद्रस्य लिंगं संपूज्य भक्तितः ..
भविष्यामो न संदेहस्तथा पितृगणाश्च ये .. 7.1.187.40 ..
16.187.m: "From this day forth, having worshipped the liṅga of Rudra with devotion, / we shall endure, there is no doubt, and likewise the host of the ancestors.

16.187.s:
ya enaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti bhaktiyuktāśca mānavāḥ ..
yāsyaṃti te surāvāsaṃ saśarīrā narottamāḥ .. 41 ..
16.187.d:
य एनं पूजयिष्यंति भक्तियुक्ताश्च मानवाः ..
यास्यंति ते सुरावासं सशरीरा नरोत्तमाः .. 41 ..
16.187.m: Those mortals who worship it endowed with devotion, / those best of men will go to the abode of the gods in their physical bodies.

16.187.s:
atraiva prathamaṃ ligaṃ yatosmā'bhiḥ pratiṣṭhitam ..
prabhāsaṃ nāma cāsyāpi prabhāseti bhaviṣyati .. 42 ..
16.187.d:
अत्रैव प्रथमं लिगं यतोस्माऽभिः प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
प्रभासं नाम चास्यापि प्रभासेति भविष्यति .. 42 ..
16.187.m: Because this first liṅga was established by us right here, / its name also shall be Prabhāsa at Prabhāsa."

16.187.s:
evamuktvā gatāḥ sarve tridivaṃ surasattamāḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tridivaṃ yānti bhūyāṃsaḥ prāṇino bhuvi .. 43 ..
16.187.d:
एवमुक्त्वा गताः सर्वे त्रिदिवं सुरसत्तमाः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा त्रिदिवं यान्ति भूयांसः प्राणिनो भुवि .. 43 ..
16.187.m: Having spoken thus, all the best of the gods went to heaven. / Having seen it, abundant living beings on earth go to heaven.

16.187.s:
tatastriviṣṭapaṃ vyāptaṃ bahubhiḥ prāṇibhiḥ priye ..
taddṛṣṭvā tridivaṃ vyāptaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ .. 44 ..
16.187.d:
ततस्त्रिविष्टपं व्याप्तं बहुभिः प्राणिभिः प्रिये ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा त्रिदिवं व्याप्तं सहस्राक्षः सुदुःखितः .. 44 ..
16.187.m: Then heaven was filled with many living beings, O dear one. / Seeing heaven overcrowded, the thousand-eyed one became deeply distressed.

16.187.s:
jñātvā liṃgaprabhāvaṃ tu tataścāgatya bhūtalam ..
vajreṇācchādayāmāsa samaṃtātsa varānane .. 45 ..
16.187.d:
ज्ञात्वा लिंगप्रभावं तु ततश्चागत्य भूतलम् ..
वज्रेणाच्छादयामास समंतात्स वरानने .. 45 ..
16.187.m: Understanding the power of the liṅga, he then came to the surface of the earth; / he covered it completely all around with his vajra, O fair-faced one.

16.187.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti no devi svargaṃ gacchaṃti mānavāḥ ..
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaḥ prabhāsasya mahodayaḥ ..
sarvapāpopaśamanaḥ sarvakāmaphalaṃ pradaḥ ..46..
16.187.d:
ततः प्रभृति नो देवि स्वर्गं गच्छंति मानवाः ..
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तः प्रभासस्य महोदयः ..
सर्वपापोपशमनः सर्वकामफलं प्रदः ..46..
16.187.m: From then on, O goddess, mortals do not go to heaven [so easily]. / Thus, in brief, the great majesty of Prabhāsa has been proclaimed, / which removes all sins and grants the fruit of all desires.

16.187.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathameprabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prabhāsapañcakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 187 ..
16.187.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमेप्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये प्रभासपञ्चकमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्ताशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 187 ..
16.187.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of the Five Prabhāsas', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.188.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tatra sthāne tu saṃsthitam ..
rudreśvaretināmānaṃ svayaṃbhūtaṃ dharātale .. 1 ..
16.188.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तत्र स्थाने तु संस्थितम् ..
रुद्रेश्वरेतिनामानं स्वयंभूतं धरातले .. 1 ..
16.188.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the one situated in that place, / self-manifest on the surface of the earth, known by the name Rudreśvara,

16.188.s:
ādiprabhāsātpurato dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam ..
rudreṇa dhyānamāsthāya svaṃ tejastatra yojitam .. 2 ..
16.188.d:
आदिप्रभासात्पुरतो धनुषां त्रितये स्थितम् ..
रुद्रेण ध्यानमास्थाय स्वं तेजस्तत्र योजितम् .. 2 ..
16.188.m: situated three bow-lengths in front of Ādiprabhāsa. / Resorting to meditation, Rudra united his own splendour there.

16.188.s:
tato rudreśvaraṃnāma sarvapātakanāśanam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 3 ..
16.188.d:
ततो रुद्रेश्वरंनाम सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा च सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 3 ..
16.188.m: Thence arose the name Rudreśvara, destroying all grave sins. / Having seen and worshipped it, one obtains all desires.

16.188.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rudreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 188 ..
16.188.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रुद्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 188 ..
16.188.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-eighth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Rudreśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.189.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva paścime bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
caṇḍikā karmamoṭī ca yoginī koṭisaṃyutā ..
pīṭhatrayaṃ mahādevi ādyaṃ trailokyavanditam .. 1 ..
16.189.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
चण्डिका कर्ममोटी च योगिनी कोटिसंयुता ..
पीठत्रयं महादेवि आद्यं त्रैलोक्यवन्दितम् .. 1 ..
16.189.m: Īśvara said: / In the western part of that very place, situated not far away, / are Caṇḍikā, Karmamoṭī, and the Yoginī accompanied by ten million [others]— / the three primordial seats praised in the three worlds, O great goddess.

16.189.s:
navamyāṃ tatra saṃpūjya devīpīṭhaṃ ca yoginīm ..
sa sarvānprāpnuyātkāmānbhavetsvargāṃganāpriyaḥ .. 2 ..
16.189.d:
नवम्यां तत्र संपूज्य देवीपीठं च योगिनीम् ..
स सर्वान्प्राप्नुयात्कामान्भवेत्स्वर्गांगनाप्रियः .. 2 ..
16.189.m: Worshipping the seat of the Goddess and the Yoginī there on the ninth day, / one will obtain all desires and become dear to heavenly maidens.

16.189.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsajñetramāhātmye karmamoṭīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 189 ..
16.189.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासज्ञेत्रमाहात्म्ये कर्ममोटीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोननवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 189 ..
16.189.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-ninth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Karmamoṭī', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.190.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tatra muktipradaṃ harim ..
prabhāsānnairṛte bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.190.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तत्र मुक्तिप्रदं हरिम् ..
प्रभासान्नैरृते भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.190.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to Hari who grants liberation, / situated in the south-western direction from Prabhāsa, not very far away.

16.190.s:
ekādaśyāṃ jitāhāro yastaṃ devi prapūjayet ..
māghemāse viśeṣeṇa so'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. 2 ..
16.190.d:
एकादश्यां जिताहारो यस्तं देवि प्रपूजयेत् ..
माघेमासे विशेषेण सोऽग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् .. 2 ..
16.190.m: Whoever worships him on an Ekādaśī, having conquered his diet, / especially in the month of Māgha, O goddess, obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

16.190.s:
yastatrānaśanaṃ kuryādvrataṃ cāndrāyaṇādikam ..
so'nya tīrthātkoṭiguṇaṃ prāpnuyātphalamīpsitam .. 3 ..
16.190.d:
यस्तत्रानशनं कुर्याद्व्रतं चान्द्रायणादिकम् ..
सोऽन्य तीर्थात्कोटिगुणं प्राप्नुयात्फलमीप्सितम् .. 3 ..
16.190.m: Whoever fasts there or observes vows such as the Cāndrāyaṇa / obtains the desired fruit ten million times greater than at any other sacred ford.

16.190.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye mokṣasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 190 ..
16.190.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये मोक्षस्वामिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम नवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 190 ..
16.190.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninetieth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Mokṣasvāmin', in the first [part], 'Glory of the Prabhāsa Field', of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.191.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi ajīgarteśvaraṃ haram ..
candravāpīsamīpasthaṃ karmamoṭīsamīpataḥ .. 1 ..
16.191.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि अजीगर्तेश्वरं हरम् ..
चन्द्रवापीसमीपस्थं कर्ममोटीसमीपतः .. 1 ..
16.191.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to Hara as Ajīgarteśvara, / located near the Candravāpī, close to Karmamoṭī.

16.191.s:
tasyāṃ snātvā mahādevi yastalligaṃ prapūjayet ..
sa muktaḥ pātakairghorairgacchecchivapadaṃ mahat .. 2 ..
16.191.d:
तस्यां स्नात्वा महादेवि यस्तल्लिगं प्रपूजयेत् ..
स मुक्तः पातकैर्घोरैर्गच्छेच्छिवपदं महत् .. 2 ..
16.191.m: Having bathed in it, O great goddess, whoever worships that liṅga / is freed from terrible sins and goes to the supreme abode of Śiva.

16.191.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'jīgarteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 191 ..
16.191.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽजीगर्तेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 191 ..
16.191.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-first chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Ajīgarteśvara', in the first [part], 'Glory of the Prabhāsa Field', of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.192.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi viśvakarmapratiṣṭhitam ..
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi mokṣasvāmina uttare .. 1 ..
16.192.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि विश्वकर्मप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
लिंगं महाप्रभावं हि मोक्षस्वामिन उत्तरे .. 1 ..
16.192.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga of great power / installed by Viśvakarman, to the north of Mokṣasvāmin,
situated five bows away, O goddess, which destroys sin.

16.192.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ samyagyātrāphalamavāpnuyāt ..
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ darśanāttasya naśyati .. 3 ..
16.192.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवः सम्यग्यात्राफलमवाप्नुयात् ..
वाचिकं मानसं पापं दर्शनात्तस्य नश्यति .. 3 ..
16.192.m: Having seen it, a man fully attains the fruit of pilgrimage; / sin committed by speech or mind is destroyed upon sight of it.

16.192.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye viśvakarmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvinavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 192 ..
16.192.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विश्वकर्मेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 192 ..
16.192.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-second chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Viśvakarmeśvara', in the first [part], 'Glory of the Prabhāsa Field', of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.193.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi yameśvaramanuttamam ..
tasyaiva nairṛte bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.193.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि यमेश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
तस्यैव नैरृते भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.193.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unsurpassed Yameśvara, / situated in its south-western direction, not very far away,
which quells sins upon sight and bestows the fruit of all desires.

16.193.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 193 ..
16.193.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये यमेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिणवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 193 ..
16.193.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-third chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Yameśvara', in the first [part], 'Glory of the Prabhāsa Field', of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.194.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ devaiḥ pratiṣṭhitam ..
jñātvā prabhāvaṃ kṣetrasya sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.194.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं देवैः प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
ज्ञात्वा प्रभावं क्षेत्रस्य सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.194.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga installed by the gods, / having recognized the power of the sacred field which destroys all sins.

16.194.s:
tatra kṛtvā tapaścograṃ liṃgaṃ devaiḥ pratiṣṭhitam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi kṛtakṛtyaḥ prajāyate .. 2 ..
16.194.d:
तत्र कृत्वा तपश्चोग्रं लिंगं देवैः प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि कृतकृत्यः प्रजायते .. 2 ..
16.194.m: Having performed severe austerity there, the liṅga was installed by the gods; / having seen it, O goddess, a man accomplishes his purpose.

16.194.s:
godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
samyakca labhate devi yātrāyāḥ phalamūrjitam .. 3 ..
16.194.d:
गोदानं तत्र देयं तु ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..
सम्यक्च लभते देवि यात्रायाः फलमूर्जितम् .. 3 ..
16.194.m: A gift of a cow should be given there to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas; / and one properly attains, O goddess, the abundant fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.194.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'mareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 194 ..
16.194.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽमरेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्णवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 194 ..
16.194.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Amareśvara', in the first [part], 'Glory of the Prabhāsa Field', of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.195.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato vṛddhaprabhāsaṃ tu gacchecca niyatātmavān ..
ādiprabhāsāddakṣiṇato nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.195.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो वृद्धप्रभासं तु गच्छेच्च नियतात्मवान् ..
आदिप्रभासाद्दक्षिणतो नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.195.m: Īśvara said: / Then one of controlled self should go to Vṛddhaprabhāsa, / situated to the south of Ādiprabhāsa, not very far away,

16.195.s: caturmukhaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ darśanātpāpanāśanam .. 2 ..
16.195.d: चतुर्मुखं महालिंगं दर्शनात्पापनाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.195.m: a four-faced great liṅga that destroys sins upon sight.

16.195.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ vṛddhaprabhāsaṃ tu nāma tasyābhavatprabho ..
tasmindṛṣṭe phalaṃ kiṃ syātstute saṃpūjite tathā .. 3 ..
16.195.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
कथं वृद्धप्रभासं तु नाम तस्याभवत्प्रभो ..
तस्मिन्दृष्टे फलं किं स्यात्स्तुते संपूजिते तथा .. 3 ..
16.195.m: The goddess said: / How did it get the name Vṛddhaprabhāsa, O Lord? / What would be the fruit when it is seen, praised, and worshipped?

16.195.s: etatkathaya me deva saṃkṣepānnātivistarāt .. 4 ..
16.195.d: एतत्कथय मे देव संक्षेपान्नातिविस्तरात् .. 4 ..
16.195.m: Tell me this, O God, in brief and not in excessive detail.

16.195.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
