ādau svāyaṃbhuve devi pūrvamanvantare purā ..
tretāyuge caturthe tu prabhāse kṣetra uttame .. 5 ..
16.195.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
आदौ स्वायंभुवे देवि पूर्वमन्वन्तरे पुरा ..
त्रेतायुगे चतुर्थे तु प्रभासे क्षेत्र उत्तमे .. 5 ..
16.195.m: Īśvara said: / In the beginning, O goddess, long ago in the first Svāyambhuva Manvantara, / in the fourth Tretāyuga, in the supreme sacred field of Prabhāsa,

16.195.s:
tasminkāle mahādevi pūrvamanvaṃtare purā ..
tretāyuge caturthe tu ṛṣayastatra saṃgatāḥ .. 6 ..
16.195.d:
तस्मिन्काले महादेवि पूर्वमन्वंतरे पुरा ..
त्रेतायुगे चतुर्थे तु ऋषयस्तत्र संगताः .. 6 ..
16.195.m: at that time, O great goddess, long ago in the former Manvantara, / in the fourth Tretāyuga, seers gathered there,

16.195.s:
darśanārthaṃ prabhāsasya uttarāpathagāminaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā''cchāditaṃ devaṃ vajreṇa tu maheśvari .. 7 ..
16.195.d:
दर्शनार्थं प्रभासस्य उत्तरापथगामिनः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा'ऽच्छादितं देवं वज्रेण तु महेश्वरि .. 7 ..
16.195.m: travelers of the northern path, for the sake of the darśana of Prabhāsa. / Having seen that god covered by a thunderbolt, O great goddess,

16.195.s:
viṣādaṃ paramaṃ jagmurvākyaṃ cedamathābuvan ..
adṛṣṭvā śāṃkaraṃ ligaṃ na yāsyāmo vayaṃ gṛham .. 8 ..
16.195.d:
विषादं परमं जग्मुर्वाक्यं चेदमथाबुवन् ..
अदृष्ट्वा शांकरं लिगं न यास्यामो वयं गृहम् .. 8 ..
16.195.m: they experienced great dejection and then spoke these words: / 'Without seeing the liṅga of Śaṃkara, we will not go home.

16.195.s:
svargārthino vayaṃ prāptā mahadadhvānameva hi ..
tasmādatraiva tiṣṭhāmo yāvalliṃgasya darśanam .. 9 ..
16.195.d:
स्वर्गार्थिनो वयं प्राप्ता महदध्वानमेव हि ..
तस्मादत्रैव तिष्ठामो यावल्लिंगस्य दर्शनम् .. 9 ..
16.195.m: Desiring heaven, we have indeed traveled a great distance; / therefore, we will stay right here until the darśana of the liṅga.'

16.195.s:
evaṃ te niścayaṃ kṛtvā parasmiṃstapasi sthitāḥ ..
varṣāsvākāśagā bhūtvā hemaṃte salilāśrayāḥ .. 7.1.195.10 ..
16.195.d:
एवं ते निश्चयं कृत्वा परस्मिंस्तपसि स्थिताः ..
वर्षास्वाकाशगा भूत्वा हेमंते सलिलाश्रयाः .. 7.1.195.10 ..
16.195.m: Having thus made their resolve, they engaged in supreme austerity: / staying in the open air during the rains, taking refuge in water during the cold season,

16.195.s:
pañcāgnisādhanā grīṣme niyatā brahmacāriṇaḥ ..
bahūnvarṣagaṇānviprā jarāgrastāstadā'bhavan .. 11 ..
16.195.d:
पञ्चाग्निसाधना ग्रीष्मे नियता ब्रह्मचारिणः ..
बहून्वर्षगणान्विप्रा जराग्रस्तास्तदाऽभवन् .. 11 ..
16.195.m: practicing the five fires in summer, self-restrained celibates. / Over many groups of years, those brahmins then became seized with old age.

16.195.s:
evaṃ vṛddhatvamāpannā yadā te varavarṇini ..
chandyamānā varaiste tu śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā .. 12 ..
16.195.d:
एवं वृद्धत्वमापन्ना यदा ते वरवर्णिनि ..
छन्द्यमाना वरैस्ते तु शंकरेण महात्मना .. 12 ..
16.195.m: When they had thus attained old age, O fair-complexioned one, / though coaxed with boons by the great-souled Śaṃkara,

16.195.s: liṃgasya darśanaṃ muktvā na te'nyaṃ vavrire varam .. 13 ..
16.195.d: लिंगस्य दर्शनं मुक्त्वा न तेऽन्यं वव्रिरे वरम् .. 13 ..
16.195.m: they chose no other boon except the darśana of the liṅga.

16.195.s:
teṣāṃ tu niścayaṃ jñātvā sarveṣāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
anukampāparo bhūtvā svaliṃgaṃ tānadarśayat .. 14 ..
16.195.d:
तेषां तु निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा सर्वेषां वृषभध्वजः ..
अनुकम्पापरो भूत्वा स्वलिंगं तानदर्शयत् .. 14 ..
16.195.m: Knowing the firm resolve of all of them, the bull-bannered [god], / becoming filled with compassion, showed them his own liṅga.

16.195.s:
etasminneva kāle tu bhittvā caiva vasundharām ..
utthitaṃ sahasā liṃgaṃ tadeva varavarṇini .. 15 ..
16.195.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भित्त्वा चैव वसुन्धराम् ..
उत्थितं सहसा लिंगं तदेव वरवर्णिनि .. 15 ..
16.195.m: At that very time, having split open the earth, / that same liṅga suddenly arose, O fair-complexioned one.

16.195.s:
ṛṣayaste ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve ca tridivaṃ gatāḥ ..
atha teṣu prayāteṣu śakrastaptamanā hyabhūt .. 16 ..
16.195.d:
ऋषयस्ते च तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे च त्रिदिवं गताः ..
अथ तेषु प्रयातेषु शक्रस्तप्तमना ह्यभूत् .. 16 ..
16.195.m: And having seen it, all those seers went to heaven. / Now, when they had departed, Śakra became distressed in mind;

16.195.s: tamapi cchādayāmāsa vajreṇa śataparvaṇā .. 17 ..
16.195.d: तमपि च्छादयामास वज्रेण शतपर्वणा .. 17 ..
16.195.m: he covered it too with his hundred-jointed thunderbolt.

16.195.s:
vṛddhabhāve yatasteṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ darśanaṃ gataḥ ..
ato vṛddhaprabhāsaṃ tatkīrtyate vasudhātale .. 18 ..!
16.195.d:
वृद्धभावे यतस्तेषामृषीणां दर्शनं गतः ..
अतो वृद्धप्रभासं तत्कीर्त्यते वसुधातले .. 18 ..!
16.195.m: Since he came into the sight of those seers when they were in an aged state, / therefore it is celebrated on earth as Vṛddhaprabhāsa.

16.195.s:
tasmindṛṣṭe varārohe adyāpi labhate phalam ..
rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ naro bhaktisamanvitaḥ .. 19 ..
16.195.d:
तस्मिन्दृष्टे वरारोहे अद्यापि लभते फलम् ..
राजसूयाश्वमेधानां नरो भक्तिसमन्वितः .. 19 ..
16.195.m: When it is seen, O lovely lady, even today a man endowed with devotion / obtains the fruit of the Rājasūya and Aśvamedha sacrifices.

16.195.s:
evaṃ tatra samutpannaṃ prabhāsaṃ vṛddhasaṃjñakam ..
tatrokṣā brāhmaṇe deyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 7.1.195.20 ..
16.195.d:
एवं तत्र समुत्पन्नं प्रभासं वृद्धसंज्ञकम् ..
तत्रोक्षा ब्राह्मणे देयः सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 7.1.195.20 ..
16.195.m: Thus Prabhāsa named Vṛddha arose there; / a bull should be given there to a brahmin by those desiring the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.195.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vṛddhaprabhāsamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 195 ..
16.195.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वृद्धप्रभासमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 195 ..
16.195.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Vṛddhaprabhāsa', in the first [part], 'Glory of the Prabhāsa Field', of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.196.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi prabhāsaṃ jalasaṃsthitam ..
vṛddhaprabhāsāddakṣiṇato nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.196.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि प्रभासं जलसंस्थितम् ..
वृद्धप्रभासाद्दक्षिणतो नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.196.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to Prabhāsa situated in the water, / situated to the south of Vṛddhaprabhāsa, not very far away.
Hear the supreme māhātmya of that very god, O goddess.

16.196.s:
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa yadā kṣattravadhaḥ kṛtaḥ ..
tadā'sya paramā jātā ghṛṇā manasi bhāmini .. 3 ..
16.196.d:
जामदग्न्येन रामेण यदा क्षत्त्रवधः कृतः ..
तदाऽस्य परमा जाता घृणा मनसि भामिनि .. 3 ..
16.196.m: When Rama, the son of Jamadagni, slaughtered the kṣatriyas, / then, O passionate lady, a deep remorse arose in his heart.

16.196.s:
tatastvārādhayāmāsa mahādevaṃ sureśvaram..
ugraṃ tapaḥ samāsthāya bahūnvarṣa gaṇānpriye .. 4 ..
16.196.d:
ततस्त्वाराधयामास महादेवं सुरेश्वरम्..
उग्रं तपः समास्थाय बहून्वर्ष गणान्प्रिये .. 4 ..
16.196.m: Thereupon he worshipped Mahādeva, the lord of gods, / having undertaken severe austerity for many series of years, O dear one.

16.196.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevastasya pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ..
abravīdvaradaste'haṃ varaṃ varaya suvrata .. 5 ..
16.196.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवस्तस्य प्रत्यक्षतां गतः ..
अब्रवीद्वरदस्तेऽहं वरं वरय सुव्रत .. 5 ..
16.196.m: Then Mahādeva, well-pleased, appeared before his eyes, / and said: “I am ready to grant a boon. Choose a boon, O one of noble vows!”

16.196.s:
.. rāma uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama ..
darśayasva svakaṃ liṃgaṃ yajñe vajreṇa chāditam .. 6 ..
16.196.d:
.. राम उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम ..
दर्शयस्व स्वकं लिंगं यज्ञे वज्रेण छादितम् .. 6 ..
16.196.m: Rāma said: / “If you are pleased with me, O god, if a boon is to be granted to me, / show your own liṅga that was covered with the thunderbolt at the sacrifice.

16.196.s:
ghṛṇā me mahatī jātā hatvemānkṣatriyānbahūn ..
darśanāttava liṃgasya yena me naśyate ghṛṇā .. 7 ..
16.196.d:
घृणा मे महती जाता हत्वेमान्क्षत्रियान्बहून् ..
दर्शनात्तव लिंगस्य येन मे नश्यते घृणा .. 7 ..
16.196.m: Great remorse has arisen in me from slaying these many kṣatriyas; / may my remorse be destroyed by the darśana of your liṅga,

16.196.s: tathā me pātakaṃ sarvaṃ prasādāttava śaṃkara .. 8 ..
16.196.d: तथा मे पातकं सर्वं प्रसादात्तव शंकर .. 8 ..
16.196.m: and likewise all my sin, through your grace, O Śaṃkara.”

16.196.s:
.. śaṃkara uvāca .. ..
mama liṃgaṃ sahasrākṣa utthitaṃ tu punaḥpunaḥ ..
vajreṇācchādayatyeva bhayena mahatā vṛtaḥ .. 9 ..
16.196.d:
.. शंकर उवाच .. ..
मम लिंगं सहस्राक्ष उत्थितं तु पुनःपुनः ..
वज्रेणाच्छादयत्येव भयेन महता वृतः .. 9 ..
16.196.m: Śaṃkara said: / “My liṅga kept rising again and again, but the Thousand-eyed One (Indra) / repeatedly covers it with his thunderbolt, overcome by great fear.

16.196.s: na te'haṃ darśanaṃ yāsye liṃgarūpī kadācana .. 7.1.196.10 ..
16.196.d: न तेऽहं दर्शनं यास्ये लिंगरूपी कदाचन .. 7.1.196.10 ..
16.196.m: I shall not appear to your darśana in the form of [that] liṅga at any time.

16.196.s:
yanmāṃ vadasi ghṛṇayā vṛto'haṃ pātakena tu ..
tatte'haṃ nāśayiṣyāmi sparśanāttu dvijottama .. 11 ..
16.196.d:
यन्मां वदसि घृणया वृतोऽहं पातकेन तु ..
तत्तेऽहं नाशयिष्यामि स्पर्शनात्तु द्विजोत्तम .. 11 ..
16.196.m: As for your saying to me, ‘I am filled with remorse and sin,’ / I shall destroy that for you through the touch [of another], O best of brahmins.

16.196.s:
asmiñjalāśraye puṇye jalamadhye mahāmate ..
utthāsyati mahāliṃgaṃ tasya tvaṃ darśanaṃ kuru .. .. 12 ..
16.196.d:
अस्मिञ्जलाश्रये पुण्ये जलमध्ये महामते ..
उत्थास्यति महालिंगं तस्य त्वं दर्शनं कुरु .. .. 12 ..
16.196.m: In this holy reservoir of water, in the midst of the water, O highly intelligent one, / a great liṅga will arise; behold it with darśana.

16.196.s:
gamiṣyati ghṛṇā sarvā niṣpāpastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ..
uktvaivamudatiṣṭhacca jalamadhyādvarānane .. 13 ..
16.196.d:
गमिष्यति घृणा सर्वा निष्पापस्त्वं भविष्यसि ..
उक्त्वैवमुदतिष्ठच्च जलमध्याद्वरानने .. 13 ..
16.196.m: All your remorse will depart, and you will become free from sin.” / Having spoken thus, O fair-faced lady, it arose from the midst of the water.

16.196.s:
jalaprabhāsanāmāsya tato jātaṃ dharātale ..
tasyālaṃ sparśanāddevi śivalokaṃ vrajennaraḥ .. 14 ..
16.196.d:
जलप्रभासनामास्य ततो जातं धरातले ..
तस्यालं स्पर्शनाद्देवि शिवलोकं व्रजेन्नरः .. 14 ..
16.196.m: Therefore its name on the earth's surface became Jalaprabhāsa. / Merely by touching it, O goddess, a man goes to the realm of Śiva.

16.196.s:
ekaṃ bhojayate yo'tra brāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam ..
bhojito'haṃ bhavettena sapatnīko na saṃśayaḥ .. 15 ..
16.196.d:
एकं भोजयते योऽत्र ब्राह्मणं शंसितव्रतम् ..
भोजितोऽहं भवेत्तेन सपत्नीको न संशयः .. 15 ..
16.196.m: Whoever feeds here a single brahmin of commended vows, / by him have I been fed along with my wife; there is no doubt.

16.196.s:
eṣā jalaprabhāsasya saṃbhūtiste mayoditā ..
śrutā pāpopaśamanī sarvakāmaphalapradā .. 16 ..
16.196.d:
एषा जलप्रभासस्य संभूतिस्ते मयोदिता ..
श्रुता पापोपशमनी सर्वकामफलप्रदा .. 16 ..
16.196.m: This origin of Jalaprabhāsa has been recounted to you by me. / When heard, it quells sin and bestows the fruit of all desires.

16.196.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jalaprabhāsamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṇṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 196 ..
16.196.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जलप्रभासमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षण्णवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 196 ..
16.196.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-sixth chapter, named “Description of the Māhātmya of Jalaprabhāsa,” in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.197.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi jamadagnīśvaraṃ śivam ..
vṛddhaprabhāsasāmīpye nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.197.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि जमदग्नीश्वरं शिवम् ..
वृद्धप्रभाससामीप्ये नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.197.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the auspicious Jamadagnīśvara, / situated near Vṛddhaprabhāsa, not very far away,

16.197.s:
sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ sthāpitaṃ jamadagninā ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi mucyate ca ṛṇatrayāt .. 2 ..
16.197.d:
सर्वपापोपशमनं स्थापितं जमदग्निना ..
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि मुच्यते च ऋणत्रयात् .. 2 ..
16.197.m: which pacifies all sins and was installed by Jamadagni. / Having seen it, O goddess, a mortal is freed from the three debts.

16.197.s:
snātvā nidhānavāpyāṃ ca saṃpūjya prāpnuyāddhanam ..
nidhānaṃ pāṃḍavairlabdhaṃ tatra sthāne purā priye .. 3 ..
16.197.d:
स्नात्वा निधानवाप्यां च संपूज्य प्राप्नुयाद्धनम् ..
निधानं पांडवैर्लब्धं तत्र स्थाने पुरा प्रिये .. 3 ..
16.197.m: Having bathed in the Nidhānavāpī and worshipped [it], one obtains wealth. / A treasure was found by the Pāṇḍavas in that place long ago, O dear one;
because of that very treasure (nidhāna), that step-well (vāpī) is praised throughout the three worlds.

16.197.s:
tasyāṃ snātvā mahādevi durbhagā subhagā bhavet ..
labhate vāñchitānkāmāniti proktaṃ mayā tava .. 5 ..
16.197.d:
तस्यां स्नात्वा महादेवि दुर्भगा सुभगा भवेत् ..
लभते वाञ्छितान्कामानिति प्रोक्तं मया तव .. 5 ..
16.197.m: Having bathed in it, O great goddess, an unfortunate woman becomes fortunate, / and obtains her wished-for desires: thus it has been declared by me to you.

16.197.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśātisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jamadagnīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 197 .. ..
16.197.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशातिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जमदग्नीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 197 .. ..
16.197.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-seventh chapter, named “Description of the Māhātmya of Jamadagnīśvara,” in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.198.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi mahāprabhāsamuttamam ..
jalaprabhāsato yāmye yamamārgavighātakam .. 1 ..
16.198.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि महाप्रभासमुत्तमम् ..
जलप्रभासतो याम्ये यममार्गविघातकम् .. 1 ..
16.198.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Mahāprabhāsa, / to the south of Jalaprabhāsa, which blocks the path of Yama.

16.198.s: śṛṇu tasyaiva māhātmyaṃ yathā jātaṃ dharātale .. .. 2 ..
16.198.d: शृणु तस्यैव माहात्म्यं यथा जातं धरातले .. .. 2 ..
16.198.m: Hear its māhātmya, how it came into being on the surface of the earth.

16.198.s:
pūrvaṃ tretāyuge devi sparśaliṃgaṃ tu tatsmṛtam ..
divyaṃ tejomayaṃ nṛṇāṃ sparśanānmuktidāyakam .. 3 ..
16.198.d:
पूर्वं त्रेतायुगे देवि स्पर्शलिंगं तु तत्स्मृतम् ..
दिव्यं तेजोमयं नृणां स्पर्शनान्मुक्तिदायकम् .. 3 ..
16.198.m: Formerly, in the Tretā age, O goddess, it was known as the Sparśaliṅga, / divine, full of fiery splendour, granting liberation to men merely by touch.

16.198.s:
atha kāle ca kasmiṃścidvajriṇācchāditaṃ priye ..
indreṇāgatya vasudhāṃ bhayākrāṃtena sundari .. 4 ..
16.198.d:
अथ काले च कस्मिंश्चिद्वज्रिणाच्छादितं प्रिये ..
इन्द्रेणागत्य वसुधां भयाक्रांतेन सुन्दरि .. 4 ..
16.198.m: Then, at a certain time, O dear one, it was covered with the thunderbolt / by Indra, who descended to the earth, seized with fear, O beautiful lady.

16.198.s:
uṣmā tadudbhavo devi nirgacchannavarodhitaḥ ..
daśakoṭipravistīrṇaṃ jvālāgraṃ liṃgarūpadhṛk .. 5 ..
16.198.d:
उष्मा तदुद्भवो देवि निर्गच्छन्नवरोधितः ..
दशकोटिप्रविस्तीर्णं ज्वालाग्रं लिंगरूपधृक् .. 5 ..
16.198.m: The heat arising from it, O goddess, could not be restrained as it issued forth; / having the tip of its flames extending over a hundred million [yojanas], bearing the form of a liṅga,

16.198.s:
prabhāsakṣetramāsthāya bhittvā''virbhāvamāsthitam ..
vajreṇa ruṃdhite devi bhittvā caiva vasuṃdharām .. 6 ..
16.198.d:
प्रभासक्षेत्रमास्थाय भित्त्वा'ऽविर्भावमास्थितम् ..
वज्रेण रुंधिते देवि भित्त्वा चैव वसुंधराम् .. 6 ..
16.198.m: taking its stand in the Prabhāsakṣetra, it split [the earth] and became manifest. / When it was blocked with the thunderbolt, O goddess, it cleaved the earth,

16.198.s:
dhūmasaṃghaiḥ sametaṃ tu vyāpayāmāsa tajjagat ..
tatastrailokyamakhilaṃ jvālābhirvyākulīkṛtam .. 7 ..
16.198.d:
धूमसंघैः समेतं तु व्यापयामास तज्जगत् ..
ततस्त्रैलोक्यमखिलं ज्वालाभिर्व्याकुलीकृतम् .. 7 ..
16.198.m: and, accompanied by masses of smoke, pervaded that world. / Thereupon the entire triple world was thrown into distress by the flames.

16.198.s:
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarva ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ ..
astuvanvividhaiḥ sūktairvedoktaiḥ śaśiśekharam .. 8 ..
16.198.d:
ततः सुरगणाः सर्व ऋषयो वेदपारगाः ..
अस्तुवन्विविधैः सूक्तैर्वेदोक्तैः शशिशेखरम् .. 8 ..
16.198.m: Then all the hosts of gods and the seers who had mastered the Vedas / praised the Moon-crested Lord with diverse hymns declared in the Vedas:

16.198.s:
saṃharasva suraśreṣṭha tejaḥ svadahanātmakam .. trai
lokyaṃ vyākulībhūtamevaṃ sarvaṃ carācaram ..
na yāvatpralayaṃ yāti tāvadrakṣa sureśvara .. 9 ..
16.198.d:
संहरस्व सुरश्रेष्ठ तेजः स्वदहनात्मकम् .. त्रै
लोक्यं व्याकुलीभूतमेवं सर्वं चराचरम् ..
न यावत्प्रलयं याति तावद्रक्ष सुरेश्वर .. 9 ..
16.198.m: “Withdraw, O best of gods, your fiery splendour composed of burning heat! / The entire triple world, with all moving and unmoving beings, is thus distraught. / Protect us, O lord of gods, before it goes to total dissolution!”

16.198.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evamābhāṣamāṇeṣu tridiveṣu sureśvari ..
tattejaḥ pañcadhāviṣṭaṃ vyāpyāśeṣaṃ jagattrayam .. .. 7.1.198.10 ..
16.198.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवमाभाषमाणेषु त्रिदिवेषु सुरेश्वरि ..
तत्तेजः पञ्चधाविष्टं व्याप्याशेषं जगत्त्रयम् .. .. 7.1.198.10 ..
16.198.m: Īśvara said: / As the dwellers in heaven were speaking thus, O sovereign of the gods, / that splendour entered into five parts, pervading the entire triple world.

16.198.s:
pañcaprabhāsarūpeṇa bhittvā tatra vasundharām..
yena mārgeṇa niṣkrāntaṃ tanmārge ca mahanmahaḥ .. 11 ..
16.198.d:
पञ्चप्रभासरूपेण भित्त्वा तत्र वसुन्धराम्..
येन मार्गेण निष्क्रान्तं तन्मार्गे च महन्महः .. 11 ..
16.198.m: In the form of the five Prabhāsas, it split open the earth there; / along the path by which it issued forth, that great splendour [arose].

16.198.s:
tatra taiḥ sthāpitaṃ dvāraṃ supradeśe'śmajaṃ priye ..
pihite'tha ca raṃdhre'smindhūmo nāśamupeyivān .. 12 ..
16.198.d:
तत्र तैः स्थापितं द्वारं सुप्रदेशेऽश्मजं प्रिये ..
पिहितेऽथ च रंध्रेऽस्मिन्धूमो नाशमुपेयिवान् .. 12 ..
16.198.m: There a stone door was placed by them in an auspicious spot, O dear one; / and when this aperture was covered, the smoke ceased to exist.

16.198.s:
svasthāścaivābhavam̐llokāstejastatraiva saṃsthitam ..
evaṃ mayā preritāste liṃgaṃ tatra samādadhuḥ .. 13 ..
16.198.d:
स्वस्थाश्चैवाभवम्̐ल्लोकास्तेजस्तत्रैव संस्थितम् ..
एवं मया प्रेरितास्ते लिंगं तत्र समादधुः .. 13 ..
16.198.m: The worlds became at ease, and the splendour remained right there. / Directed thus by me, they installed the liṅga there.

16.198.s:
tanmahastatra deveśi viśrāmamakarottadā ..
tato mahāprabhāseti kīrtyate devadānavaiḥ .. 14 ..
16.198.d:
तन्महस्तत्र देवेशि विश्राममकरोत्तदा ..
ततो महाप्रभासेति कीर्त्यते देवदानवैः .. 14 ..
16.198.m: That great splendour then took rest there, O queen of gods; / therefore it is praised as Mahāprabhāsa by the gods and Dānavas.

16.198.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā liṃgaṃ puṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam .. 15 ..
16.198.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या लिंगं पुष्पैः पृथग्विधैः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं जरामरणवर्जितम् .. 15 ..
16.198.m: He who worships that liṅga with devotion with diverse kinds of flowers / goes to the supreme abode, free from old age and death.

16.198.s:
dṛṣṭena tena deveśi mucyate pātakairnaraḥ ..
labhate vāñchitānkāmānmanasā cepsitānpriye .. 16 ..
16.198.d:
दृष्टेन तेन देवेशि मुच्यते पातकैर्नरः ..
लभते वाञ्छितान्कामान्मनसा चेप्सितान्प्रिये .. 16 ..
16.198.m: When it is beheld, O ruler of the gods, a mortal is freed from sins; / he obtains his wished-for desires and whatever is cherished in his heart, O dear one.

16.198.s:
hiraṇyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe śaṃsitavrate ..
godānaṃ vidhivattatra deyaṃ caiva dvijanmane .. 17 ..
16.198.d:
हिरण्यं तत्र दातव्यं ब्राह्मणे शंसितव्रते ..
गोदानं विधिवत्तत्र देयं चैव द्विजन्मने .. 17 ..
16.198.m: Gold should be given there to a brahmin of commended vows; / and a gift of cows should be given there according to rule to a twice-born person.

16.198.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā mahādevi labhate janmanaḥ phalam ..
rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ prāpnuyātphalamūrjitam .. 18 ..
16.198.d:
एवं कृत्वा महादेवि लभते जन्मनः फलम् ..
राजसूयाश्वमेधानां प्राप्नुयात्फलमूर्जितम् .. 18 ..
16.198.m: Having done so, O great goddess, one obtains the fruit of one’s birth; / one will obtain the abundant fruit of the Rājasūya and Aśvamedha sacrifices.

16.198.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pañcamaprabhāsakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭānavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 198 ..
16.198.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पञ्चमप्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टानवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 198 ..
16.198.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-eighth chapter, named “Description of the Māhātmya of the Fifth Prabhāsakṣetra,” in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].
